Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. data.description:
Company Description Arete Manufacturing Services Pvt. Ltd. is an ISO 9001: 2015, IATF 16949: 2016, and ISO 13485: 2016-certified Electronics Manufacturing Services organization based in Pune, Maharashtra, India. The company delivers end-to-end EMS solutions, including prototyping, PCB assembly, testing, and full-scale box build assembly. With a process-driven approach and state-of-the-art manufacturing facilities, Arete focuses on quality, reliability, and regulatory compliance across every stage of production. Its expert team combines deep industry knowledge with advanced technology to design tailored processes that meet unique client requirements. Collaboration, timely delivery, and cost-effective execution are central to how Arete supports customers and drives product excellence. 
Role Description The Subject Matter Expert role is a full-time, on-site position based in the Pune Division. The Subject Matter Expert will provide deep technical and process expertise in electronics manufacturing, supporting teams across prototyping, PCB assembly, testing, and box build operations. Responsibilities include developing and refining standard operating procedures, advising on best practices for quality and compliance, and troubleshooting complex production and process issues. The role involves collaborating closely with engineering, production, quality, and customer-facing teams to optimize workflows, reduce defects, and improve overall efficiency. The Subject Matter Expert will also contribute to training programs, documentation, and continuous improvement initiatives to ensure that the organization maintains high performance and alignment with industry standards. 
Qualifications

- Strong expertise in electronics manufacturing processes, including prototyping, PCB assembly, testing, and box build operations. 
 - Experience with quality management systems and standards such as ISO 9001, IATF 16949, and ISO 13485, and familiarity with regulatory and compliance requirements. 
 - Ability to develop, review, and improve process documentation, work instructions, and standard operating procedures. 
 - Proven skills in cross-functional collaboration with engineering, production, quality, and supply chain teams to resolve complex technical issues. 
 - Analytical and problem-solving skills for root-cause analysis, process optimization, and continuous improvement initiatives. 
 - Strong communication skills to explain complex technical concepts clearly and to support training and knowledge transfer. 
 - Bachelor's degree in Electronics, Electrical Engineering, Manufacturing, or a related technical field; advanced certifications in quality or process engineering are an advantage. 
 - Demonstrated ability to work on-site in a fast-paced manufacturing environment and manage multiple priorities while maintaining attention to detail.

data.title: Technical Architect - AWS
data.description:
About Us

At Rhythm, our values form the foundation of our business. We are passionate about customer success, innovation, and our employees. They guide our actions, decisions, and interactions, ensuring that we consistently make a positive impact on the world around us. 

Job Description

Position Overview

We are seeking a rare, highly skilled hybrid AWS Solutions Architect & Software Developer to join our core product engineering team. In this role, you will bridge the gap between high-level cloud architecture and hands-on backend development. You will be responsible for designing, implementing, and code-authoring the robust cloud infrastructure that powers our data core. 

The primary focus of this position is architecting and developing the high-throughput pipelines that process raw "fleet exhaust data" (noise) in AWS and funnel actionable summaries (signals) into our enterprise presentation layer. You will heavily focus on complex data orchestrations and integrations across AWS, Salesforce Data Cloud, MuleSoft, and critical third-party fleet compliance ecosystems. 

Key Responsibilities

As a hybrid Architect and Developer, your responsibilities will span architectural design, core systems programming, and cross-platform ecosystem integration: 

Cloud Architecture & Strategy

- Design & Scale: Architect and optimize secure, scalable, and cost-effective cloud infrastructures capable of ingesting massive, high-velocity streaming data environments. 
 - Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Develop and maintain production-ready CloudFormation or Terraform templates to ensure fully automated, repeatable environment deployments. 
 - CI/CD Leadership: Establish and govern standardized CI/CD pipelines that continuously decrease time-to-production for new backend features while enforcing rigorous quality and testing gates. 
 - Security & Trust: Design and implement a robust Cloud Trust Architecture ensuring compliance with stringent data protection best practices and role-based access control. 

Backend Software Engineering

- Write Robust Backend Code: Write clean, highly performant, and scalable code (primarily utilizing Python or Node. js) to build core AWS backend services, APIs, and microservices. 
 - Data Processing & AI: Program state-of-the-art serverless workflows utilizing AWS Lambda, EventBridge, and Amazon Bedrock to compute derived risk indicators (e. g. , speeding minutes per 100 miles, trend slope tracking). 
 - Database & Knowledge Lake Management: Optimize structured and unstructured data persistence strategies across Amazon S3, RDS instances, and managed Vector Databases. 
 - Testing & Quality Assurance: Author and run extensive unit and integration tests for AWS-based applications, lead code reviews, and aggressively improve core data processing algorithms. 

Multi-Platform Ecosystem Integration

- Ecosystem Orchestration: Architect the ingestion paths for high-velocity telematics and IoT data, isolating massive volume processing in AWS before translating relevant indicators to executive CRM workflows. 
 - Telematics & Compliance Integration: Build and maintain direct API data pipelines integrating heavy enterprise platforms and third-party systems including: 
 - Telematics Infrastructure: Deep integration with providers like Verizon Connect (VZC) to ingest real-time engine diagnostics, GPS, and harsh event data. 
 - Regulatory Compliance: Integrations with FMCSA API systems (including SAFER, SMS, A&I, and DataQs datasets). 
 - Risk & Personnel Platforms: Synchronized identity management pipelines with Motor Vehicle Record (MVR) monitoring and Learning Management Systems (LMS) such as Samba Safety, Sentix, or related Risk Cloud environments. 
 - Salesforce & MuleSoft Collaboration: Partner closely with application teams to orchestrate end-to-end event-driven flows using MuleSoft for bidirectional Roster CRUD logic, linking the AWS Knowledge Lake cleanly with Salesforce Data Cloud and AgentForce. 
Requirements

What We're Looking For

- Education: Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related technical field. 
 - Experience: 
 - Minimum of 5-7 years of proven hands-on software development experience writing clean production code. 
 - Minimum of 2 years of dedicated experience acting as an AWS Solutions Architect designing complex, multi-system integration topographies. 
 - AWS Certifications: Valid AWS Certifications are strongly preferred (e. g. , AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Professional, AWS Certified Developer - Associate). 
 - Technical Proficiency: 
 - Languages: Advanced proficiency in Python or Node. js. 
 - AWS Infrastructure: Deep knowledge of AWS S3, Lambda, EventBridge, Amazon Bedrock, Lex, Connect, SES, and native database layers (RDS, DynamoDB, or Vector DBs). 
 - Integration Tech: Exceptional familiarity with building and consuming web services across API, REST, and RPC architectures. 
 - Containers: Experience working with Docker and Kubernetes environments for containerized compute deployment. 
 - Domain Context: Prior experience writing applications that parse telematics data, cellular/IoT streams, geographic spatial boundaries, or government/compliance API interfaces is a significant advantage. 
 - Soft Skills: Exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills, with a dedicated approach to data-driven technical execution and clear, transparent team communication.

data.title: Testing Engineer
data.description:
We're looking for a Testing Engineer to own end-to-end quality for assigned products and features. The ideal candidate will move beyond execution into defining test strategies, setting quality standards, improving automation coverage, and driving cross-team quality advocacy. 

Core Responsibilities

- Analyze functional and non-functional requirements and clarify ambiguities early. 
 - Define, maintain, and prioritize test plans (positive, negative, edge, regression). 
 - Design reusable test cases and suites; keep them versioned and traceable. 
 - Set up pipelines/tasks for scalability and benchmarking to review different environments/conditions. 
 - Execute tests: manual (exploratory, UX, edge) and automated (API, UI, integration). 
 - Log clear, reproducible defects (steps, environment, evidence, impact). 
 - Verify fixes, manage defect lifecycle, and prevent reopens via root cause analysis. 
 - Contribute to performance, load, reliability, and basic security test coverage. 
 - Maintain test data, environments, and baseline health checks. 
 - Track and report quality metrics (defect density, pass rate, automation %, MTTR). 
 - Collaborate with Dev/Product teams on release readiness (go/no-go signals). 
 - Improve and refactor existing tests to reduce flakiness and execution time. 
 - Participate in design reviews with a "testability" lens. 
 - Participate in comparative studies for different approaches/platforms. 

Key Outcomes (Success Indicators)

- Defects caught pre-release increase; post-production escapes trend down. 
 - Automation coverage % (critical paths) increases sprint over sprint. 
 - Flaky test rate reduced and tracked. 
 - Consistent, documented test standards adopted across teams. 
 - Release confidence improved (shorter stabilization window). 
 - Clear actionables from comparative studies and/or observed insights driving product stability and reliability. 

Required Skills

- 1-3 years of experience with testing. 
 - Solid understanding of software testing principles (functional, regression, boundary, exploratory). 
 - Experience with UI automation (Playwright / Selenium / Cypress). 
 - Familiarity with low-code automation tools like Cucumber, BugBug, BrowserStack, etc. 
 - Hands-on experience with at least one automation framework (API or UI). 
 - Competent in scripting (Python or JavaScript) for test creation/utilities. 
 - Able to design clear, reproducible defect reports with impact context. 
 - Working knowledge of REST API testing (Postman/Newman, curl, or pytest requests). 
 - Familiar with Git, branching, PR workflows, and CI basics (GitHub Actions/GitLab/Jenkins). 

Nice to Have

- Experience with UI automation (Playwright / Selenium / Cypress). 
 - Exposure to performance/load tools (k6, Locust, JMeter). 
 - Basic container and service debugging (Docker logs, health probes). 
 - Familiarity with contract testing (e. g. , Pact) or schema validation. 
 - Knowledge of observability signals (logs, metrics, basic tracing) for root cause assistance. 
 - Experience with test data management and environment isolation. 
How We Work

- We use Microsoft Teams for daily communication, including standups and team meetings. 
 - Our culture values open discussion, ownership, and a founder's mindset. 
 - We prioritize exceptional design, UI/UX, thorough documentation, clear to-do lists, and data-driven decision-making. 
 - Team bonding is encouraged through bi-monthly townhalls, destressing sessions with a certified healer, and biannual company retreats. 
 - We offer a fully remote workplace, comprehensive health insurance, attractive equity options for top performers, mental health consultations, company-sponsored upskilling courses, designated growth hours, 40 hours annually for community causes, and access to a financial advisor. 
 - Wobot is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

EnCharge's robust and scalable next-generation in-memory computing technology provides orders-of-magnitude higher compute efficiency and density compared to today's best-in-class solutions. The high-performance architecture is coupled with seamless software integration and will enable the immense potential of AI to be accessible in power, energy, and space constrained applications. EnCharge AI launched in 2022 and is led by veteran technologists with backgrounds in semiconductor design and AI systems. 

Job Title: Staff / Senior Staff CAD & Methodology Engineer (Digital Implementation & Signoff)

Location: [ Bangalore Hybrid / INDIA Remote]

Role Overview

We are an ambitious AI hardware startup building next-generation accelerators with massive compute density. To achieve aggressive Power, Performance, and Area (PPA) targets on accelerated tapeout schedules, we require a robust, highly automated, and heavily optimized physical implementation and signoff flow. 

As a Staff / Senior Staff CAD & Methodology Engineer, You will be the resident expert in Innovus and Tempus, responsible for developing, debugging, and continually accelerating our RTL-to-GDSII and timing signoff flows. You will work closely with Physical Design and STA leads to eliminate bottlenecks, automate manual tasks, and push the limits of EDA capabilities at advanced process nodes. 

Key Responsibilities

- Flow Architecture & Automation: Architect, develop, and maintain a highly automated, robust, and scalable physical design and signoff flow from synthesis through GDSII, optimized for AI accelerator architectures. 
 - Innovus Methodology: Drive advanced physical design methodologies in Cadence Innovus. Optimize recipes for floorplanning, placement, Clock Tree Synthesis (CTS), routing, and power grid implementation to squeeze out maximum PPA. 
 - Tempus Signoff Integration: Own the STA and timing signoff methodology using Cadence Tempus. Implement and optimize Distributed Multi-Scenario Analysis (DMSA), advanced OCV methodologies, and automated Tempus ECO flows to ensure rapid timing closure.

data.title: Principal Cybersecurity Architect
data.description:
Providence is seeking an exceptional Principal Cybersecurity Architect to lead the research, development, and deployment of Small Language Models (SLMs) specialized for healthcare and cybersecurity applications. This role combines cutting-edge machine learning research with practical implementation, requiring deep expertise in model architecture design, advanced fine-tuning techniques, graph-based knowledge systems, and vector-based retrieval augmentation. 

The ideal candidate will architect and train efficient, domain-specialized language models using state-of-the-art techniques including LoRA/QLoRA, graph neural networks, vector embeddings, and hybrid retrieval systems. This position requires both depth in machine learning and hands-on implementation skills to deliver high-impact solutions for healthcare operations, clinical workflows, and security applications. 

Key Responsibilities

- Design, develop, and optimize Small Language Models for healthcare and cybersecurity domains using advanced architectures (efficient transformers, MoE, sparse attention), compression techniques (quantization: INT8/INT4/GPTQ/AWQ, pruning, knowledge distillation), and emerging SLM architectures (Phi-3, Gemma, Mistral 7B variants) with rigorous ablation studies balancing model size, inference speed, accuracy, and resource requirements 
 - Implement parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) techniques including LoRA, QLoRA, prefix tuning, prompt tuning, and adapter layers; design instruction tuning pipelines aligning SLMs with clinical terminology and security protocols; develop multi-task learning frameworks; and deploy continuous learning strategies using DPO, RLHF, and active learning while optimizing hyperparameters to prevent overfitting on limited healthcare datasets 
 - Implement knowledge graphs capturing domain relationships and build graph-augmented language models integrating Neo4j/Cosmos DB with unstructured text processing, leveraging GNN components (PyTorch Geometric, DGL, GraphSAGE) for entity relationship modeling and complex graph traversal reasoning 
 - Create entity extraction and relation classification pipelines that automatically populate and maintain knowledge graphs from clinical documents, security logs, and operational data to enable graph-based reasoning across patient journeys, care coordination workflows, and security incident chains 
 - Optimize model inference using vLLM, TensorRT-LLM, llama. cpp, GGML, and Optimum for maximum throughput/minimum latency; implement scalable model serving architectures (Triton, TorchServe, FastAPI) with batching, caching, and load balancing; design A/B testing frameworks and champion-challenger patterns for safe production model updates 
 - Design and implement vector database architectures for semantic search and RAG applications using specialized embeddings optimized for cyber text, with hybrid search combining dense vector retrieval, sparse BM25 matching, and graph-based context expansion 
 - Build advanced RAG architectures implementing multi-vector retrieval, reranking strategies (Cohere, Cross-Encoders), context compression, and query decomposition; optimize vector indexing (HNSW, IVF, Product Quantization) balancing accuracy, latency, and memory footprint; and develop chunking pipelines for diverse cyber data formats 
 - Experience in end-to-end data pipelines for cyber text corpora processing, implementing data quality frameworks through de-identification and synthetic data generation (Synthea), bias detection, and representativeness metrics while building experiment tracking systems (MLflow) for versioning and reproducibility 
 - Develop distributed training workflows using DeepSpeed, FSDP, or Megatron-LM for efficient multi-GPU/multi-node training on Azure ML; create automated data augmentation pipelines (back-translation, paraphrasing, entity substitution, synthetic generation) to expand limited healthcare training datasets while maintaining clinical validity 
 - Design comprehensive evaluation frameworks measuring healthcare-specific task performance (NER, relation extraction, summarization, QA, reasoning) with custom benchmark datasets aligned to clinical accuracy requirements, regulatory compliance, and operational impact; implement automated robustness testing for adversarial attacks, edge cases, OOD detection, and hallucination detection 
 - Conduct comparative analysis of SLM variants across accuracy, latency, throughput, memory, and cost metrics; build interpretability tools using attention visualization, SHAP values, and integrated gradients to ensure clinical safety and explainability for healthcare stakeholders and regulatory requirements 
 - Understand on monitoring and observability dashboards tracking model performance drift, data distribution shifts, embedding quality degradation, and retrieval accuracy in production; collaborate with MLOps teams on containerization (Docker), Kubernetes/AKS deployment, and CI/CD pipelines for automated testing and deployment workflows 
 - Build security-focused SLMs for threat detection, log analysis, vulnerability assessment, incident response automation, and policy compliance checking 
 - Partner with clinical stakeholders, security teams, and product managers to identify high-impact use cases and translate domain requirements into technical specifications; mentor junior data scientists on SLM development, fine-tuning techniques, and healthcare AI; contribute to knowledge sharing through documentation, tech talks, and research communities; stay current with emerging research through literature review, conference participation, and experimentation

Required Qualifications

Education & Experience

- 7-10 years of experience in data science, machine learning research, or AI engineering with demonstrated track record of developing and deploying language models 
 - 3+ years hands-on experience with transformer architectures, fine-tuning methodologies, and production NLP system development 
 - Proven experience applying machine learning in healthcare, life sciences, or highly regulated industries with understanding of domain-specific challenges

Core Technical Skills

- Expert-level proficiency in Python and core ML libraries including PyTorch, Hugging Face Transformers, PEFT, TRL (Transformer Reinforcement Learning), and BitsAndBytes 
 - Deep hands-on experience with parameter-efficient fine-tuning: LoRA, QLoRA, AdaLoRA, prefix tuning, prompt tuning, P-Tuning, IA3, and adapter methods 
 - Strong knowledge of model quantization techniques and tools: GPTQ, AWQ, GGUF/GGML, bitsandbytes (4-bit/8-bit quantization), and post-training quantization strategies 
 - Expertise in transformer architectures including attention mechanisms (multi-head, grouped-query, sliding window), positional encodings (RoPE, ALiBi), and architectural variants (encoder-only, decoder-only, encoder-decoder) 
 - Practical experience optimizing model training: mixed precision (FP16, BF16), gradient checkpointing, gradient accumulation, distributed training (DDP, FSDP, DeepSpeed ZeRO), and memory-efficient techniques 
 - Strong foundation in machine learning fundamentals including optimization algorithms, regularization techniques, loss functions, evaluation metrics, and experimental design

Graph & Vector Technologies

- Hands-on experience with graph databases: Neo4j, Amazon Neptune, Azure Cosmos DB (Gremlin API), or TigerGraph including Cypher/Gremlin query languages and graph data modelling 
 - Proficiency in graph neural networks using PyTorch Geometric, DGL (Deep Graph Library), Spektral, or GraphSAGE for node classification, link prediction, and graph classification tasks 
 - Deep experience with vector databases and similarity search: Pinecone, Weaviate, Qdrant, Milvus, Chroma, FAISS, or Annoy including index optimization and hybrid search implementations 
 - Expertise in embedding models and techniques: sentence transformers, bi-encoders, cross-encoders, domain-adapted embeddings, and multi-modal embeddings 
 - Strong knowledge of RAG architectures: naive RAG, advanced RAG (with reranking, query transformation), modular RAG, and evaluation frameworks (RAGAS, TruLens) 
 - Understanding of knowledge graph construction techniques including entity extraction, relation extraction, entity linking, and ontology alignment

Data & Infrastructure Skills

- Proficiency with cloud ML platforms, preferably Azure ML, Azure Databricks, or equivalent (AWS SageMaker, Google Vertex AI) for model training and deployment 
 - Strong SQL skills and experience with data warehouses (Snowflake preferred) and data lakes (Azure Data Lake, Delta Lake) for working with healthcare datasets 
 - Experience with experiment tracking and model management: MLflow, Weights & Biases, Comet. ml, Neptune. ai, or similar platforms 
 - Familiarity with containerization (Docker), orchestration (Kubernetes), and version control (Git) for reproducible ML workflows 
 - Knowledge of data processing frameworks: Pandas, Polars, Dask, Spark (PySpark) for large-scale data manipulation and feature engineering

Domain Knowledge

- Understanding of healthcare data standards (HL7, FHIR), clinical terminologies (SNOMED CT, ICD-10, LOINC, RxNorm), and EHR systems (Epic, Cerner, Oracle Health) 
 - Knowledge of healthcare privacy regulations (HIPAA, HITECH) and data security requirements including de-identification standards (Safe Harbor, Expert Determination) 
 - Familiarity with clinical workflows, medical documentation practices, and healthcare operational challenges that AI systems must address 
 - Understanding of responsible AI principles including bias detection, fairness metrics, model interpretability, and ethical considerations for healthcare AI

Professional Competencies

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with ability to formulate complex business problems as machine learning tasks 
 - Excellent communication skills with ability to explain technical concepts to clinical, business, and executive stakeholders 
 - Demonstrated ability to manage end-to-end data science projects from problem definition through production deployment 
 - Strong collaboration skills with experience working across data engineering, ML engineering, product, and clinical teams 
 - Self-directed learner who stays current with rapidly evolving AI/ML research and proactively experiments with emerging techniques

Preferred Qualifications

- PhD in Machine Learning, Natural Language Processing, Computer Science, or related field with publications in top-tier conferences (NeurIPS, ICML, ACL, EMNLP, ICLR) 
 - Research contributions to efficient language models, parameter-efficient fine-tuning, knowledge graphs, or retrieval-augmented generation domains 
 - Experience with instruction tuning datasets and methodologies including self-instruct, Alpaca-style datasets, FLAN, and human preference alignment (DPO, PPO) 
 - Hands-on experience with inference optimization frameworks: vLLM, TensorRT-LLM, text-generation-inference, CTranslate2, or ONNX Runtime for production deployment 
 - Familiarity with agentic AI frameworks including LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, AutoGen, CrewAI, or Semantic Kernel for building multi-step AI workflows 
 - Experience with prompt engineering techniques, prompt optimization frameworks (DSPy, PromptSource), and evaluation of prompt effectiveness 
 - Knowledge of clinical NLP benchmarks and datasets: i2b2, MIMIC, n2c2, BioASQ, PubMedQA, and clinical outcome prediction tasks 
 - Familiarity with multi-modal models combining text with clinical imaging, genomics, or time-series physiological data 
 - Experience with federated learning or privacy-preserving ML techniques (differential privacy, secure multi-party computation) for sensitive healthcare data 
 - Contributions to open-source ML/AI projects (Hugging Face, PyTorch, LangChain ecosystem) or active participation in ML research communities 
 - Prior experience in healthcare technology organizations, clinical research institutions, or regulated industries with complex compliance requirements

Success Metrics & Objectives

Role

Performance in this role will be evaluated based on the following key metrics aligned with Providence's AI Data Science and Engineering OKR framework: 

Model Performance & Quality

- Achieve target accuracy, F1 scores, and domain-specific metrics for SLMs on healthcare tasks (e. g. , >85% F1 for clinical NER, >90% accuracy for classification tasks) Deliver inference latency meeting real-time requirements (target: <100ms p95 latency) while maintaining model quality through optimization techniques 
 - Reduce model size by 50%+ through quantization and compression while retaining 95%+ of original model performance

Technical Innovation

- Successfully implement and deploy 3+ novel fine-tuning or optimization techniques advancing Providence's SLM capabilities within first year 
 - Build production-grade graph-augmented RAG system improving retrieval accuracy by 30%+ over baseline vector-only approaches

Business Impact

- Deploy 2-3 production SLM applications within first 12 months demonstrating measurable clinical workflow improvement or operational efficiency gains 
 - Achieve 20%+ reduction in manual clinical documentation time or 30%+ improvement in security analyst productivity through AI automation 
 - Optimize inference costs achieving 40-60% reduction through model compression, efficient serving, and resource optimization strategies

Collaboration & Knowledge Sharing

- Maintain high stakeholder satisfaction scores (>80%) from clinical and operational partners on model performance and collaboration quality 
 - Deliver technical documentation, training materials, and knowledge-sharing sessions enabling team members to leverage SLM capabilities 
 - Mentor 2-3 junior team members contributing to skill development in fine-tuning techniques, graph learning, or vector retrieval systems

Key Technologies & Tools

This role requires hands-on expertise with the following technology stack: 

Core ML Frameworks & Libraries

PyTorch, Hugging Face (Transformers, PEFT, TRL, Accelerate, Datasets, Tokenizers, Diffusers), TensorFlow/Keras, scikit-learn, XGBoost, LightGBM, BitsAndBytes, Optimum, ONNX Runtime

Fine-Tuning & Optimization

LoRA, QLoRA, AdaLoRA, Prefix Tuning, P-Tuning v2, IA3, Adapters, GPTQ, AWQ, GGUF/GGML, AutoGPTQ, llama. cpp, vLLM, TensorRT-LLM, DeepSpeed, FSDP, Flash Attention, Axolotl, UnslothAI

Graph Technologies

Neo4j, Amazon Neptune, Azure Cosmos DB (Gremlin), PyTorch Geometric, DGL (Deep Graph Library), NetworkX, GraphSAGE, Node2Vec, Graph Attention Networks (GAT), Knowledge Graph Embeddings (TransE, DistMult, ComplEx)

Vector Stores & Embeddings

Pinecone, Weaviate, Qdrant, Milvus, Chroma, FAISS, Annoy, Sentence Transformers, all-MiniLM, BGE Embeddings, E5 Embeddings, Instructor Embeddings, BioBERT, ClinicalBERT, PubMedBERT, SciBERT

RAG & Retrieval Frameworks

LangChain, LlamaIndex, Haystack, RAGAS, TruLens, Cohere Rerank, Cross-Encoders, ColBERT, BM25 (rank-bm25, Elasticsearch), Hybrid Search, Query Expansion, HyDE (Hypothetical Document Embeddings)

Agentic & Orchestration

Cloud & Infrastructure

Azure ML, Azure Databricks, Azure OpenAI Service, Azure Cognitive Services, Azure Data Lake, Azure AKS (Kubernetes), Snowflake, Docker, Kubernetes, Ray, Terraform

MLOps & Experiment Tracking

MLflow, Weights & Biases, Comet. ml, Neptune. ai, DVC (Data Version Control), ClearML, Kubeflow, Airflow, Prefect, Great Expectations, Evidently AI

The Vision

Joveo is on a mission to fundamentally rewrite the rules of the recruitment industry through AI. The New Initiatives AI Labs is our "Special Ops" team-a high-speed, high-stakes environment where we build the future of the company from the ground up. 

This isn't just about writing code; it's about engineering the breakthrough. We are looking for a Software Engineer who thinks like a founder, moves like an operator, and builds like an artist. You'll be the technical engine behind Joveo's most ambitious AI-led growth stories. 

What You'll Do

- Engineer from 0 to 1: Lead the technical birth of greenfield AI products. You'll take an idea from a whiteboard sketch to a production-ready, scalable reality.

 - The Builder's Mindset: You are a "hustler" who thrives in ambiguity. If a tool doesn't exist, you build it. If a process is slow, you automate it.

 - Technical Versatility: Whether it's backend, infrastructure, or integrating the latest LLM, you are a polyglot who picks up the right tool for the job. 

Why Joveo AI Labs

- Unrivaled Visibility: Work directly with the CXOs
 - Pure Innovation: This is a "No Legacy Debt" zone. You get to use the latest tech to solve the hardest problems in HR Tech. 
 - Radical Ownership: We don't micromanage. We give you the mission and the autonomy to execute it. 
 - Steep Growth: You will be at the epicenter of our AI-led transformation, gaining experience that would take a decade elsewhere. 

Your Launchpad

If you're tired of being a cog in a legacy machine and want to be the architect of a new era in AI, this is your moment. 

Build the next chapter of Joveo. Apply now

data.title: Python Backend Developer – Distributed & Event-Driven Systems
data.description:
We are looking for a Python Backend Engineer with hands-on experience in distributed systems and event-driven architecture to design, develop, and maintain scalable backend services and data processing workflows. 

The ideal candidate will have experience building Python-based microservices, implementing event-driven communication using message brokers, handling asynchronous processing, and developing reliable distributed workflows. Strong programming fundamentals and knowledge of API development, concurrency, SQL databases, and fault-tolerant system design are essential. 

The role involves building scalable backend services, processing events asynchronously, managing service-to-service communication, and ensuring the reliability, performance, and resilience of distributed applications. 

Title : Python Backend Engineer

Location : Remote Work

Employment Type: Full-time

Exp Range: 2+ years

Key Responsibilities: 

- Python Backend Development: Design, develop, and maintain backend applications and REST APIs using Python and frameworks such as FastAPI or Flask. 
 - Distributed Systems: Build and maintain distributed backend services, handling service communication, concurrent requests, failures, timeouts, retries, and fault tolerance. 
 - Event-Driven Architecture: Design and implement event-driven workflows using message brokers or event streaming platforms such as Kafka, RabbitMQ, or equivalent technologies. 
 - Messaging & Event Processing: Develop event producers and consumers, process messages asynchronously, and handle message failures, retries, duplicate events, and delivery guarantees. 
 - Microservices Development: Build independent backend services and implement reliable service-to-service communication and integration. 
 - Asynchronous Processing & Task Scheduling: Implement asynchronous operations, background jobs, scheduled tasks, and task queues using asyncio, Celery, or equivalent frameworks. 
 - Data Ingestion & ETL Pipelines: Develop data processing workflows to extract, transform, validate, and load data while maintaining accuracy and reliability. 
 - Database Development: Write and optimize SQL queries, manage database interactions, and integrate backend services with PostgreSQL, AlloyDB, or other SQL databases. 
 - Redis & Caching: Implement caching and efficient data access strategies to reduce database load and improve application performance. 
 - Problem Solving & Debugging: Analyze logs, troubleshoot complex backend issues, identify root causes, and optimize application performance. 
 - Containerization & Cloud Deployment: Use Docker to package backend services and support deployments and troubleshooting in AWS or GCP environments. 
 - Code Quality & Collaboration: Follow clean coding practices, use Git for version control, participate in code reviews, and write maintainable, testable code. 

Mandatory Skills & Qualifications: 

- Python Backend Development: 2+ years of hands-on experience developing backend applications and REST APIs using Python, preferably with FastAPI or Flask. 
 - Distributed Systems: Practical understanding of distributed services, service-to-service communication, fault tolerance, timeouts, retries, and failure handling. 
 - Event-Driven Architecture: Hands-on experience with event-driven workflows, message producers and consumers, and asynchronous messaging. 
 - Message Brokers: Experience with Kafka, RabbitMQ, or equivalent messaging technologies. Familiarity with message delivery guarantees, acknowledgments, retries, and dead-letter queues is preferred.

data.title: Lead Research Engineer - LLM Optimization & Agentic Systems
data.description:
Company: CraftifAI

Work arrangement: Full-time, work from office

Role focus: 70% hands-on research and engineering; 30% technical leadership and ownership

Preferred joining timeline: Candidates who can join in fewer than 45 days are preferred. 

About CraftifAI

CraftifAI is building Orbit, a platform that automates engineering workflows across embedded software, Edge AI, and FPGA development. Our work connects requirements, domain knowledge, code generation, testing, validation, and deployment to help engineering teams build working products. 

We are looking for a research-driven engineer who can strengthen the LLMs and agentic systems behind these workflows, with a particular focus on efficient on-premises deployment and reliable code generation. 

About the Role

You will lead the research and implementation of domain-specific LLM solutions and agentic systems for engineering applications. This includes fine-tuning models, reducing their deployment footprint while preserving measured task quality, designing knowledge architectures, building agent harnesses, and establishing rigorous product benchmarks. 

This is a hands-on technical leadership role. Approximately 70% of your time will involve coding, experiments, model optimization, evaluation, and product integration. The remaining 30% will involve architecture decisions, research direction, mentoring, and ownership of technical outcomes. 

You should be comfortable moving from a research hypothesis to an implementation, measuring its impact, understanding its failures, and improving it until it works reliably within the product. 

What You Will Own

1. LLM Fine-Tuning and Efficient On-Premises Deployment

- Adapt LLMs for engineering tasks, including code generation, tool use, debugging, and reasoning over domain-specific information. 
 - Build data preparation and fine-tuning workflows using suitable approaches such as supervised fine-tuning, LoRA, QLoRA, and preference optimization. 
 - Apply and evaluate compression techniques such as quantization, knowledge distillation, and pruning to reduce model size and memory requirements. 
 - Measure trade-offs between task quality, model footprint, inference latency, throughput, and infrastructure cost on target deployment hardware. 

2. Agentic Systems for Code Generation

- Design and implement agent harnesses for task planning, repository exploration, context management, code generation, tool execution, debugging, and iterative correction. 
 - Build reliable execution flows with clear state management, failure recovery, stopping conditions, and observable results. 
 - Improve the ability of agents to complete engineering tasks across multiple files, dependencies, tools, and execution environments. 
 - Own the integration of these capabilities into CraftifAI's product workflows. 

3. Domain Knowledge and Context Architecture

- Design knowledge systems that connect source code, requirements, architecture documents, hardware documentation, SDKs, APIs, and previous engineering outcomes. 
 - Develop effective retrieval and context construction using approaches such as hybrid search, reranking, structured knowledge, and repository-aware retrieval. 
 - Decide when information belongs in model training, retrieval, structured tools, or persistent agent memory. 
 - Keep retrieved information traceable to its source, version, and applicable hardware or software configuration. 

4. Code Quality and Automated Verification

- Build and integrate static analysis tools, compiler diagnostics, linters, code structure checks, and security checks into agent workflows. 
 - Combine these checks with automated builds, unit tests, and controlled execution to evaluate generated code. 
 - Convert tool findings into actionable feedback that agents can use to diagnose and correct their outputs. 
 - Establish quality gates and regression checks that provide objective evidence of improvement. 

5. Low-Latency System Design

- Profile and optimize the complete workflow, including retrieval, context preparation, model inference, tool calls, and correction cycles. 
 - Improve serving, caching, batching, context efficiency, and execution routing where they produce measurable benefits. 
 - Design for practical on-premises constraints, including available compute, GPU memory, concurrency, and restricted external connectivity. 
 - Optimize time to a verified result alongside model response time. 

6. Reasoning and Learning from Field Use

- Improve agent planning, tool selection, debugging, and recovery through systematic failure analysis and controlled experiments. 
 - Turn field failures and user feedback into curated datasets, evaluation cases, improved knowledge, and better agent behavior. 
 - Evaluate suitable methods for improving reasoning and tool use, including fine-tuning, preference learning, and reinforcement learning where appropriate. 
 - Validate improvements against regression benchmarks before release, within customer data and deployment constraints. 

7. Product Benchmarking and Technical Leadership

- Own reproducible benchmarks at both model and complete product workflow levels. 
 - Measure task completion, functional correctness, static analysis findings, test results, human intervention, latency, memory use, and compute cost. 
 - Use held-out tasks, baseline comparisons, ablation studies, and error analysis to explain which changes improve the product and why. 
 - Define research priorities, lead architecture and code reviews, mentor engineers, and take ownership from experimentation through product integration. 

Required Qualifications and Experience

- Minimum qualification: MS by Research from a Tier-1 institution in India or abroad, in Computer Science, AI/ML, or a closely related field. A PhD is preferred. 
 - Strong practical experience fine-tuning LLMs and deploying them on private or on-premises infrastructure. 
 - Demonstrated experience reducing model size or inference memory requirements, supported by measured quality and performance results. 
 - Deep hands-on experience building agentic systems for code generation, including tool integration, execution feedback, and iterative repair. 
 - Strong understanding of domain knowledge architecture, retrieval systems, context management, and their interaction with model behavior. 
 - Strong Python and software engineering skills, with practical experience using frameworks such as PyTorch, Transformers, PEFT, or equivalent tools. 
 - Experience integrating static analysis, build systems, automated testing, or other programmatic checks into code-generation workflows. 
 - Strong research discipline: clear hypotheses, controlled experiments, reproducible results, and careful interpretation of failures. 
 - Ability to make architecture decisions, communicate technical trade-offs, and personally implement critical parts of the solution. 

Additional Experience We Value

- Research publications or open-source contributions in efficient LLMs, code models, reasoning, agentic systems, or program analysis. 
 - Experience with C/C++, embedded software, compilers, firmware, or hardware-aware code generation. 
 - Experience with model serving, inference profiling, distributed training, or resource-constrained deployments. 
 - Experience turning research prototypes into maintained production capabilities. 

What to Include in Your Application

Please share your CV and relevant publications, repositories, or project examples. Where possible, include: 

- An LLM fine-tuning or compression project with measured quality, memory, and latency results. 
 - An agentic code-generation system you personally built, including its tool integrations and evaluation approach. 
 - A brief explanation of your individual contribution and the most significant technical problem you solved. 
 - Your current notice period and availability to work from the office.

data.description:
Platform Engineer

Role Overview

- The Platform Engineer will be responsible for designing, automating, and operating UIDAI's core application and infrastructure platform to ensure high availability, scalability, and reliability across multiple data centres
 - This role focuses on Service Reliability Engineering (SRE) principles, observability, and infrastructure automation, ensuring that UIDAI systems consistently meet defined SLA/SLO targets
 - The position requires in-depth technical expertise in container orchestration, service mesh, CI/CD, monitoring, and distributed system reliability, combined with strong ownership, operational discipline, and collaborative problem-solving skills

Key Responsibilities

Platform Engineering & Reliability

- Design and maintain scalable, secure, and fault-tolerant infrastructure for UIDAI's core systems deployed across multiple DCs
 - Apply SRE principles - define, measure, and continuously improve SLIs/SLOs/SLAs for all mission-critical services
 - Build self-healing and automated recovery mechanisms for core applications and APIs

Infrastructure Automation & Configuration Management

- Design and manage infrastructure provisioning and configuration using automation frameworks
 - Experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools like Terraform, Ansible, or Chef is desirable

Desirable

- Certifications such as CKA/CKAD, Terraform Associate, AWS/GCP DevOps Engineer, or equivalent

UIDAI Values

- Citizen Centricity

 - Comfort with Ambiguity

data.title: Senior Software Engineer C++ | Low Latency Trading Systems
data.description:
About BestEx Research

BestEx Research is a financial technology and research firm specializing in building sophisticated execution algorithms and transaction cost modeling tools servicing multiple asset classes. The firm provides high-performance algorithmic execution services to hedge funds, CTAs, asset managers, and banks through a traditional electronic broker and in a broker-neutral Software as a Service (SaaS) model. 

Its cloud-based platform, Algo Management System (AMS), is the first end-to-end algorithmic trading solution for equities and futures that delivers an entire ecosystem around execution algorithms, including transaction cost analysis (TCA), an algorithm customization tool called Strategy Studio, a trading dashboard, and pre-trade analytics in a single platform. The platform is currently live for U. S. , Europe, and Canadian equities and global futures trading. 

BestEx Research is disrupting a $100 billion industry by challenging the status quo of stale, black-box solutions from banks and offering next-generation execution algorithms that combine performance improvement with transparency and customization. BestEx Research uses leading-edge technology to support its low-latency, highly scalable research and trading systems, with its backend in C++, research libraries in C++/Python and R, and web-based technologies for delivering its front-end platforms. 

BestEx Research's mission is to become the leader in automation and measurement of execution across asset classes globally and significantly reduce transaction costs for our clients. 

Visit for more information about our mission, products, research, and services. 

Why Join Us?

BestEx Research's Bangalore office is not an "offshore center. " It's a core engineering and research hub, working on the exact same problems and projects as our U. S. team. You will be part of the global brain trust, solving some of the hardest problems in trading, systems, and data science. 

What You'll Love: 

- Zero bureaucracy, zero silos-engineers directly collaborate with traders, researchers, and the management team
 - Direct ownership of subsystems
 - Daily opportunity to learn from pioneers in HFT, low-latency systems, and algo trading
 - A high-trust environment, where performance speaks louder than hierarchy. 
 - Competitive compensation in India, including equity and cash bonuses
 - Ability to transition between various teams and projects, whether related to trading systems, algorithmic trading or system tooling
 - 5-week structured training program: 
 - Market microstructure and trading mechanics
 - Algorithmic execution and strategy design
 - Exchange simulators and performance testing
 - Market data systems and real-time analytics
 - Hands-on exercises using production research data
 - Continuous professional development, with refresher courses, advanced sessions, and on-demand training tailored to your growth
 - Global exposure: Opportunities to collaborate with, visit, or relocate to our U. S. , Singapore, or London offices, based on performance and business needs

Your Role: Build What Most Engineers Never Get to Touch

You'll be part of a lean, focused team building ultra-low-latency trading systems, real-time exchange simulators, execution algorithms, and alpha forecasting models. Our engineers own the stack-from C++ nanosecond-sensitive infrastructure to Python-based research platforms. 

This role is ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of research and engineering-comfortable building systems, testing hypotheses, and working directly with data that moves markets. 

What You'll Work On

Designing and developing system architecture: 

- Core trading systems and algorithmic trading frameworks
 - High-performance execution algorithms for global markets
 - Exchange simulators and tick-level backtesting frameworks
 - Market data adaptors and exchange connectivity adaptors

Building from scratch: 

- Trading systems for new asset classes and execution algorithms
 - Performance optimizations for low-latency, high-throughput systems

Enhancing existing systems: 

- Add support for new features and improve scalability and reliability

Collaborating closely with: 

- A global team of quants, traders, and senior engineers to design cutting-edge solutions

Analyzing and optimizing system performance: 

- Across application, OS, and hardware layers to achieve industry-leading performance
 - Work primarily with C++17 in a high-impact, low-bureaucracy environment

Requirements

You Should Have: 

- Bachelor's or Master's from a top-tier CS or Engineering program (IIT/NIT/BITS preferred but not required)
 - At least 5+ years software development experience with C++
 - Expert-level knowledge of C++ and excellent software design skills
 - Expert-level knowledge of TCP/IP and multithreading
 - Excellent problem solving and analytical skills
 - Excellent communication skills and ability to articulate ideas
 - An attitude of constant curiosity and growth, as well as the ability and desire to mentor others
 - While domain experience is a plus, we welcome strong engineers from other industries

Bonus Points For

- Database optimization and experience with research or market data pipelines
 - Prior work on trading platforms, FIX engines, or exchange protocols
 - Contributions to open-source C++/Python performance tools, ability to work with large datasets
 - Prior experience developing trading systems or execution algorithms
 - Knowledge of relational databases, database optimizations, and SQL
 - Experience with Python/R

data.description:
ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD. 

At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world's most important challenges. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future. 

Whether you're designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or bringing leading edge products to market, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger - technology that moves the world forward. Join us and, together, we'll advance your career. 

PMTS SILICON DESIGN ENGINEER

The Role

As a member of Circuit Technologies (CT) Team, you will architect, develop, and lead the DFT Design and Integration of cutting edge DFT structures including SCAN, ATPG, MBIST, BSCAN. In this role, you will work with the lead SoC/chiplet and IP architects to define future DFx architectures and contribute to product specifications, micro-architecture specifications, performance, and power trade-offs. The role will work from early concept development through the development phases to final production. 

THE PERSON: 

In this role, you will collaborate with a network of expert architects and designers around the world where collaboration and communication skills are critical to the success of this role, and excellent organization skills are essential. You will approach sophisticated problems with a firm methodology and problem-solving technique and conduct experiments and analysis to formulate recommendations and next steps for other colleagues, and SOC/chiplet and IP design teams located in across multiple time zones and geographies. You will formally present your findings to co-workers, teams, and customer engineering teams. 

Key Responsibilities

- Develop next-generation SoC/chiplet and IP debug and observability solutions that enable secure, scalable, and robust silicon bring-up, validation, and post-silicon debug. 
 - Partner with architecture and SoC/chiplet and IP design teams to define and execute a comprehensive Design-for-Excellence (DFX) strategy spanning debug, test, validation, reliability, and manufacturability. 
 - Collaborate with technology, silicon validation, product engineering, and manufacturing teams to establish DFX architectures that support both functional operating modes and manufacturing test requirements. 
 - Drive cross-functional alignment on DFX requirements, use cases, and end-to-end implementation flows across AMD engineering organizations. 
 - Evaluate and deploy AI-driven methodologies to streamline DFX planning, insertion, verification, coverage analysis, and implementation, improving quality, consistency, and scalability while reducing manual effort and time-to-deployment. 
 - Define metrics, methodologies, and automation frameworks to ensure DFX solutions meet product quality, testability, debug, and production readiness objectives across multiple programs and technology generations. 

Preferred Experience

- 10+ years of experience in SoC/chiplet and IP design, DFX architecture, or related silicon development disciplines. 
 - Strong understanding of DFX implementation and integration within complex, large-scale SoC/chiplet architectures. 
 - Deep knowledge of DFT methodologies and infrastructure, including scan, ATPG, MBIST, JTAG 1149. x/boundary scan, and advanced debug and test features. 
 - Solid understanding of SoC clocking, reset, power management, and low-power design architectures. 
 - Strong analytical, organizational, and communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across diverse engineering teams and disciplines. 
 - Demonstrated ability to decompose complex technical problems, evaluate tradeoffs, and develop solutions from both architectural and implementation perspectives. 
 - Experience applying AI and data-driven techniques to improve engineering productivity, including DFX requirement analysis, insertion planning, verification, coverage assessment, validation, and design quality optimization. 
 - Ability to leverage modern AI-assisted engineering workflows and tools to accelerate debug, reduce manual effort, improve consistency, and enable earlier identification of design and DFX risks. 

Academic Credentials

- Bachelors or Masters degree in computer engineering/Electrical Engineering

data.title: Hybrid Powertrain Development Engineer
data.description:
Ref No. : TRAN/26-27/HRD-1004

Dated: 17th October 2026

Job Description (JD)

1. ) Job Title: Senior Application Engineer - Hybrid Mobility & Mechatronics Drive. 

"TRANTRONIX Pvt Ltd" is seeking a motivated and technically proficient Development Engineer to join our Hybrid Powertrain Development in Strategic Project Division(SPD). Pushing the boundaries of high-efficiency traction motors, inverter controllers, and integrated electric drives, the candidate will play a pivotal role in the end-to-end design assistance, development, and vehicle-level integration within our New Product Development (NPD) vertical. This role is ideal for a hands-on professional with strong expertise in high-voltage drive systems, motor control algorithms, power electronics hardware, and hybrid powertrain architecture (HIL Testing). This role is ideal for a mid-level professional who thrives in a "hands-on" NPD and Technical Provisioning environment, integration for the automotive systems & applications. 

2. ) Job Summary: Senior Application Engineer Shall be responsible for the design, development, and system-level integration of Hybrid Powertrain Systems, focusing specifically on EV/HEV Traction Motors (PMSM/SRM) and SR Traction Motor Controllers (SiC/IGBT-based power drives like Asymmetric Half-Bridge MOSFETS Converter). The role encompasses electromagnetic and thermal design evaluation, inverter hardware/software testing, control loop tuning (FOC, Closed loop control like DTC, MPC), analog/digital circuits (Encoder, resolver, Solenoids & Switches). Further integration with, often focusing on system-level functionality, testing. Motor-controller drive calibration, and seamless electromechanical integration into hybrid vehicle architectures. 

  3. ) Position Overview:                                                                                     

- Role:                                               Sr. Application Engineer (Hybrid Mobility & Mechatronics Drive. )
 - Department:                     Strategic Project Division (New Product Development department) 
 - Grade:                                         E03/E04
 - Experience:                         (3~7)Years
 - Location:                                 Gurgaon, NCR
 - Salary Package:         ₹8. 5 - ₹12. 5 LPA (Based on experience and skill set)
 - Joining Timeline:     30~60 Days·              Place of Posting             Capital Business Park, Unit No 1104, 11th Floor, Tower-A, 

                  Sector 48, Sohna Road, Gurgaon, Haryana, India-122018. 

4. ) Key Responsibilities: 

A. Powertrain & Drive System Design & Prototype Development

- System Design & Execution: Lead end-to-end NPD activities for Hybrid Powertrain assemblies, including traction motor sizing, controller selection, and high-voltage (HV) architecture design. 
 - Traction Motor & Inverter Integration: Co-design and validate PMSM/SRM traction motors along with SiC/IGBT-based power drives like Asymmetric Half-Bridge MOSFETS Converter. 
 - BOM & Technical Documentation: Prepare comprehensive Bills of Materials (BOM), Process Flow Diagrams (PFD), Control Plans, and DFMEA/PFMEA for hybrid drive systems. 
 - Drawings & Design Review: Review mechanical CAD models, PCB Schematic design & drawings, busbars, PCB layouts, and 2D blueprints with GD&T for high-speed motor and inverter assemblies. 
 - Prototype Fabrication & Debugging: Oversee functional prototype builds, dyno testing, drive-cycle simulation, and perform root cause analysis on drive/motor operational failures with error rectification / troubleshooting.   

  

B. Supplier Quality Assurance (SQA) & Compliance

- Quality Frameworks: Drive APQP (Advanced Product Quality Planning) and PPAP (Production Part Approval Process) for all new electro-mechanical and electronic components. 
 - Audits & Process Validation: Conduct regular supplier facility audits (process and system audits) to ensure adherence to ISO 9001 / IATF 16949 standards and assess manufacturing capabilities for precision components like encoders, resolvers, and actuators. 
 - Defect Management & Resolution: Lead root cause analysis for any supplier-related quality issues using methodologies like 8D, Fishbone, and 5-Why. Implement and verify Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA). 

C. Drive Testing, Calibration & Vehicle Integration

- Bench & Dyno Validation: Define and execute test protocols on motor dynos for Torque-Speed curves, efficiency mapping, field weakening, thermal rise, and short-circuit response. 
 - Controller Tuning & Calibration: Perform drive tuning using Field-Oriented Control (FOC), Space Vector PWM (SVPWM), position sensor (Resolver/Encoder) calibration, and fault diagnostic routines. 
 - Vehicle System Integration: Validate powertrain integration with ICE/hybrid gearboxes, Vehicle Control Units (VCU), Battery Management Systems (BMS), and vehicle CAN/CAN-FD communication networks. 
 - HIL & Environmental Testing: Oversee Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) testing, vibration, thermal shock, ingress protection (IP67/IP6K9K), and EMI/EMC compliance testing. 

5. ) Qualification Requirements: 

- Education & Qualification: B. Tech/B. E. in Electrical & Electronics / Electronics & Instrumentation / Mechatronics. 
 - M. E. / M. Tech in Power Electronics, Drives, Electrical Machines, or Hybrid Electric Vehicle Technology is an added advantage

6. ) Technical Skills: 

- Traction Motors & Drives: In-depth understanding of PMSM,   SRM motor topologies, winding designs (hairpin/distributed), magnetic circuits, and high-voltage inverter architectures. 
 - Power Electronics & Control: Deep technical knowledge of SiC/IGBT power modules, gate driver circuits, field-oriented control (FOC), Asymmetric Half-Bridge MOSFETS Converter and resolver-to-digital conversion. 
 - Simulation & Development Tools: Hands-on experience with ANSYS Maxwell / Motor-CAD, MATLAB / Simulink, PSpice/LTspice, and FEA tools. 
 - Testing & Calibration Tools: Proficiency in dynamometer testing, power analysers, oscilloscopes, CANoe/CANalyzer, and HIL test systems. 
 - Quality Core Tools: DFMEA, PFMEA, SPC etc shall be an advantage 
 - Standards & Protocols: Familiarity with ISO 26262 (Functional Safety), Automotive SPICE, IATF 16949, ISO 9001: 2025, and CAN / CAN-FD / LIN communication protocols. 

7. ) Soft Skills: 

- Problem-Solving: Strong analytical mindset with a proven track record of resolving complex technical and quality bottlenecks. 
 - Agility & Collaboration: Ability to work in a fast-paced environment with a 30-day turnaround for project milestones with effective communication skills to coordinate between the Mechanical and Power Electronics teams. 

8. ) Perks & Benefits: 

·            5 days Working

·            PF

·            24 PL

·            Medical Benefits

·            Annual Bonus (Fixed + Performance)

data.title: Software Engineering Architect
data.description:
Description

About Us

Trintech, a leading global provider of cloud-based, integrated reconciliation and financial close solutions for Finance & Accounting departments, helps organizations automate and manage high-volume transaction matching, balance sheet reconciliations, intercompany accounting, journal entries, close management tasks, governance, risk, and compliance. Trintech's portfolio includes the Cadency Platform for large enterprises and the Adra Suite for mid-market organizations. Over 4, 200 clients worldwide, including the majority of the Fortune 100, rely on Trintech's solutions to optimize data, control risk, drive efficiencies, and provide strategic insights. 

Position Summary

The Architect, Software Engineering is a senior technical individual contributor responsible for defining, guiding, and governing software architecture for mission-critical enterprise SaaS products. This role partners with engineering, product, security, DevOps, QA, and architecture stakeholders to design scalable, secure, reliable, and maintainable solutions across Java, . NET, web, API, data, and cloud technologies. The architect will also promote AI-native software engineering practices, including responsible use of LLMs and AI-assisted development tools to improve design quality, developer productivity, code review, testing, documentation, and modernization efforts. 

Key Responsibilities

Architecture Strategy and Governance

- Define and evolve solution architecture for enterprise SaaS applications, including cloud-hosted and hybrid deployment models. 
 - Provide architectural direction for product areas, ensuring alignment with enterprise architecture principles, security standards, scalability needs, and long-term product strategy. 
 - Contribute to Architecture Review Board activities and help establish practical architecture standards, patterns, and guardrails. 
 - Make or recommend key technical decisions, including technology selection, integration patterns, modernization approach, and build-versus-buy options. 

Solution Design and Technical Leadership

- Architect end-to-end solutions using technologies such as Java/J2EE, . NET, REST and SOAP APIs, Angular or React, microservices, relational databases, messaging, caching, and cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud. 
 - Review technical designs and critical implementation approaches to ensure they are secure, scalable, maintainable, testable, and aligned with the approved architecture. 
 - Guide engineering teams on complex design problems, performance bottlenecks, reliability risks, integration challenges, and production-critical issues. 
 - Provide hands-on technical leadership through prototypes, proof-of-concepts, design reviews, code reviews for critical areas, and architecture documentation. 

Engineering Excellence and Modernization

- Drive best practices for modular architecture, API design, secure coding, automated testing, CI/CD, observability, performance engineering, and operational readiness. 
 - Partner with DevOps and engineering teams to support automated build, test, deployment, and release practices for enterprise SaaS products. 
 - Identify and guide modernization opportunities across legacy components, platform capabilities, frameworks, databases, and deployment architecture. 
 - Ensure architecture supports performance, scalability, reliability, localization, maintainability, and customer-specific enterprise requirements. 

AI-Native Software Engineering

- Promote responsible use of Agentic software development and testing frameworks like OpenAI Codex, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot and similar tools within secure development practices. 
 - Use Agentic Development Tools where appropriate to accelerate architecture research, design alternatives, code generation support, test case ideation, documentation, troubleshooting, and developer productivity. 
 - Provide guidance on safe and compliant AI usage, including protection of confidential information, validation of AI-generated outputs, security review, and code quality expectations. 
 - Stay current with emerging AI agent tools and Agentic software engineering practices and assess where they can improve product engineering outcomes. 

Collaboration and Influence

- Collaborate with product managers, engineering managers, senior engineers, QA, DevOps, security, and support teams to translate business needs into effective technical solutions. 
 - Influence technical direction across teams without relying on direct reporting authority. 
 - Communicate complex technical concepts clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Mentor senior engineers and technical leads to improve architecture maturity and engineering capability across the organization. 

Qualifications And Experience

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related discipline; advanced degree preferred. 
 - 12+ years of hands-on software engineering experience building mission-critical, high-performance, web-based enterprise applications, including at least 3 years in an architect or principal engineer role. 
 - Strong object-oriented design, coding, troubleshooting, and debugging skills. 
 - Deep understanding of multi-tier web application architecture, distributed systems, SaaS, PaaS, cloud-native architecture, and high-scale enterprise application design. 
 - Proficiency with Java/J2EE technologies such as Servlets, JSP, JMS, Spring, Hibernate, SOA, and web services. 
 - Experience with . NET technologies and ability to operate in a multi-technology product environment. 
 - Experience with middleware technologies such as messaging, caching, service orchestration, API gateways, and integration frameworks. 
 - Solid understanding of relational database concepts and hands-on experience with SQL Server, Oracle, or similar enterprise databases. 
 - Experience with application servers such as JBoss or Tomcat. 
 - Experience with REST, SOAP, API security, SSL, web services security, authentication, authorization, and secure integration patterns. 
 - Hands-on experience with private, hybrid, or public cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud. 
 - Experience working in Agile environments and collaborating with globally distributed engineering teams. 
 - Developer or architect certification is preferred. 

Preferred Skills

- Experience architecting financial, accounting, reconciliation, compliance, or other enterprise workflow platforms. 
 - Experience with performance engineering, scalability testing, reliability testing, and production incident analysis. 
 - Familiarity with AI-assisted software development workflows and ability to guide teams in responsible adoption of LLM-based tools. 
 - Experience with modernization of mature enterprise products, including decomposition of monoliths, service extraction, cloud migration, or platform refactoring. 

Cultural Fit

- Highly motivated, thoughtful technical leader and self-starter with excellent written and verbal communication skills. 
 - Business-focused technologist who balances customer outcomes, product strategy, engineering quality, and delivery realities. 
 - Ability to influence without direct authority and guide teams through complex technical trade-offs. 
 - Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities. 
 - Collaborative, detail-oriented, and committed to continuous improvement. 
 - Demonstrates Trintech values: Humble, Empowered, Reliable, and Open. 

At our core, Trintechers stand committed to fostering a culture rooted in our core values - Humble, Empowered, Reliable, and Open. Together, these values guide our actions, define our identity, and inspire us to continuously strive for excellence in everything we do. 

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin or disability.

data.title: Product Engineer
data.description:
Experience: 3. 00 + years

Salary: INR 4500000-6000000 / year (based on experience)

Expected Notice Period: 15 Days

Shift: (GMT+05: 30) Asia/Kolkata (IST)

Opportunity Type: Office ()

Placement Type: Full Time Permanent position(Payroll and Compliance to be managed by: Astra)

(*Note: This is a requirement for one of Uplers' client - Astra)

What do you need for this opportunity?

Must have skills required: 

LLM, Typescript/React, Node Js, Node/react, Websockets, AI Agents, Tool calling

Astra is Looking for: 

Supa Health is building the agentic operating system that makes this work disappear - an AI scribe, an AI receptionist, and an agentic back office that handles benefits verification, prior auth, intake, and claims. Every call its agents make, every denial they work, every payer quirk they encounter feeds back into a system that gets sharper the next time. We''re building software that compounds. 

We''re not selling dashboards. We''re replacing the work itself. 

Small team, $5M from Peak XV (formerly Sequoia India), shipping fast. Looking for our founding product engineer. 

What You''ll Work On

The honest answer is: whatever moves the product furthest. We have surface area in every direction and we''d rather you pick the one that fits you than wedge you into a slot. 

That could mean: 

Operator-facing surfaces. Real-time, dense, information-rich SPAs where our back-office team works through hundreds of cases a day. The interaction model matters as much as the engineering - operators live in these tools eight hours a day, and small wins compound into hours saved. Modern React stack, TypeScript end-to-end, real-time over WebSockets. 

The agent platform. The systems that let our agents do real work in the world - making calls, navigating systems built before APIs existed, parsing structured and unstructured payer responses, and writing back into our own state. Worklfows for orchestration, Postgres as the source of truth, LLMs invoked deliberately rather than reflexively. 

The platform underneath both. Schema, services, auth, multi-tenancy, integrations, and the HIPAA-grade segregation that has to be right on day one. Postgres, Drizzle, Fastify, an Nx monorepo, WorkOS for auth. 

The next product wedge. We have a roadmap. We also have customers asking for things that aren''t on it. Founding engineers at Supa Health get to argue for what we should build next, and then build it. 

You''ll talk to operators. You''ll talk to clinic owners. You''ll watch someone do their job for two hours and then go automate the painful parts of it. You''ll ship something on Tuesday and see it running in production on Wednesday. 

What We Look For

Craft. You''ve shipped real software to real users for years and it shows in how you think. You have opinions about schema design, about when to reach for a state machine, about what makes a UI feel fast. You can tell the difference between extra effort and meaningful quality, and you reach for the second one. Your code reviews make the people around you better - not because you''re harsh, but because you''re specific, and the team''s standards rise around you. 

Judgment. Healthcare is full of edge cases that look like bugs and bugs that look like edge cases. The CTO can''t be in every decision and we don''t want to use process as a substitute for thinking. We want people who can reason through a tradeoff with incomplete information and make the call. 

Ownership. You don''t wait for work to be handed to you. You see what''s broken, what''s slow, what''s missing - and you write the doc, file the issue, or open the PR. You take a problem from "I noticed this" to "it''s deployed and working, " which means talking to the user, designing the solution, writing the code, watching it land, and going back to fix what you got wrong. 

Direction. You work with users and teammates to figure out what to build and how to build it. You sit with operators, watch where they get stuck, and come back with a sharper definition of the problem than we started with. You''re a thought partner to the team - not someone waiting for a spec, and not someone going off to build in a vacuum. 

Speed. Not crashed-out hustle-culture speed. The kind of speed that comes from deleting unnecessary work, making decisions quickly, and not being precious about being wrong. 

Range. You don''t need to be a 10/10 at frontend, backend, infra, AI, and product. You do need to be willing to learn whichever of those the work demands this week. 

Must Have: 

3+ years building production software. We care less about the years and more about the slope - what you''ve shipped, what you learned the hard way, and what you''d do differently now. You''ve lived in TypeScript and Postgres long enough to have real opinions about both. 

Good to Have: 

Agentic AI / LLM systems. You''ve built something with agents, tools, evals, and the unglamorous plumbing around them. You know when an LLM is the right answer and when it''s a fancy way to make a slow, wrong API call. 

Early-stage startup experience. You know what it feels like to have no design system, no playbook, no PM, and a customer call in 90 minutes. 

Healthcare / RCM background. You know what a 271 is. You''ve fought with a clearinghouse. You have feelings about Availity. This is rare and we''d love to find it, but we''ll happily teach the right person. 

How We Hire

We borrowed our process from Linear because we think they got it right. 

Intro call with the CTO. ~30 minutes. We talk about you, the company, and whether the role fits. We''ll discuss comp on this call. 

Technical conversation. ~60 minutes. We work through a real problem together. No leetcode. 

Paid work trial. 2-5 days, paid at our standard daily rate. You work on something real. You meet the team. You leave with a much clearer picture of whether Supa Health is the right place for you, and we leave with a much clearer picture of whether you''re the right person for Supa Health. 

Decision. Independent feedback from the trial team, then a debrief, then an offer (or honest feedback if not). 

Who This Isn''t For

We''d rather be honest now than waste your time later. 

If you need a roadmap handed to you, you''ll be uncomfortable here. The roadmap is a conversation, and you''re in it. 

If you want a 9-to-5, that''s a legitimate and healthy choice, and it isn''t this job. We don''t expect crunch, but we expect founding-team intensity. 

If you''d rather not talk to users. Operators and clinic owners are part of your job, not someone else''s. 

Interview Process: 

L1- Introduction with the CTO

L2- Technical Conversation

L3- Paid Work Trial

L4- Decision

How to apply for this opportunity?

- Step 1: Click On Apply! And Register or Login on our portal. 
 - Step 2: Complete the Screening Form & Upload updated Resume
 - Step 3: Increase your chances to get shortlisted & meet the client for the Interview!

About Uplers: 

Our goal is to make hiring reliable, simple, and fast. Our role will be to help all our talents find and apply for relevant contractual onsite opportunities and progress in their career. We will support any grievances or challenges you may face during the engagement. 

(Note: There are many more opportunities apart from this on the portal. Depending on the assessments you clear, you can apply for them as well). 

So, if you are ready for a new challenge, a great work environment, and an opportunity to take your career to the next level, don't hesitate to apply today. We are waiting for you!
