data.description:
About This Role

In this hourly, remote contractor role, you will work as a Tamil Quality Assurance Lead (QAL) to oversee quality, consistency, and trainer performance across Tamil AI training projects. You will review AI-generated Tamil content and trainer/QA work, evaluate output quality against project guidelines, provide precise written feedback, and ensure that all contributors follow the expected quality standards. 

You will assess work for accuracy, fluency, grammar, spelling, tone, cultural appropriateness, meaning preservation, instruction-following, formatting, and adherence to project-specific rubrics. You will spot recurring quality issues, communicate updates to trainers and QAs, support onboarding, maintain documentation, and help activate contributors who are not working consistently. This role requires strong Tamil and English skills, excellent attention to detail, structured communication, and the ability to manage quality workflows across remote teams. 

This role is with SME Careers, a fast-growing AI Data Services company and subsidiary of SuperAnnotate, delivering training data for many of the world's largest AI companies and foundation-model labs. Your Tamil quality leadership will directly help improve the world's premier AI models by ensuring that Tamil training data is natural, accurate, culturally appropriate, well-documented, and aligned with client expectations. 

Selection process involves an AI interview, a domain-specific task, and an interview with a recruiter. 

Your profile

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Tamil, Linguistics, Translation, Communications, Journalism, English, Education, Quality Assurance, or a relevant domain/related field. 
 - Native or near-native Tamil proficiency with strong reading and writing skills. 
 - Strong grasp of the English language to follow project guidelines, communicate with teams, and provide clear feedback in English. 
 - 3+ years of professional experience in Tamil writing, editing, translation, localization, content QA, AI training, education, annotation, or related language-review workflows. 
 - Strong understanding of Tamil grammar, spelling conventions, punctuation, tone, register, regional variation, and cultural context. 
 - Ability to evaluate Tamil content against detailed rubrics and identify issues such as mistranslation, literal phrasing, unnatural tone, hallucinated claims, ambiguity, or inconsistent terminology. 
 - Experience leading or supporting remote teams of trainers, annotators, reviewers, editors, or QAs is strongly preferred. 
 - Comfortable working in fast-moving remote environments using tools such as Discord, Google Sheets, Google Docs, trackers, dashboards, and project management systems. 
 - Highly detail-oriented and organized, with the ability to maintain style guides, FAQs, trackers, onboarding materials, honeypots, and other quality documentation. 
 - Experience with AI training, data annotation, large language models, prompt/response evaluation, or rubric-based LLM QA is a strong plus. 

Key responsibilities

- Quality monitoring: Spot-check Tamil items, identify quality issues, provide ongoing feedback through DMs, and escalate recurring or critical issues. 
 - Trainer and QA communication: Update trainers and QAs on Discord about new item guidelines, project changes, workflow updates, and quality expectations. 
 - Question handling: Respond to trainer/QA questions clearly and promptly, especially around Tamil wording, register, translation fidelity, cultural context, regional variation, and edge cases. 
 - Trainer/QA activation management: DM contributors who are inactive or not working, encourage activation, track follow-ups, and flag availability issues when needed. 
 - Documentation: Create and maintain Tamil project documentation, including style guides, trackers, FAQs, quality notes, examples, honeypots, and onboarding materials. 
 - Onboarding and training: Schedule and run onboarding/training calls with trainers and QAs to explain project expectations, workflows, rubrics, quality standards, and Tamil-specific style requirements. 
 - Quality alignment: Ensure all trainers and QAs apply Tamil language guidelines consistently and understand updates as projects evolve. 
 - Process improvement: Identify recurring quality gaps, propose workflow improvements, and help build scalable QA processes for Tamil-language projects.

data.title: Odia (Oriya) Team Lead (Remote)
data.description:
About This Role

Interview language: English

In this hourly, remote contractor role, you will work as an Odia (Oriya) Quality Assurance Lead (QAL) to oversee quality, consistency, and trainer performance across Odia AI training projects. You will review AI-generated Odia content and trainer/QA work, evaluate output quality against project guidelines, provide precise written feedback, and help ensure that all contributors follow the expected standards. 

You will assess work for accuracy, fluency, grammar, spelling, tone, cultural appropriateness, meaning preservation, instruction-following, formatting, and adherence to project-specific rubrics. You will spot recurring quality issues, communicate updates to trainers and QAs, support onboarding, maintain documentation, and help activate contributors who are not working consistently. This role requires strong Odia and English skills, excellent attention to detail, structured communication, and the ability to manage quality workflows across remote teams. 

This role is with SME Careers, a fast-growing AI Data Services company and subsidiary of SuperAnnotate, delivering training data for many of the world's largest AI companies and foundation-model labs. Your Odia quality leadership will directly help improve the world's premier AI models by ensuring that Odia training data is natural, accurate, culturally appropriate, well-documented, and aligned with client expectations. 

Selection process involves an AI interview, a domain-specific task, and an interview with a recruiter. 

Your profile

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Odia, Linguistics, Translation, Communications, Journalism, English, Education, Quality Assurance, or a relevant domain/related field. 
 - Native or near-native Odia proficiency with strong reading and writing skills. 
 - Strong grasp of the English language to follow project guidelines, communicate with teams, and provide clear feedback in English. 
 - 3+ years of professional experience in Odia writing, editing, translation, localization, content QA, AI training, education, annotation, or related language-review workflows. 
 - Strong understanding of Odia grammar, spelling conventions, punctuation, tone, register, and cultural context. 
 - Ability to evaluate Odia content against detailed rubrics and identify issues such as mistranslation, literal phrasing, unnatural tone, hallucinated claims, ambiguity, or inconsistent terminology. 
 - Experience leading or supporting remote teams of trainers, annotators, reviewers, editors, or QAs is strongly preferred. 
 - Comfortable working in fast-moving remote environments using tools such as Discord, Google Sheets, Google Docs, trackers, dashboards, and project management systems. 
 - Highly detail-oriented and organized, with the ability to maintain style guides, FAQs, trackers, onboarding materials, honeypots, and other quality documentation. 
 - Experience with AI training, data annotation, large language models, prompt/response evaluation, or rubric-based LLM QA is a strong plus. 

Key responsibilities

- Task Description: Review and quality-check existing translations of English science benchmark questions (ARC) in your target language. For each item, you'll compare the original translation and an AI-proposed correction against the English source, focusing strictly on accuracy and faithfulness rather than stylistic improvement . 
 - You'll review the question and answer choices only , select the appropriate outcome (accept the original, accept the AI correction, edit the final translation, or escalate), and provide a brief review comment. The goal is to preserve the source exactly - including its meaning, difficulty, answer structure, scientific terminology, and protected elements - while following the provided core and language-specific guidelines.

data.title: Malayalam Linguistic QA Specialist (Remote)
data.description:
About This Role

In this hourly, remote contractor role, you will work as a Malayalam Quality Assurance Lead (QAL) to oversee quality, consistency, and trainer performance across Malayalam AI training projects. You will review AI-generated Malayalam content and trainer/QA work, evaluate output quality against project guidelines, provide precise written feedback, and ensure that all contributors follow the expected quality standards. 

You will assess work for accuracy, fluency, grammar, spelling, tone, cultural appropriateness, meaning preservation, instruction-following, formatting, and adherence to project-specific rubrics. You will spot recurring quality issues, communicate updates to trainers and QAs, support onboarding, maintain documentation, and help activate contributors who are not working consistently. This role requires strong Malayalam and English skills, excellent attention to detail, structured communication, and the ability to manage quality workflows across remote teams. 

This role is with SME Careers, a fast-growing AI Data Services company and subsidiary of SuperAnnotate, delivering training data for many of the world's largest AI companies and foundation-model labs. Your Malayalam quality leadership will directly help improve the world's premier AI models by ensuring that Malayalam training data is natural, accurate, culturally appropriate, well-documented, and aligned with client expectations. 

Selection process involves an AI interview, a domain-specific task, and an interview with a recruiter. 

Your profile

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Malayalam, Linguistics, Translation, Communications, Journalism, English, Education, Quality Assurance, or a relevant domain/related field. 
 - Native or near-native Malayalam proficiency with strong reading and writing skills. 
 - Strong grasp of the English language to follow project guidelines, communicate with teams, and provide clear feedback in English. 
 - 3+ years of professional experience in Malayalam writing, editing, translation, localization, content QA, AI training, education, annotation, or related language-review workflows. 
 - Strong understanding of Malayalam grammar, spelling conventions, punctuation, tone, register, regional variation, and cultural context. 
 - Ability to evaluate Malayalam content against detailed rubrics and identify issues such as mistranslation, literal phrasing, unnatural tone, hallucinated claims, ambiguity, or inconsistent terminology. 
 - Experience leading or supporting remote teams of trainers, annotators, reviewers, editors, or QAs is strongly preferred. 
 - Comfortable working in fast-moving remote environments using tools such as Discord, Google Sheets, Google Docs, trackers, dashboards, and project management systems. 
 - Highly detail-oriented and organized, with the ability to maintain style guides, FAQs, trackers, onboarding materials, honeypots, and other quality documentation. 
 - Experience with AI training, data annotation, large language models, prompt/response evaluation, or rubric-based LLM QA is a strong plus. 

Key responsibilities

- Quality monitoring: Spot-check Malayalam items, identify quality issues, provide ongoing feedback through DMs, and escalate recurring or critical issues. 
 - Trainer and QA communication: Update trainers and QAs on Discord about new item guidelines, project changes, workflow updates, and quality expectations. 
 - Question handling: Respond to trainer/QA questions clearly and promptly, especially around Malayalam wording, register, translation fidelity, cultural context, Kerala usage, diaspora usage, and edge cases. 
 - Trainer/QA activation management: DM contributors who are inactive or not working, encourage activation, track follow-ups, and flag availability issues when needed. 
 - Documentation: Create and maintain Malayalam project documentation, including style guides, trackers, FAQs, quality notes, examples, honeypots, and onboarding materials. 
 - Onboarding and training: Schedule and run onboarding/training calls with trainers and QAs to explain project expectations, workflows, rubrics, quality standards, and Malayalam-specific style requirements. 
 - Quality alignment: Ensure all trainers and QAs apply Malayalam language guidelines consistently and understand updates as projects evolve. 
 - Process improvement: Identify recurring quality gaps, propose workflow improvements, and help build scalable QA processes for Malayalam-language projects.

data.title: HR Systems Assurance Specialist
data.description:
HR Systems Assurance SpecialistSAP Payroll and SuccessFactorsChennai | India

We are seeking an HR Systems Assurance Specialist to provide independent assurance that HR data, payroll and time are accurate, compliant and appropriately controlled across SAP ECC Payroll and SuccessFactors. The role involves independently extracting and reconciling data across systems, investigating discrepancies, testing controls and clearly reporting findings. This is an assurance and reporting role; it does not involve building or configuring the systems. 

Key Responsibilities

Perform recurring data quality checks across SuccessFactors Employee Central and SAP ECC Payroll to assess completeness, accuracy, validity and consistency of HR master data. 

Reconcile payroll results across periods, including headcount, gross pay, deductions, general ledger (GL) and bank postings, and check compliance with statutory and company policy requirements. 

Verify that SuccessFactors Time Tracking data aligns with rosters and time rules and flows correctly into SAP ECC Payroll wage types. 

Monitor Employee Central to ECC replication and investigate errors, missing records and data mismatches. 

Design, perform and document control tests, maintaining clear, audit-ready evidence and supporting audit trails. 

Log findings, follow up with control and process owners on remediation, and report recurring issues and trends. 

Explain findings and potential impacts clearly to HR Technology, payroll teams and HR business stakeholders. 

Key Competencies & Skills

Strong hands-on reporting skills in SAP ECC HCM/Payroll and SuccessFactors, including Story reports and Table reports. 

Good understanding of SAP HCM and SuccessFactors data models, including Employee Central, Time Tracking and the payroll cluster. 

Working knowledge of payroll processes, including gross-to-net calculations, retroactive and off-cycle payroll, and payroll reconciliation. 

Understanding of time management processes, including rosters, overtime, shift and night allowances, public holidays and absence accruals. 

Advanced Excel skills, including Power Query, PivotTables and XLOOKUP; working knowledge of SQL. 

Ability to use Power BI for reporting is preferred; Python or similar scripting experience for automating checks is an advantage. 

Understanding of control design and testing, maker-checker controls, segregation of duties, audit trails and data privacy. 

Strong analytical thinking, professional scepticism, clear written communication and accurate documentation. 

TECHNICAL KNOWLEDGE

SAP ECC HCM / Payroll

Knowledge of key info types: 0000/0001, 0007, 0008, 0014/0015, 2001/2002 and 2010. 

Understanding of payroll cluster PCL2, including RT, CRT and WPBP, and how retroactive calculations appear. 

Experience with or understanding of Wage Type Reporter (PC00_M99_CWTR), payroll journal, PC_PAYRESULT, Ad Hoc Query, SQVI and SE16N. 

Ability to read a payroll schema or PCR and explain a result; configuration or development is not required. 

SuccessFactors Employee Central

Understanding of corporate, succession and country-specific data models, MDF objects, picklists and effective-dated records. 

Experience creating or using Story reports (People Analytics) and Table reports. 

Ability to use the Data Replication Monitor to investigate Employee Central to ECC replication issues. 

SuccessFactors Time Tracking

Understanding of time profiles, time types, time recording profiles, work schedules and holiday calendars. 

Knowledge of time valuation and time collectors, including how approved timesheets flow into ECC Payroll wage types. 

Payroll, Data and Assurance

Understanding of gross-to-net payroll, retroactive and off-cycle runs, and statutory deductions. 

Ability to reconcile headcount, gross pay, GL postings and bank postings period on period. 

Ability to assess roster patterns such as 4x4, 7x7, 14x14 and FIFO, including overtime, shift and night allowances, public holidays and absence accruals. 

Understanding of data quality dimensions: completeness, accuracy, validity, timeliness and consistency. 

Knowledge of GDPR and India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023, and the importance of protecting employee data. 

Experience & Education Requirements

6-10 years of total professional experience, including at least 4 years of hands-on experience with SAP HCM/Payroll and SuccessFactors data. 

Experience working with multicultural, multi-country teams. 

A degree in Commerce, Information Technology, Engineering or a related discipline. 

Payroll and Time Management experience is an advantage. 

Strong written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to explain findings to payroll and HR managers without unnecessary technical jargon. 

Self-motivated, analytical and process-oriented, with a collaborative approach to issue resolution and documentation. 

Additional / Preferred Skills

SAP certifications in SuccessFactors Employee Central, SuccessFactors Time Tracking or SAP HCM Payroll. 

Exposure to Employee Central Payroll. 

Interest or experience in automated or AI-assisted assurance checks. 

PRACTICAL SCREENING EXERCISE

As part of the selection process, candidates may be given an anonymised Employee Central extract, timesheet extract and payroll wage-type extract. In approximately 45 minutes, candidates will be asked to: 

Identify employees with approved time but no matching wage type in payroll. 

Identify Employee Central pay changes that have not replicated to ECC. 

Flag overtime that exceeds roster rules. 

Name the control that could have prevented each issue. 

LOCATION & WORKING HOURS

Location: Chennai, India. 

Flexible working hours to overlap with operating sites in the Americas, Africa and Australia. India Standard Time is approximately 8. 5-10. 5 hours ahead of the Americas, depending on location and daylight-saving time. 

Who We Are

Glencore is one of the world's largest global diversified natural resource companies and a major producer and marketer of more than 60 commodities. Through a network of assets, customers and suppliers that spans the globe, we produce, process, recycle, source, market and distribute the commodities that advance everyday life. 

With over 140, 000 employees and contractors and a strong footprint in over 30 countries in both established and emerging regions for natural resources, our marketing and industrial activities are supported by a global network of offices. 

Glencore's customers are principally industrial consumers, such as those in the automotive, steel, power generation, battery manufacturing and oil sectors. We also provide financing, logistics and other services to producers and consumers of commodities.

Job Details

Force. com (Sales, Service, Community, IoT, Einstein Clouds), Marketing Cloud, Commerce, and Health Cloud), and developing solutions cross-cloud is becoming more critical. 

Responsibilities

- Working closely with Delivery Managers, Functional Solution Architects, and if required directly with clients to devise technology solutions to meet client needs and ensure the software product is used accurately and the go-forward solution is easy to maintain and meets standard processes.  - Experience in Salesforce (SFDC) CRM with end-to-end implementation experience.

 - Knowledge in LWC. 
 - Strong practical deployment knowledge of VisualForce, Flex, Salesforce configurations, Apex classes, APEX Web services, API, AppExchange deployment, and Salesforce. com controls. 
 - Ability to define the system landscape, identify gaps between current and desired end-states, and deliver a CRM solution. 
 - Additional Salesforce. com experience includes Workflow Alerts and Actions, and Approval Workflow. 
 - Experience leading teams in the analysis of complex problems, and the design and implementation of related solutions. 
 - Diligent with the ability to learn quickly to demonstrate new concepts, technologies, and solutions.

Unleash Your Potential

data.description:
Who We Are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected OperationsTM Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing - and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale. 

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term. 

About the role: 

Samsara Technologies India Private Limited is looking for a Staff Engineer to join the Platform & Infrastructure organization, which is responsible for building foundational systems that drive software products. Examples include areas such as Reporting/Automations/Enterprise capabilities to support our rapidly growing footprint of customers and foundational infrastructure capabilities such as container orchestration/data storage/real-time data ingestion/GraphQL execution to power Samsara engineering. 

As a Staff Engineer at Samsara, you will help us spearhead the technical direction for the organization, be a technical leader that brings fresh ideas and expertise to guide the team's technical design and architecture and enable increasingly complex features and customer use cases. You will work on specific projects critical to Samsara's needs alongside other highly-skilled Samsara engineers and push Samsara's technical capabilities forward. 

This role is hybrid - 3 days per week in the office. 

Office address: PRESTIGE TECH PARK, Kadubeesanahalli, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560103, India

You should apply if: 

- You want to impact the industries that run our world: The software, firmware, and hardware you build will result in real-world impact-helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely. 
 - You are a life-long learner: We have ambitious goals. Every Samsarian has a growth mindset as we work with a wide range of technologies, challenges, and customers that push us to learn on the go. 
 - You believe customers are more than a number: Samsara engineers enjoy a rare closeness to the end user and you will have the opportunity to participate in customer interviews, collaborate with customer success and product managers, and use metrics to ensure our work is translating into better customer outcomes. 
 - You are a team player: Working on our Samsara Engineering teams requires a mix of independent effort and collaboration. Motivated by our mission, we're all racing toward our connected operations vision, and we intend to win-together. 

In this role, you will: 

- Drive technology choices, implementing services, and/or establishing architectural patterns that have a broad and lasting impact on Samsara's platform
 - Identify opportunities and initiate strategic conversations to influence the direction of platform technology and engineering culture
 - Architect, design, and develop software that enables Samsara to operate at scale
 - Lead teams in delivering products and capabilities that contribute to Samsara's products and revenue
 - Deliver impact by solving the hardest technical problems and enabling products to reach the market quickly and successfully with high quality
 - Keep a platform-first approach while collaborating with our infrastructure and product teams to build products, tools, and solutions. 
 - Act as a multiplier for the team, elevating the impact and output of every team member
 - Contribute to Samsara's engineering brand by representing Samsara in external-facing forums
 - Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

Minimum requirements for the role: 

- Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science/Engineering or equivalent practical experience
 - 12+ years of experience in software design, development, and algorithm-related solutions with at least 4 of those years in an architect or leadership role
 - Stellar programming/coding fundamentals
 - 4+ years of experience building large-scale distributed systems
 - 4+ years of experience leading cross-organization projects
 - Expertise working with web services at a massive scale deployed on Cloud providers such as AWS, GCP or Azure

An ideal candidate also: 

- Has 15+ years of relevant industry experience in software development
 - Enjoys leading and mentoring engineers to think about systems - their life cycles, edge cases, and failure modes
 - Enjoys fostering collaboration among engineers with different focuses (frontend, mobile, firmware, vision, ML)
 - Is an expert in writing high-quality, performant, and maintainable code in a modern programming language
 - Production experience working with Javascript and/or client-side code
 - Expertise working on large-scale enterprise software applications
 - Demonstrated ability to ship production-quality software in a dynamic environment
 - Expert-level knowledge of at-scale stream-processing decision engines

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time. 

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here. 

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable. 

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact. 

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email accessibleinterviewing@samsara. com or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process. 

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara's Candidate Privacy Notice for more information. 

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara. com, @us-greenhouse-mail. io or @mail3. guide. co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

This is a place for builders with a growth mindset who act with agility, embrace change, and use modern technology to shape smarter solutions, exceptional experiences, and the future of our industry for our clients, customers, and our culture. 

Why We Do What We Do

In the U. S. , consumers, payers, and providers face significant challenges throughout the healthcare financial journey. Zelis helps streamline the process by offering solutions that improve transparency, efficiency, and communication among all parties involved. By addressing the obstacles that patients face in accessing care, navigating the intricacies of insurance claims, and the logistical challenges healthcare providers encounter with processing payments, Zelis aims to create a more seamless and effective healthcare financial system. 

Zelis India plays a crucial role in this mission by supporting various initiatives that enhance the healthcare financial experience. Beyond operational expertise, Zelis India cultivates a collaborative work culture, leadership development, and global exposure, creating a dynamic environment for professional growth. With hybrid work flexibility, comprehensive healthcare benefits, financial wellness programs, and cultural celebrations, we foster a holistic workplace experience. Additionally, the team plays a vital role in maintaining high standards of service delivery and contributes to Zelis' award-winning culture. 

Position Overview

Salesforce manager with people management and technical delivery

Job Title: Salesforce Manager (10+ Years Experience)

Location: Hyderabad, Telangana

Department: Enterprise Applications

Reports To: Director - Enterprise Applications

Role Overview

The Salesforce Manager will lead the strategy, architecture, delivery, and governance of the Salesforce ecosystem across Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, CPQ, and Health Cloud. This role requires deep technical expertise, healthcare domain awareness, and proven experience leading and managing high-performing Salesforce teams. 

The individual will be accountable for platform delivery, team performance, regulatory compliance, and stakeholder satisfaction while ensuring scalable, secure, and enterprise-grade Salesforce solutions. 

Key Responsibilities

Leadership & People Management

- Lead, mentor, and manage a team of Salesforce developers, administrators, and engineers. 
 - Drive performance management, career development, and succession planning within the team. 
 - Establish delivery standards, code quality benchmarks, and governance practices. 
 - Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement. 
 - Manage capacity planning, sprint allocation, and resource forecasting. 
 - Partner with cross-functional IT and business leaders to prioritize roadmap initiatives. 

Strategic Stakeholder Engagement

- Collaborate with functional stakeholders to gather and analyze business requirements.

data.title: Director-Software Engineering-Unify Energy
data.description:
We are seeking an experienced and strategic Director of Software Engineering to lead engineering for the Unify Energy platform. This role will provide technical, organizational, and delivery leadership for software and data capabilities serving the oil and gas industry. The Director will align engineering execution with customer and business priorities while advancing a secure, scalable platform that helps energy organizations manage high-value information, streamline operational workflows, and improve access to trusted data across the asset lifecycle. 

The Director will partner closely with Product Management, business leadership, Architecture, Information Security, DevOps, Data Engineering, Quality Engineering, Implementation, Customer Success, and other software teams. This leader will translate industry needs into an executable engineering strategy, coordinate cross-team dependencies, and ensure that product investments produce measurable customer, operational, and financial outcomes. 

The ideal candidate is a hands-on strategic leader with deep experience delivering complex SaaS and cloud-native platforms, leading distributed engineering teams, and building data-intensive solutions for regulated or asset-intensive industries. Oil and gas domain experience is strongly preferred, including familiarity with upstream, midstream, or downstream workflows; land, lease, well, facility, and asset records; regulatory information; document and data onboarding; and integration with industry and enterprise systems. 

Roles And Responsibilities

- Lead, mentor, and develop high-performing engineering teams responsible for the Unify Energy platform and related software, data, integration, and automation capabilities. 
 - Own the engineering strategy, technical roadmap, execution plan, and delivery outcomes for Unify Energy in alignment with product strategy, customer commitments, revenue goals, and long-term platform direction. 
 - Build strong working partnerships with oil and gas business leaders, customers, Product Management, Implementation, and Customer Success to understand industry workflows, prioritize the highest-value problems, and convert business outcomes into clear engineering plans. 
 - Provide technical leadership across SaaS software engineering, cloud-native architecture, APIs and integrations, data pipelines, search and document services, analytics, workflow automation, and applied AI. 
 - Oversee the full software development lifecycle, from discovery and architecture through development, testing, deployment, monitoring, support, and continuous improvement. 
 - Drive delivery of scalable, secure, and maintainable capabilities that support energy information ingestion, normalization, indexing, classification, validation, search, retrieval, workflow, and reporting. 
 - Advance platform capabilities that enable Access to serve as a trusted steward of customers' physical and digital information assets by supporting metadata management, intuitive search, filtering, navigation, and map-based discovery within the SaaS platform. Lead the data engineering capabilities required to ingest, organize, and enrich customer data so it becomes more accessible, useful, and valuable across oil and gas workflows. 
 - Guide integration strategy for industry and enterprise systems, including data exchanges, APIs, batch interfaces, identity services, content repositories, GIS or spatial data, analytics platforms, and customer-specific systems of record. 
 - Lead data engineering and data quality practices for high-volume structured and unstructured information, including ETL/ELT, metadata management, lineage, reconciliation, observability, and reliable downstream consumption. 
 - Guide responsible use of AI and machine learning to improve document understanding, metadata extraction, classification, entity matching, search relevance, workflow recommendations, quality assurance, and operational efficiency. 
 - Ensure solutions are designed with appropriate attention to cybersecurity, privacy, records retention, legal hold, auditability, data residency, regulatory obligations, customer controls, and business continuity. 
 - Establish outcome-based planning and measurement. Define engineering and business KPIs for major initiatives, including delivery predictability, quality, reliability, adoption, customer value, operational efficiency, and revenue or retention impact. 
 - Partner with Architecture, Information Security, DevOps, Quality Engineering, Data Engineering, and Operations to establish technical standards, reusable patterns, release controls, service-level objectives, and operational readiness. 
 - Monitor portfolio health, delivery metrics, product quality, reliability, risks, dependencies, capacity, and technical debt; make clear tradeoffs and proactively resolve or escalate issues that threaten business outcomes. 
 - Continuously improve platform architecture, technical health, and integration patterns while protecting customer continuity and sequencing change based on value, risk, and delivery readiness. 
 - Support talent planning through hiring, coaching, performance management, succession planning, role clarity, and the creation of an accountable, inclusive, and customer-focused engineering culture. 
 - Represent Unify Energy engineering in executive, product, customer, and governance forums, providing clear updates on strategy, delivery performance, investment needs, risks, opportunities, and decisions required. 
 - Stay current with emerging trends in energy technology, information management, cloud engineering, cybersecurity, data platforms, AI-enabled automation, SaaS architecture, and software delivery practices. 

First 6-12 Months

The initial focus will be to establish a clear engineering and product delivery baseline for Unify Energy, strengthen alignment between customer needs and the technical roadmap, and improve execution predictability. The Director will assess the platform architecture, team capabilities, operating model, delivery commitments, reliability, security posture, technical debt, and customer integration landscape. They will work closely with Product, Operations, and customer-facing teams to confirm the highest-priority business and product outcomes and translate them into a focused, sequenced delivery plan. 

Success will be demonstrated through clearer accountability, stronger engineering and product operating rhythms, improved delivery and quality metrics, reduced execution risk, deeper customer partnership, and measurable progress on the highest-value Unify Energy capabilities.

Every restaurant is unique, and a restaurant's menu expresses its individual brand and product offerings. Inside a Toast restaurant, the definition of the menu becomes the common language between guests, servers, and the kitchen. In our digital ordering products, a great menu serves as both a billboard and a roadmap to an excellent dining experience. It is the central hub for restaurant configuration- it determines what guests can order, how the dishes are presented and priced in different contexts, where they are routed for fulfillment and how they are coursed, how they are prepared, whether the ingredients are still available, and how they are classified for reporting. A menu is always evolving: kitchens create new dishes, managers experiment with pricing and presentation, and staff optimize the menu for restaurant operations. 

We create products to satisfy the vast breadth of our restaurants, from single-location coffee shops to complex enterprise brands with thousands of locations. We offer an extremely powerful and configurable menu platform, and our team exists to ensure that this flexibility can be managed effectively at any scale. This includes feature-rich menu data models, APIs for both first and third party integrations (eg: DoorDash and other ordering partners), and the user experiences for configuring menus that meet a vast variety of needs, from complex customer segments (eg: Pizza shops) to our evolving Retail platform. 

We are looking for a visionary engineer who is motivated by these challenges and eager to transform our menus architecture to meet the dynamic needs of our customers and our rapidly growing business. As a Principal Software Engineer on the Menus team, you will take ownership of this essential function, making strategic technical decisions that enhance our capabilities and ensure scalability. You will have the opportunity to make a huge impact in a critical space. Your leadership will drive excellence within the team and influence our broader engineering community, setting new standards and contributing to our collective success. 

About this roll* (Responsibilities)

- Lead the evolution of our Menus architecture and data models, delivering scalable solutions that have significant business impact. 
 - Define and implement frameworks and processes that guarantee the quality, resilience, and scalability of our user experiences and API platform. 
 - Develop and execute technical strategies to solve complex business challenges, leveraging data-driven decisions to prioritize impactful changes. 
 - Establish guiding technical and delivery principles that influence engineering practices across the broader engineering organization. 
 - Mentor and guide engineers, fostering a culture of continuous improvement, inclusivity, and engineering excellence. 
 - Build and maintain strong partnerships across lines of business, aligning technical solutions with strategic objectives. 

Do you have the right ingredients*? (Requirements)

- Minimum education: BE or B. Tech in a technology-related field
 - 10+ years of experience in software engineering, with a strong background in back-end development using Java, Kotlin, or other object-oriented language
 - Proficient with modern API standards and technologies (e. g. REST, GraphQL)
 - Proficient with relational databases and alternative data stores
 - Experience with distributed systems, enterprise messaging systems, and/or microservices
 - Demonstrated ability to deliver high-impact, scalable solutions in complex, multi-product environments. 
 - Strong leadership and mentoring skills, with a track record of guiding teams through architectural transformations. 
 - Excellent communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to diverse audiences. 
 - Passionate about driving innovation and continuously improving engineering practices. 

How Toast Uses AI In Its Hiring Process

Throughout the hiring process, our goal is to get to know you. We use AI tools to support our recruiters and interviewers with tasks like note-taking, summarization, and documentation of interviews to ensure they can be fully focused on your conversation. All hiring decisions are made by people. We ask that you complete interviews and assessments on your own, without real-time AI tools, recording, or transcription bots, unless we tell you otherwise in advance. To learn more: https: //careers. toasttab. com/ai-in-hiring

Our Approach to Hybrid Working

We embrace a hybrid work model that fosters in-person collaboration while valuing individual needs. Our goal is to build a strong culture of connection as we work together to empower the hospitality community, regardless of location. Please visit the Locations page on our career site to learn more about our in-office expectations by region: https: //careers. toasttab. com/locations-toast

People Are the Secret Ingredient in Our Recipe for Success

At Toast, our employees are our secret ingredient-when they thrive, we thrive. The restaurant industry brings together people with a wide range of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives, and we value that same breadth at Toast. We strive to build a culture grounded in authenticity, respect, and humility, where every Toaster has a real opportunity to grow, contribute, and do their best work-raising the bar in delivering exceptional experiences for our customers and each other.

data.description:
Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all. 

Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever. 

Job Summary

The Construction Quality Manager is responsible for developing, implementing, and managing the overall Quality Management System (QMS) for large-scale construction projects, ensuring compliance with project specifications, engineering standards, statutory regulations, client requirements, and international quality practices. The role oversees quality assurance and quality control activities across all phases of construction including civil, structural, architectural, mechanical, electrical, plumbing (MEP), process utilities, cleanroom systems, and high-tech industrial facility installations. The position plays a critical role in ensuring defect-free execution, minimizing rework, maintaining construction excellence, and achieving project delivery targets with the highest quality standards. 

Key Roles & Responsibilities

- Develop, implement, and maintain project-wide Construction Quality Management Plans, Inspection & Test Plans (ITPs), quality procedures, and inspection protocols. 
 - Lead all QA/QC activities for civil, structural steel, architectural, mechanical, electrical, instrumentation, piping, HVAC, cleanroom, and utility systems construction works. 
 - Ensure construction activities comply with approved drawings, project specifications, applicable codes, standards, client requirements, and statutory regulations. 
 - Establish and monitor quality assurance systems for contractors, subcontractors, vendors, and suppliers across the project lifecycle. 
 - Conduct quality audits, surveillance inspections, site walkthroughs, and compliance reviews to identify gaps and enforce corrective actions. 
 - Review and approve Method Statements, Material Submittals, Inspection Requests, Test Reports, Welding Procedures, and quality documentation. 
 - Manage Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs), Site Observation Reports (SOR), Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA), Root Cause Analysis (RCA), and quality improvement initiatives. 
 - Coordinate with Engineering, Construction, Procurement, Safety, Commissioning, and Project Controls teams to ensure integrated project execution with required quality. 
 - Oversee testing and inspection activities including concrete testing, welding inspections, NDT, pressure testing, cleanroom validation, and equipment installation quality checks. 
 - Ensure compliance with ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems and applicable international construction standards such as ASTM, ASME, ANSI, NFPA, IPC, SEMI, ACI, AWS, NFPA, FM Global, NEC, IS, DISH, PESO, ATEX, CE, UL and IEC standards. 
 - Shall be developing and implementing Test Protocols for Piping and HVAC in coordination with commissioning team for MEP and other services. 
 - Sustainability shall be conversion with the sustainability and green building requirement. 
 - Monitor contractor quality performance metrics, workmanship standards, punch points, and closure of quality observations. 
 - Lead quality meetings with clients, consultants, EPC contractors, and stakeholders to review project quality performance and risk mitigation actions. 
 - Ensure proper maintenance of quality records, inspection reports, turnover dossiers, as-built documentation, and handover packages. 
 - Support commissioning and startup teams by ensuring all systems are installed and tested in accordance with approved quality standards. 
 - Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance construction quality, reduce defects, improve productivity, and optimize project delivery efficiency. 
 - Mentor QA/QC engineers, inspectors, and site quality personnel while fostering a strong culture of quality excellence across the organization. 

Education & Qualifications Required

- Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Civil Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Construction Management, or related engineering discipline. 
 - Master's Degree or MBA in Project Management / Construction Management is preferred. 
 - Certifications such as ISO 9001 Lead Auditor, Certified Quality Engineer (CQE), PMP, CSWIP, AWS-CWI, NACE, or equivalent certifications are preferred. 
 - Strong knowledge of construction quality standards, semiconductor/high-tech industrial facility requirements, cleanroom construction practices, and EPC project execution methodologies. 
 - Proficiency in QA/QC documentation systems, inspection methodologies, material quality standards, and testing procedures. 
 - Strong understanding of international codes and standards including ASTM, ASME, ANSI, SEMI, NFPA, ACI, IPC, AWS, and IEC. 
 - Experience with digital quality management systems, construction management software, BIM coordination platforms, and project reporting tools. 
 - Excellent leadership, stakeholder management, communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills. 
 - Ability to manage multi-disciplinary construction teams in fast-paced and technically demanding environments. 

Experience Required

- 12-15+ years of experience in construction quality management for large industrial, semiconductor, data center, pharmaceutical, oil & gas, or high-tech infrastructure projects. 
 - Minimum 5+ years in a leadership role managing QA/QC teams on mega construction projects. 
 - Experience in semiconductor fabs, cleanroom facilities, advanced manufacturing plants, or mission-critical infrastructure projects is highly preferred. 
 - Proven experience handling EPC contractors, international consultants, commissioning teams, and large-scale project stakeholders

Preferred Technical Skills

- Construction Quality Management Systems (QMS)
 - QA/QC Procedures & Inspection Management
 - Root Cause Analysis (RCA) & CAPA
 - Welding Inspection & NDT Coordination
 - Cleanroom & Semiconductor Facility Standards
 - Material Testing & Compliance Verification
 - Construction Codes & International Standards
 - Contractor Quality Performance Management
 - Audit & Compliance Management
 - Risk Assessment & Quality Improvement Programs
 - Project Documentation & Turnover Management

Leveraged AI-enabled and Generative AI solutions to streamline construction interface management, accelerate issue resolution, improve coordination across multidisciplinary teams, and enhance project execution visibility

Work Environment

The role involves extensive coordination across active construction sites, engineering offices, contractor locations, and stakeholder interfaces. The position may require travel between project sites, long working hours during critical project phases, and direct field involvement in high-value industrial construction activities.

This is a hands-on build role for someone who takes a business process and turns it into a canvas app people find easy and fast to use, backed by a properly designed Dataverse model and automation that holds up in production. 

You will own features end to end - data model, app, automation, integration and security - on delivery teams alongside architects, business analysts and client stakeholders. We also expect you to bring AI into the solution where it earns its place: embedding Copilot and agent capabilities in canvas apps and the wider Power Platform estate, rather than treating AI as a separate project. 

Key Responsibilities

- Design and build intuitive, user-friendly Power Apps canvas apps - screen and navigation design, responsive layouts, reusable components, delegation-aware data access and performance tuning. 
 - Turn business requirements and user journeys into working applications, taking ownership of usability and of how the app performs with real data volumes. 
 - Design and implement scalable Power Automate workflows - cloud flows, child flows, error handling and retry patterns, approvals, scheduled and event-driven processing, and concurrency and throughput considerations. 
 - Design and implement Dataverse solutions: tables, columns and relationships, alternate keys, calculated and rollup fields, and business rules. 
 - Design and implement the Dataverse security model - security roles, teams, business units, and row-level and column-level security - and validate that users see only what they should. 
 - Integrate AI agents and Copilot capabilities into canvas apps and related Power Platform solutions, including Copilot Studio agents, AI Builder models and prompt-based actions, with attention to grounding, accuracy and appropriate use. 
 - Integrate solutions with external systems and Microsoft 365 services using standard and custom connectors, Power Automate and APIs. 
 - Apply Power Platform ALM properly - solutions, managed and unmanaged layers, environment variables, connection references, and deployment through pipelines or Azure DevOps. 
 - Troubleshoot, tune and resolve defects across apps, flows and Dataverse, including performance and delegation issues. 
 - Follow Power Platform governance, licensing, data loss prevention and security best practice, and design within the client's environment strategy. 
 - Produce technical documentation, solution designs and handover material, and support testing, UAT, deployment and release activities. 
 - Work with business stakeholders, architects and developers to shape practical solutions, and guide junior developers on the team. 

Required Skills & Experience

- 6-10 years of overall application development experience, with a substantial recent focus on the Microsoft Power Platform. 
 - Strong hands-on experience building Power Apps canvas apps that users find intuitive - component reuse, responsive design, Power Fx, collections and variables, delegation and performance optimisation. 
 - Strong experience designing and implementing scalable Power Automate workflows, including error handling, child flows, approvals and long-running or high-volume patterns. 
 - Proven Dataverse implementation experience: tables, columns and relationships, alternate keys, calculated and rollup fields, and business rules. 
 - Practical command of the Dataverse security model - security roles, teams, business units, and row-level and column-level security - and the ability to design it for a real organizational structure. 
 - Working knowledge of integrating AI agents and Copilot capabilities with canvas apps and Power Platform solutions (Copilot Studio, AI Builder or equivalent). 
 - Experience integrating with external systems and Microsoft 365 services through standard and custom connectors and APIs. 
 - Understanding of Power Platform ALM - solutions, environment variables, connection references and automated deployment. 
 - Awareness of Power Platform governance, licensing implications and DLP policies. 
 - Ability to debug and performance-tune apps and flows, and to resolve defects through to closure. 
 - Good client-facing communication - running requirement discussions and demos, and explaining design decisions clearly. 

Qualifications

Preferred / Good to Have

- Experience with model-driven apps, Power Pages or Power BI alongside canvas apps. 
 - Experience building Copilot Studio agents in depth - topics, actions, knowledge sources and channel deployment. 
 - Custom code extension skills: PCF components, JavaScript, C# plug-ins or Azure Functions. 
 - Azure integration experience - Logic Apps, API Management, Key Vault or Service Bus. 
 - Microsoft certifications: PL-400, PL-200, PL-600 or AI-102. 
 - Experience with Dataverse data migration and integration tooling (dataflows, Azure Data Factory, Data Migration Utility).

JOB DESCRIPTION

Plant Head - Manufacturing & Operations

Company: Shri Viratra Engineering Pvt. Ltd. 

Location: Jodhpur, Rajasthan, India

Department: Manufacturing & Operations

Reporting To: Directors / Senior Management

Experience: 15+ years

Salary: ₹75, 000-₹1, 25, 000 per month, depending on experience and capability

Team Size: Approximately 200 employees

About the Company

Shri Viratra Engineering Pvt. Ltd. is engaged in manufacturing industrial machinery and processing plants, including Dal, Rice, Atta, Besan, Masala and Oil Mill plants. 

Job Purpose

To lead and manage the complete manufacturing operations of the company, ensuring production efficiency, product quality, cost control, timely delivery, ERP/MRP implementation, and a systematic, process-driven manufacturing environment. 

Key Responsibilities

1. Complete Plant Management

- Lead and coordinate all manufacturing departments. 

- Manage Laser Cutting, CNC Bending, Welding & Fabrication, Powder Coating, Assembly, Quality Control, Testing and Dispatch. 

- Establish departmental targets, responsibilities, reporting systems and accountability. 

- Ensure smooth coordination between Production, Design, PPC, Stores, Purchase, Quality and Dispatch. 

2. Production Planning & Control

- Prepare daily, weekly and monthly production plans. 

- Ensure timely execution of work orders and customer delivery commitments. 

- Monitor machine capacity, manpower utilization, material availability and production bottlenecks. 

- Implement production tracking and daily review meetings. 

3. Quality Control & Testing

- Establish incoming, in-process and final inspection procedures. 

- Ensure machines and plants undergo proper functional testing before dispatch. 

- Reduce rework, rejection, customer complaints and quality-related delays. 

- Implement root-cause analysis and corrective/preventive actions. 

4. ERP/MRP & Process Implementation

- Lead implementation and adoption of ERP/MRP systems. 

- Establish accurate production routing, BOM coordination, work orders, material consumption and inventory tracking. 

- Develop SOPs, department-wise KPIs, dashboards and daily MIS reports. 

- Ensure production data is recorded accurately and reviewed regularly. 

5. Manpower & Leadership

- Lead a workforce of approximately 200 employees through department heads, supervisors and team leaders. 

- Improve discipline, productivity, attendance, skill development and workforce accountability. 

- Identify staffing gaps and build a reliable supervisory structure. 

- Develop a second line of leadership to reduce dependency on individual employees. 

6. Cost, Productivity & Delivery

- Control manufacturing costs, wastage, overtime and rework. 

- Improve machine utilization, labour productivity and material yield. 

- Monitor on-time delivery, production achievement and dispatch readiness. 

- Drive continuous improvement, 5S and Lean Manufacturing practices where applicable. 

7. Maintenance, Safety & Compliance

- Coordinate preventive maintenance of production machinery. 

- Ensure workplace safety, equipment inspections and safe material handling. 

- Maintain housekeeping, process discipline and applicable statutory compliance. 

8. Management Reporting

- Submit daily, weekly and monthly performance reports to management. 

- Highlight delays, quality issues, cost overruns and corrective actions. 

- Take ownership of manufacturing performance and implement measurable improvements. 

Required Qualifications

- B. E. /B. Tech in Mechanical Engineering or Production Engineering preferred. 

- Diploma in Mechanical Engineering may be considered for candidates with strong, relevant plant leadership experience. 

- Minimum 15 years of overall manufacturing experience, with substantial experience in senior operations leadership. 

- Proven experience managing large teams in machinery manufacturing, industrial equipment or sheet-metal fabrication. 

- Practical knowledge of CNC laser cutting, bending, welding, fabrication, coating, assembly and testing. 

- Strong understanding of PPC, Quality Management, ERP/MRP, BOM, routing, inventory and MIS. 

- Excellent leadership, problem-solving, communication and execution skills.

The selected candidate will be evaluated on: 

- Production plan achievement. 

- On-time delivery and dispatch. 

- Quality rejection and rework reduction. 

- Labour productivity and manufacturing cost. 

- ERP/MRP adoption and reporting accuracy. 

- Departmental discipline, safety and process compliance.

A hands-on, result-oriented manufacturing leader who can build systems, develop department heads, improve operational efficiency and manage the entire plant independently.

data.title: ASIC Digital Design, Staff Engineer
data.description:
We Are

Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow. 

You Are

You have built verification environments that catch bugs before they become customer issues. Whether you have been doing this for three years or closer to ten, you have learned that verification is not about running tests; it is about thinking through what could go wrong and building the infrastructure to prove it won't. You understand that a well-written testbench is half the battle, and the remaining is knowing which corner cases matter, and which ones are just noise. 

You are comfortable working in System Verilog and UVM, writing test cases that exercise real scenarios, not just the ones in the specification. You have debugged enough simulations to recognize patterns in waveforms, and you know when to dig deeper versus when to loop in the design team. Protocols like MIPI UFS/UniPro, DDR, PCIe, Ethernet or USB are not just acronyms to you; you have worked with at least one of them closely enough to understand how transactions flow and where things typically break. 

Working on a verification team means asking questions when the test plan does not make sense, writing assertions that catch issues, and tracking coverage in a way that tells you what you have validated and what you have not. At Synopsys, you will work on IP cores that go into AI systems, automotive platforms, and data centers. The verification work you do will determine whether that IP works when it ships. 

What You'll Be Doing

- Build and maintain UVM-based testbench for RTL IP cores, including agents, drivers, monitors, scoreboards, and coverage collectors
 - Write System Verilog test cases and constrained random stimulus to verify functional correctness across different operating modes and protocol scenarios
 - Develop and execute verification plans based on design specifications, identifying test scenarios, corner cases, and coverage goals
 - Debug RTL and testbench issues by analyzing simulation logs, waveforms, and coverage reports to isolate root causes and verify fixes
 - Implement assertion-based checks and functional coverage models to track verification progress and ensure thorough validation
 - Collaborate with design engineers to understand IP functionality, clarify requirements, and provide feedback on design-for-verification considerations
 - Run regressions, analyze results, and work toward coverage closure, documenting verification status and outstanding issues

The Impact You Will Have

- Ensure Synopsys IP cores are thoroughly validated before they reach customers building AI accelerators, automotive systems, and cloud infrastructure
 - Reduce post-silicon bugs and customer escalations by catching design issues early through systematic verification and coverage analysis
 - Contribute to faster IP release cycles by building reusable verification components and efficient test strategies
 - Help maintain high-quality standards across Synopsys IP products, directly impacting customer success and product reliability
 - Support the development of verification best practices and methodologies within the Bangalore team
 - Enable design teams to iterate faster by providing clear, actionable feedback on functional correctness and edge case behavior
 - Build verification infrastructure that can scale across multiple IP variants and protocol configurations

What You'll Need

- 4-8 years of hands-on experience in ASIC or RTL verification for IP cores or digital designs
 - Understanding of verification planning, test case development, and coverage-driven verification concepts
 - Working knowledge of UVM or similar verification methodologies, with experience building testbench components and writing test cases
 - Solid System Verilog skills, including understanding of constrained random verification, coverage, and assertions
 - Familiarity with at least one industry-standard protocol such as MIPI UFS/UniPro, DDR, PCIe, Ethernet, USB or similar
 - Experience debugging RTL simulations using waveform viewers and analyzing coverage reports to guide verification progress
 - Experience with Perforce or similar revision control environment
 - Basic scripting ability in Python, Perl, TCL, or shell scripting to support automation and regression management
 - Ability to use AI tools like Cursor and GitHub Copilot for analysis, development, debugs and maximizing productivity. 
 - Have good communication skills, will be a team player, and will have good problem-solving skills. 

Who You Are

- You can look at a design spec and start listing the test scenarios that need to be covered without waiting for someone to hand you a complete test plan
 - You are methodical about debugging, when a test fails, you do not guess, you trace through the waveform and log until you understand exactly what happened
 - You ask questions when requirements are unclear or when a design decision seems like it will be hard to verify, and you do it early enough to matter
 - You are comfortable working with design engineers who may be in different locations, coordinating on bug fixes, clarifications, and verification scope
 - You track your own coverage and verification progress, knowing what has been tested, what has not, and what the gaps mean for overall quality
 - You are motivated by the moment when your testbench catches a real bug, the kind that would have caused problems downstream if it had slipped through

The Team You'll Be Part Of

You will join the IPG and SSG Group at the Bangalore Design Center, working alongside verification and design engineers who develop IP cores for a range of applications including AI, automotive, and cloud infrastructure. The team collaborates across Synopsys' global sites, and you will have the opportunity to work on IP that goes into high-performance systems used by customers worldwide. 

Rewards And Benefits

We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

data.title: Pen Testing - Senior Consultant
data.description:
Summary

Position Summary

Deloitte Cyber understands the unique challenges and opportunities businesses face in cybersecurity. Join our team to deliver powerful insights that help clients navigate the ever-changing threat landscape and technology environment as we partner with them to transform their businesses. 

Work you'll do

As a Senior Consultant on the Cyber Defense & Resilience team, you will be responsible for leading offensive security engagements and helping clients identify, validate, and remediate vulnerabilities across their digital ecosystem. 

- Lead penetration testing workstreams across web, API, mobile, thick-client, network, cloud, and infrastructure environments. 
 - Design and execute manual and automated security assessments, validate findings, and develop remediation recommendations. 
 - Perform secure code reviews, application security architecture reviews, and threat modeling to identify design and implementation risks. 
 - Prepare client-ready reports, executive summaries, technical findings, and presentation materials, and support remediation and retesting discussions with stakeholders. 
 - Contribute to engagement planning, proposal support, delivery optimization, methodology development, and mentoring of junior team members. 

The team

Deloitte Cyber Defense & Resilience teams assist clients in identifying, prioritizing, and remediating vulnerabilities across their digital ecosystems. Through penetration testing, application security assessments, attack surface management, red teaming, and purple teaming, our professionals help clients understand how threat actors may exploit weaknesses across applications, networks, cloud environments, endpoints, and enterprise systems. The team combines offensive security expertise with practical defensive recommendations. Our work helps clients improve detection, response, remediation, and overall cyber resilience while aligning technical findings to business priorities and risk objectives. 

Location: Bengaluru/Hyderabad/Pune/Chennai

Shift Timings: General

Qualifications

Required: 

- 6+ years of experience in cybersecurity, application security, vulnerability assessment, penetration testing, or cyber risk services. 
 - Experience conducting penetration tests across web applications, APIs, mobile applications, thick-client applications, networks, cloud environments, or enterprise infrastructure. 
 - Experience performing manual assessment and exploitation of vulnerabilities including SQL injection, cross-site scripting, XML external entity attacks, server-side request forgery, insecure deserialization, HTTP request smuggling, authentication weaknesses, authorization weaknesses, and business logic vulnerabilities. 
 - Experience performing secure code reviews and threat modeling. 
 - Experience using tools such as Burp Suite, Fiddler, Wireshark, Nmap, Metasploit, Nessus, Qualys, Tenable, Veracode, Frida, Apktool, JADX, dnSpy, or IDA Pro. 
 - One or more cybersecurity certifications such as Offensive Security Certified Professional, Offensive Security Web Expert, GIAC Penetration Tester, GIAC Web Application Penetration Tester, Certified Information Systems Security Professional, or CREST certification. 
 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent experience. 

Preferred: 

- Experience with red team, purple team, breach and attack simulation, or adversary emulation engagements. 
 - Experience assessing Amazon Web Services, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud environments, including identity and access management, storage, compute, networking, containers, or Kubernetes. 
 - Experience testing artificial intelligence-enabled applications, large language model integrations, APIs, or agent-based systems. 
 - Experience developing security testing automation using Python, PowerShell, Bash, or similar scripting languages. 
 - Experience supporting executive briefings and presenting technical findings to technical and nontechnical audiences. 
 - Publications, blogs, open-source tools, conference presentations, research, or Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures submissions related to cybersecurity. 

Our purpose

Deloitte's purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities. 

Our people and culture

Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients' most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work. 

Professional development

At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India . 

Benefits To Help You Thrive

At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially-and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you. 

Recruiting tips

From developing a stand out resume to putting your best foot forward in the interview, we want you to feel prepared and confident as you explore opportunities at Deloitte. Check out recruiting tips from Deloitte recruiters.

At Pearson, our purpose is simple: Add life to a lifetime of learning. 

As a global leader in digital learning, we are transforming how people learn through innovative, AI-powered experiences that improve outcomes and create meaningful impact. The Office of the CTO powers this transformation by delivering scalable, secure, resilient, and intelligent enterprise platforms. Within Digital & Technology (D&T), the AgentOps Team leads the next generation of enterprise automation through Agentic AI, intelligent workflows, and autonomous systems that drive measurable business value. 

Why Join AgentOps?

This is an opportunity to be at the forefront of enterprise AI innovation and help shape how humans and AI agents collaborate at scale. 

You will: 

- Build cutting-edge agentic AI solutions deployed across Pearson's global enterprise

- Create intelligent workflows that combine automation, reasoning, and human oversight

- Solve high-impact business challenges using advanced AI technologies

- Influence enterprise-wide AI engineering and automation standards

- Help define the future of a symbiotic workforce where humans and AI agents work together seamlessly

Role Overview

The Lead Specialist, Agentic Automations is a senior practitioner and solution leader responsible for driving the end-to-end discovery, design, and delivery of enterprise-scale Agentic AI and intelligent automation solutions. 

This role sits at the intersection of business strategy, process transformation, and AI engineering. You will work closely with business leaders, architects, engineers, and product teams to identify automation opportunities, design scalable agent ecosystems, and deliver solutions that generate measurable business outcomes. 

As a critical member of AgentOps, you will translate complex business challenges into intelligent, AI-powered workflows while ensuring alignment with enterprise architecture, governance, risk, compliance, and ROI objectives. 

You will play a key role in advancing Pearson's vision of an AI-enabled enterprise powered by agentic systems and intelligent automation. 

Key Responsibilities

Business Analysis & Opportunity Discovery

- Lead end-to-end requirements gathering, process discovery, and stakeholder workshops for agentic automation initiatives.

- Facilitate cross-functional discussions with SMEs, product owners, operational teams, and business leaders.

- Translate business challenges into scalable AI and automation solutions with clearly defined value realization metrics. 

- Establish measurable ROI, productivity, efficiency, quality, and cost optimization objectives. 

Solution Design & Agentic Architecture
