At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner-and every person here makes that happen. You'll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world. 

This Position reports to: 

Senior Digital Solution Engineering Spec

Your role and responsibilities: 

This is a Project Engineer- Advanced Process Control role, reporting to the Engineering Manager in business area Process Automation located in Bangalore. You will be responsible for delivering APC projects for Cement customers across the globe. You will be part of Process Industries operations/development team within INOPC-PA. As a project Engineer, you will be responsible for developing and delivering APC scope for process industry Cement. Your responsibility will be to ensure the project deliverables are met in terms of application quality performance & budget, while working with a team of automation project engineers. 

The work model for the role is: 

This role is contributing to the Process Automation business for Process Industries division based in Bangalore, India. 

You will be mainly accountable for: 

- Work on APC/APCA projects end-to-end for Cement. Carry out independently activities of basic and detailed engineering of APC solutions. 
 - Carry out Engineering and commissioning of APC Product for Cement plant
 - Study of process operation and process control requirements and definition of suitable simple, complex and advanced regulatory control strategies to be implemented at DCS. 
 - Ensure the engineering workflow is adhered and project is executed as per the Quality Management System. 
 - Prepare periodic reports (like weekly commissioning report, time sheet, SAT) and update the relevant stakeholders. 
 - Ensure Time Sheets are maintained periodically. 
 - Ensure customer queries are resolved on time & maintain customer relationship through professional approach. 
 - Efficient in Process Analysis and estimating the areas where optimization is required to enhance productivity. 
 - Responsible for providing remote assistance to installed base. Ensures the activities at site are in line with company health, safety, and environmental policies. 
 - Take required support from L2/ L3 support line and resolve issues on time. Provide required inputs for L2/L3 support line for issues raised. 

Qualifications for the role : 

- B. Tech/ B. E from a reputed University with First Class in Chemical engineering 
 - 2-4 years of relevant work experience in APC implementation. 
 - Experience in Advance Process Control Technology and Automation principles . 
 - Domain expertise in Cement
 - Basics of Control System & OPC Communication with PLC/DCS 
 - Availability to travel for either short or long term assignment (50 % to 60 % travel )

More about us: 

The Process Industries Division serves the mining, minerals processing, metals, cement, pulp and paper, battery manufacturing, and food and beverage, as well as their associated service industries. The Division brings deep industry domain expertise coupled with the ability to integrate both automation and electrical systems, increase productivity and reduce overall capital and operating costs for customers. For mining, metals and cement customers, solutions include specialized products and services, as well as total production systems. The Division designs, plans, engineers, supplies, installs and commissions integrated electrical and motion systems, including electric equipment, drives, motors, high power rectifiers and equipment for automation and supervisory control within a variety of areas including mineral handling, mining operations, aluminum smelting, hot and cold steel applications and cement production. The offering for the pulp and paper industries includes control systems, quality control systems, drive systems, on-line sensors, actuators and field instruments. Digitalization solutions, including collaborative operations and augmented reality, help improve plant and enterprise productivity, and reduce maintenance and energy costs.

data.description:
Senior GenAI Engineer

● Overall experience: 5-8 years

● Location: Bangalore (or willing to relocate to Bangalore)

Role Overview

We are looking for a Senior GenAI Engineer with strong core engineering foundations and

hands-on experience building and deploying GenAI solutions. This role is execution- and

ownership-focused - responsible for delivering GenAI features end-to-end (backend +

frontend), working with agentic AI workflows, and mentoring junior engineers while handling

ambiguous requirements. 

This position is part of our GenAI hiring phase, where we prioritize strong full-stack/backend

engineers who have recently built and shipped GenAI and agentic AI solutions in production. 

Experience Profile

● Overall experience: 5-8 years

● Core engineering background: Python (Django / FastAPI)

● GenAI experience: 2-3+ years of hands-on, production-level experience, including Agentic AI. 

Key Responsibilities

GenAI Solution Development

● Build and deploy GenAI-powered features within real-world products, spanning backend

(Python - Django/FastAPI)

● Design and implement RAG pipelines, including: 

○ Embeddings

○ Vector databases

○ Retrieval strategies

● Integrate GenAI capabilities with backend systems via APIs and services. ● Build responsive, GenAI-integrated UI/UX components in React to surface AI-driven

features to end users. 

System & Solution Ownership

● Own GenAI solutions end-to-end, from design to production rollout - across backend, 

frontend, and AI layers. 

● Design RAG architectures and decide: 

○ Chunking strategies

○ Retrieval approaches

● Handle ambiguous requirements and convert them into working, shippable solutions. 

Reliability, Quality & Performance

● Address latency, cost, and evaluation considerations in GenAI systems. 

● Implement guardrails and safety mechanisms. 

● Contribute to monitoring and basic operational readiness. 

Agentic AI (Core Focus)

● Build and own agent-based workflows, including: 

○ Multi-step reasoning flows

○ Tool/function calling

○ Orchestrated GenAI interactions

● Work hands-on with agent frameworks to design and deploy production-grade agentic

systems (deep research not required, but practical build experience expected). 

Mentoring & Collaboration

● Mentor junior engineers working on GenAI components. 

● Review GenAI-related code and designs, across both backend and frontend

implementations. 

● Collaborate closely with backend, frontend, data, and product teams. 

Must-Have Skills

● Strong engineering experience in Python (Django / FastAPI)

● Hands-on experience building GenAI applications in production. 

● Experience with: 

○ RAG pipelines

○ Vector databases

○ LLM APIs

○ Agentic AI (multi-step reasoning, tool/function calling, orchestration)

● Solid understanding of API design and backend integrations. 

● Ability to reason about trade-offs in performance, cost, and reliability. 

Nice-to-Have Skills

● Familiarity with evaluation frameworks for GenAI. 

● Exposure to cloud-native deployments. 

● Experience mentoring junior engineers.

data.description:
Job Title: Senior DevOps Engineer (Data Platform & ERP Integration)

Notice Period: Immediate to 30 days

Experience Required: - 5+ Years

Job Location: Pune/Hybrid)

About Accelirate

Accelirate is a leading agentic AI and automation firm, building intelligent agents that transform enterprise operations. We're a certified partner of UiPath, Microsoft, and Salesforce, with 1500+ processes automated annually across industries. Honored as a Top Workplaces USA winner five years in a row, we're known for delivering scalable, agent-driven solutions that empower humans, agents, and robots to work smarter together. 

About the Role We are seeking a Senior DevOps Engineer to build, scale, and maintain the cloud infrastructure and delivery pipelines supporting our platform team. In this role, you will focus on powering real-time ERP data integration workloads by building resilient Kubernetes platform automation, managing distributed streaming clusters (Kafka/Flink), ensuring rigorous IaC standards, and delivering comprehensive observability across our multi-database ecosystem. 

Key Responsibilities

- Infrastructure Automation: Design, provision, and maintain secure, scalable AWS cloud infrastructure using Terraform or CloudFormation. 
 - Container Orchestration & Platform: Manage, optimize, and secure Kubernetes clusters (EKS) for deploying microservices, stream processors, and data connectors. 
 - CI/CD & Pipeline Engineering: Build, automate, and maintain robust GitHub Actions deployment pipelines for Java (Spring Boot), Python, and infrastructure workloads. 
 - Observability & Reliability: Implement end-to-end monitoring, centralized logging, distributed tracing, and automated alerting using Datadog, New Relic, or Splunk to guarantee high availability for mission-critical integration pipelines. 
 - Data Platform Support: Partner with data engineers to automate, scale, and secure deployments of Apache Kafka, Kafka Connect, Apache Flink/Kafka Streams, and relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server, Oracle). 
 - Security & Compliance: Enforce secret management, IAM policies, network security controls, and infrastructure compliance across environments. 

Required Qualifications

- DevOps & Cloud Engineering: 5+ years of experience in DevOps or Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), with deep expertise on AWS. 
 - Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Advanced hands-on proficiency with Terraform or AWS CloudFormation. 
 - Containerization & Orchestration: Proven track record running production workloads using Docker and Kubernetes (EKS). 
 - CI/CD Automation: Deep experience designing and optimizing automated pipelines using GitHub Actions. 
 - Observability & APM: Strong production experience configuring dashboards, metrics, and alerting in Datadog, New Relic, or Splunk. 
 - Scripting & Tooling: Strong scripting abilities in Python or Bash, with solid understanding of Java/Spring Boot application runtimes and JVM tuning. 
 - Databases & Streaming Awareness: Experience provisioning and supporting self-hosted or managed relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server, Oracle) and streaming middleware (Apache Kafka). 
 - Version Control: Advanced proficiency with Git and standard branching models. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience managing stateful workloads and operators on Kubernetes (e. g. , Strimzi Kafka Operator, Flink Kubernetes Operator). 
 - Familiarity with Change Data Capture (CDC) infrastructure tools like Debezium. 
 - AWS certifications (e. g. , AWS Certified Solutions Architect or DevOps Engineer Professional).

data.title: Manager, Data Storage Platforms
data.description:
Vantive is a vital organ therapy company on a mission to extend lives and expand possibilities for patients and care teams everywhere. For 70 years, our team has driven meaningful innovations in kidney care. As we build on our legacy, we are deepening our commitment to elevating the dialysis experience through digital solutions and advanced services, while looking beyond kidney care and investing in transforming vital organ therapies. Greater flexibility and efficiency in therapy administration for care teams, and longer, fuller lives for patients- that is what Vantive aspires to deliver. 

We believe Vantive will not only build our leadership in the kidney care space, it will also offer meaningful work to those who join us. At Vantive, you will become part of a community of people who are focused, courageous and don't settle for the mediocre. Each of us is driven to help improve patients' lives worldwide. Join us in advancing our mission to extend lives and expand possibilities. 

The Manager, Data Storage Platforms is responsible for leading a team of platform engineers overseeing the planning, the build, and the operations of data platforms. They will be responsible for architecting, engineering, and optimizing large‐scale, cloud‐native data platforms on AWS and Azure. This role leads development of event‐driven data architectures, CDC frameworks, data lake ingestion pipelines, and scalable ETL/ELT processes. The architect partners closely with cross‐functional teams, leads technical delivery, ensures operational excellence, and provides hands‐on support for global data transformation initiatives. They will be a part of the Data Services Platforms team and provide technological and process expertise and support the global domain data product delivery teams. They will provide leadership by assisting business partners in identifying and responding to opportunities for cost-effective data implementations and solutions by analyzing and making decisions that have cross functional business impact. 

Responsibilities

- Lead and mentor a team of data platform engineers
 - Accountable for strategic planning and technical roadmap development for data platforms. 
 - Oversee the design, implementation, and maintenance of data engineering pipelines in a multi-cloud environment, including integrations with a variety of data sources (including structured, semi-structured, and unstructured data)
 - Collaborate with the Domain Data Product Delivery teams and other stakeholders in Architecture, Data Integration, DevOps, and Data Governance to deliver data platform initiatives
 - Ensure data engineering standards align with industry best practices for data governance, data quality, and data security. 
 - Monitor and optimize the performance of data pipelines, ensuring they meet SLAs for data availability and quality. 
 - Evaluate and recommend new data technologies and tools to improve data engineering processes and outcomes, in collaboration with the Domain Data Product Delivery teams. 
 - Effectively communicate and realize vision and strategy for the organization that aligns with the business and patient needs. 
 - Embrace and embed agile ways of working in support of a fail-fast-learn-fast culture and enabling continual improvement. 
 - Foster a collaborative work environment with strong working relationships within and across businesses and functions, and with strategic external partners. 
 - Manage datasets using Apache Hudi (version 0. 11. x and higher), focusing on supporting near real-time data processing and incremental data loading utilizing cutting-edge features for more efficient data lake management and complex data transformation pipelines
 - Implement the latest versions of Terraform (0. 12. x and higher) to efficiently handle infrastructure changes and versioning with enhanced security and flexibility

Key Experiences & Attributes

- Bachelor's degree or higher in computer science or relevant subject area
 - Minimum 5+ years of progressive technical experience in one or more of the cloud-based data warehouse/data lake platforms such as AWS S3, Snowflake, Databricks, Microsoft Synapse. 
 - Significant experience in leading teams in Data & Analytics programs with experience in native digital technologies (cloud, big data and predictive) in organizations driving product development. 
 - Change Agent - Catalyst for the teams and expected to lead the transformation to a fail-fast-learn-fast culture enabling continual improvement. 
 - Servant Leader - Able to gain respect from their team and willing to get their hands dirty to get the job done. 
 - Courageous - Able to effectively challenge and influence peers and teams, leading them through difficult or uncertain situations. 
 - Significant experience working in a global matrix environment. 
 - Must be a strategic, innovative problem solver, and have strong influencing and communication skills. 
 - Strong knowledge of business process flow and/or entity relationship modeling. 
 - Demonstrated outstanding written and verbal communication skills. Ability to work effectively with other technology teams as well as business partners. Ability to effectively present information, interact with, and respond to questions from managers, employees, customers, and vendors

data.description:
At Columbia, we're as passionate about the outdoors as you are. And while our gear is available worldwide, we're proud to be based in the Pacific Northwest, where natural wonders are our playground. 

Every product we make and every task we undertake is inspired by the famous words of our founder Gert Boyle: "It's perfect. Now make it better. " As pioneers of relentless improvement, we are constantly evolving. 

We believe the outdoors is ours to protect and strive to keep our planet healthy. We believe in empowering people to experience the outdoors to the fullest. 

And we believe in you. 

About The Position

Although we're an apparel and footwear-focused company, technology is central to everything we do. Columbia Sportswear's Digital Technology (CDT) group enables an IT infrastructure and applications across four global brands, a global supply chain, and 500+ geographically dispersed stores. These teams support in-store, mobile, and data platforms to enhance customer interface and service in an ever-evolving industry. 

The Quality Analyst II has a solid understanding of technology platforms and utilizes best practices among the quality team. This person reviews test strategies, authors test plans, and authors and executes test cases. The Quality Analyst II uses a variety of testing tools and methods and updates or creates automated test cases. The role executes automated test scripts and identify process and/ technology issues. 

How You'll Make a Difference

- Communication, Collaboration & Leadership: Communicates status in daily meetings, fosters constructive, collaborative and effective communication with others, both internally and externally. Actively participates in design discussions, planning, and retrospective reviews. Explains and simplifies complex information to others. 
 - Knowledge: Ensures processes are clearly documented. Demonstrates a basic understanding of the functions and technologies of the product. Learns about multiple test techniques, tools and business context and technologies of the software used. Addresses problems, proposes solutions, and takes action to resolve, referring more complex issues to senior employees. 
 - Metrics: Creates and monitors status dashboards for tracking team progress
 - Quality Standards: Drives analysis of post release quality and defect escapes and implements improvements based on the results of analysis. Completes straightforward projects and provides input for enhancements to improve test coverage and processes. Assesses the testability of components and features built by development teams. Works with project team to establish quality standards or metrics and identify risks. 
 - Test Strategy & Planning: Identifies salient test cases based on product domain knowledge and traceability to use cases, enabling on-time sprint deployments. Writes effective and efficient test scripts and test cases. Reviews of test plans are thoughtful and considerate of the customer and time frames needed for releases. 
 - Test Execution: Ensures thorough and complete resolution and closure of tickets once deployed to production. Assists developers in desk checks and testing. Works with the team to ensure code is tested at the appropriate level, assists in gaining efficiencies. Identifies and prevents defects early. Proactively works to identify the root cause of problems and identifies efficient ways to reproduce issues. Contributes to bug triage and prioritization processes. 
 - Mentorship: Provides peer level technical guidance for team members. Helps more junior team members learn, grow and contribute to the team. 

YOU ARE

- Genuinely curious - you ask why, not just whether. You want to understand why a tag fires in a specific sequence, what the Liquid personalization token is supposed to render for a given profile, and what a consent mode change means downstream for pixel data. You treat every testability gap as a signal worth investigating, not an obstacle to work around. 
 - Shift-left by default. You don't wait for a build to find problems. You read acceptance criteria like an auditor - spotting what's missing, what's ambiguous, and what will create a defect if it isn't clarified before dev starts. Refinement is where your value shows up first. 
 - A master of async defect communication. You file bugs the way a distributed team needs you to - self-contained, structured, and immediately actionable. A QA defect in your queue is never a mystery that needs a Zoom call to decode. Your documentation is your reputation. 
 - Globally minded, with experience working on geographically distributed teams. You understand the discipline, cadence, and over-communication required to make a US-India collaboration genuinely cohesive - and you've built those habits in practice. 
 - Methodical and detail-oriented - you understand that a missed pixel fire or a broken personalization token has real downstream consequences for marketing measurement and campaign performance. You bring that care to every test case you write and every defect you file. 
 - A collaborative teammate, comfortable working across engineering, product, analytics, and marketing functions within a globally distributed model. You don't stay in a QA swim lane - you go where quality needs attention. 

YOU HAVE

- Bachelor's Degree required Computer Science, Information Systems or a related field. An equivalent combination of education and experience may be considered. 
 - 4+ years' experience
 - Proficiency with Postman for API testing - structured request/response validation, test data generation, role-based access checks, and SLA timing verification. 
 - Experience with email QA - template render testing using Email on Acid, Litmus, or equivalent; familiarity with ESP platform testing (Zeta, Braze, Emarsys, or similar). 
 - Working knowledge of tag management QA - understanding what tag management systems do, how to use browser developer tools to validate tag fires, and how to read data layer objects against a specification. Experience with the Adobe Experience Platform Debugger or equivalent tag debugging tooling is strongly preferred. 
 - Solid understanding of agile/Scrum delivery - shift-left quality practices, sprint ceremony participation, Definition of Ready and Definition of Done as quality gates, QA sizing in sprint planning. 
 - Experience with Jira for defect tracking, defect lifecycle management, and sprint ticket status workflows. 
 - Experience testing across a multi-phase test lifecycle: QA → SIT → UAT → E2E → Production validation. 
 - Demonstrated experience working on a globally distributed or cross-timezone team - including a US-India GCC model, offshore delivery, or equivalent. Prior experience collaborating with remote stakeholders is strongly preferred. 
 - Strong written and verbal English communication skills - including the ability to write async-friendly defect reports, test status updates, and QA documentation that remote teammates can act on independently without a live call. 

Nice to Have

- Experience with Adobe Analytics validation - understanding how events, eVars, props, and conversion metrics are captured and how to confirm accuracy against a measurement plan (SDR). 
 - Familiarity with OneTrust or consent management platforms and how they gate tag firing (GDPR/CCPA context). 
 - Experience testing on Salesforce Commerce Cloud (SFCC) - navigating Business Manager for test data setup, order creation, and profile configuration. 
 - Knowledge of CI/CD pipeline integration for test automation - CircleCI, GitHub Actions, or equivalent; understanding of artifact reporting and suite segmentation (smoke, regression, integration). 
 - Exposure to Liquid templating in ESP platforms - ability to validate personalization logic and token rendering in email templates.

Join us in advancing our mission to extend lives and expand possibilities. 

The Manager, Data Storage Platforms is responsible for leading a team of platform engineers overseeing the planning, the build, and the operations of data platforms. They will be responsible for architecting, engineering, and optimizing large‐scale, cloud‐native data platforms on AWS and Azure. This role leads development of event‐driven data architectures, CDC frameworks, data lake ingestion pipelines, and scalable ETL/ELT processes. The architect partners closely with cross‐functional teams, leads technical delivery, ensures operational excellence, and provides hands‐on support for global data transformation initiatives. They will be a part of the Data Services Platforms team and provide technological and process expertise and support the global domain data product delivery teams. They will provide leadership by assisting business partners in identifying and responding to opportunities for cost-effective data implementations and solutions by analyzing and making decisions that have cross functional business impact. 

Responsibilities

- Lead and mentor a team of data platform engineers
 - Accountable for strategic planning and technical roadmap development for data platforms. 
 - Oversee the design, implementation, and maintenance of data engineering pipelines in a multi-cloud environment, including integrations with a variety of data sources (including structured, semi-structured, and unstructured data)
 - Collaborate with the Domain Data Product Delivery teams and other stakeholders in Architecture, Data Integration, DevOps, and Data Governance to deliver data platform initiatives
 - Ensure data engineering standards align with industry best practices for data governance, data quality, and data security. 
 - Monitor and optimize the performance of data pipelines, ensuring they meet SLAs for data availability and quality. 
 - Evaluate and recommend new data technologies and tools to improve data engineering processes and outcomes, in collaboration with the Domain Data Product Delivery teams. 
 - Effectively communicate and realize vision and strategy for the organization that aligns with the business and patient needs.

 - Foster a collaborative work environment with strong working relationships within and across businesses and functions, and with strategic external partners.

- Bachelor's degree or higher in computer science or relevant subject area
 - Minimum 5+ years of progressive technical experience in one or more of the cloud-based data warehouse/data lake platforms such as AWS S3, Snowflake, Databricks, Microsoft Synapse. 
 - Significant experience in leading teams in Data & Analytics programs with experience in native digital technologies (cloud, big data and predictive) in organizations driving product development. 
 - Change Agent - Catalyst for the teams and expected to lead the transformation to a fail-fast-learn-fast culture enabling continual improvement. 
 - Servant Leader - Able to gain respect from their team and willing to get their hands dirty to get the job done. 
 - Courageous - Able to effectively challenge and influence peers and teams, leading them through difficult or uncertain situations. 
 - Significant experience working in a global matrix environment. 
 - Must be a strategic, innovative problem solver, and have strong influencing and communication skills. 
 - Strong knowledge of business process flow and/or entity relationship modeling. 
 - Demonstrated outstanding written and verbal communication skills. Ability to work effectively with other technology teams as well as business partners. Ability to effectively present information, interact with, and respond to questions from managers, employees, customers, and vendors
 - Experience in applying best practices to ELT/ETL data transformation from variety of data sources to AWS and other data warehouse platforms like Snowflake, Databricks, Microsoft Synapse etc. 

Required Technical Skills

- AWS CDK (TypeScript/Python)
 - AWS Glue (ETL, Catalog, Crawlers, Job Bookmarks)
 - AWS Lambda, API Gateway, SQS, SNS, Step Functions, EventBridge

 - AWS DMS

data.description:
Note: Looking for immediate joiners. 

Location options: Bengaluru, Pune, Hyderabad

Mandatory Tech Stack Experience: 

- AWS Bedrock
 - Agentcore
 - Python
 - LLM

Role Overview

A Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) works directly inside a strategic enterprise customer to design, build, deploy and run AI-powered production systems alongside the customer's engineering team. FDEs write production-grade software and own outcomes end to end, from prototype through enterprise-scale deployment. 

The role combines the technical rigor of a software engineer with the urgency and ownership needed to deliver measurable business outcomes. FDEs also create reusable architectures, patterns and engineering practices that help the wider FDE practice scale. 

Key Responsibilities: 

- Embed with customer engineering teams: Understand the customer's business processes, technical architecture and operational constraints. Turn ambiguous business problems into scalable, AI-enabled production systems. 
 - Build production AI applications: Design and develop production-grade software for AI and agentic workflows, including multi-agent orchestration, retrieval pipelines, workflow automation and decision intelligence. Integrate foundation models, customer data sources, APIs and existing applications into cohesive AI experiences. Optimize for latency, reliability, observability, cost and security. 
 - Own production: Take systems from design through production rollout and ongoing operations. Troubleshoot incidents across AI models, distributed systems, data pipelines and application services. Put in place monitoring, evaluations, guardrails, testing, CI/CD, rollback and resiliency mechanisms that keep AI systems healthy at scale. 
 - Accelerate customer transformation: Identify opportunities to expand AI adoption across customer workflows. Build reusable patterns, accelerators and reference architectures for future engagements. 
 - Raise the bar: Mentor engineers and contribute to engineering best practices for AI and forward deployment. Feed reusable components and learnings back into products and services. 

Core technical skills (must have): 

Python: Strong, production-grade Python: clean code, testing, APIs and integration with enterprise systems. 

Agentic AI on AWS:   Hands-on experience building multi-agent systems on Amazon Bedrock and Bedrock AgentCore, including prompt engineering, tool calling and agent orchestration with a framework (e. g. Strands Agents, LangGraph, LangChain). 

RAG & retrieval: Building retrieval pipelines: embeddings, chunking and vector search (e. g. Bedrock Knowledge Bases, OpenSearch, pgvector). 

Core AWS services: Working knowledge of serverless and container services, storage, security and networking on AWS (e. g. Lambda, API Gateway, ECS/EKS, S3, DynamoDB, IAM). 

Production engineering: Taking AI systems to production: CI/CD, automated testing, monitoring, evaluations and guardrails for AI output. 

Good to have: 

- Infrastructure as code (e. g. Terraform, AWS CDK) and containers (Docker). 
 - LLM evaluation and tracing tools (e. g. Bedrock Guardrails, RAGAS, Langfuse, OpenTelemetry). 
 - MCP (Model Context Protocol), agent-to-agent (A2A) patterns, or other frameworks such as CrewAI or LlamaIndex. 
 - API frameworks such as FastAPI, SQL, and event-driven services (e. g. Step Functions, SQS, EventBridge). 
 - A second language such as TypeScript/Node. js or Java. 
 - Amazon SageMaker, and model fine-tuning or customization on Bedrock. 
 - Experience in regulated industries (banking, capital markets, insurance): security reviews, audit and data-residency controls. 
 - AWS certifications: AI Practitioner, Machine Learning Engineer - Associate, Solutions Architect - Associate/Professional, or Generative AI Developer - Professional. 

Basic qualifications: 

- 5+ years of professional software development experience (excluding internships). 
 - 5+ years of programming in at least one software programming language. 
 - 5+ years leading design or architecture of new and existing systems (design patterns, reliability and scaling). 
 - Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team. 

Preferred qualifications: 

- Experience building production AI or ML applications, including agentic workflows. 
 - 5+ years across the full software development life cycle: coding standards, code reviews, source control, build processes, testing and operations. 
 - Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent. 
 - Strong written and verbal communication skills; comfortable working in customer-facing environments.

data.description:
BUREAU VERITAS | HR SHARED SERVICES HUB, NOIDA

Service Delivery Manager - Performance & Continuous Improvement

Intelligent Command Centre (ICC) & Transformation Lead - all towers

Tower

Cross-tower: Performance, Governance & Continuous Improvement

Location

Noida, India (HR Shared Services Hub)

Reports to

HR SSC Regional Hub Director, Noida

Role type

People manager

Scope

Intelligent Command Centre, SLA and KPI governance, continuous improvement portfolio, transition PMO support and hub quality management

Grade

About The Hub

Bureau Veritas is building a greenfield HR Shared Services hub in Noida. The hub will bring HR operations that currently run separately in each country into one standardised, digitally enabled service centre. You will design your tower, move work into Noida in structured waves, and run it at scale to global standards. 

ROLE PURPOSE

You are the hub's performance and improvement engine. You will build the Intelligent Command Centre that gives leaders one real-time view of service health across every tower. You will also run the continuous improvement system that moves the hub from stable operations to best-in-class service. 

Key Responsibilities

- Transition and shared services set-up
 - Design the hub's performance framework: a KPI tree, SLA definitions, data sources and a reporting cadence shared by all towers. 
 - Capture and certify the pre-transition baselines for each country, so the hub can prove its value against the starting point. 
 - Support the transition PMO with readiness scorecards, go/no-go dashboards and hypercare tracking for every wave. 
 - Set up the Intelligent Command Centre, covering architecture, data pipelines, dashboards and alerting. 
 - Process ownership and service delivery
 - Run the ICC day to day, with real-time SLA, volume, backlog and escalation monitoring across R2P, R2H, Q2R and A2W. 
 - Lead the hub's governance rhythm: daily stand-ups, weekly tower reviews, monthly service reviews and quarterly business reviews with stakeholders. 
 - Own the hub-wide customer voice programme, including CSAT and NPS surveys, closing the loop with respondents, and reporting insight. 
 - Run hub-level capacity and productivity analytics to support resourcing decisions. 
 - Governance, risk and controls
 - Own the hub quality management system, covering process documentation standards, internal quality audits and control testing across towers. 
 - Maintain the hub risk register and the tracking of issues and actions. 
 - Build data governance for performance reporting so that there is one version of the truth. 
 - Continuous improvement and digital
 - Build and govern the hub-wide continuous improvement backlog. Prioritise by value and effort, and agree ownership with each GPO. 
 - Lead improvement projects using Lean, Six Sigma and process mining. Track benefits through to realised savings. 
 - Run the hub's automation and AI pipeline, from idea intake to business case, delivery and benefits tracking. 
 - Build a continuous improvement culture through training, recognition and a simple way for every employee to raise ideas. 
 - People leadership, performance and culture
 - Build the tower's team from the ground up. Define the structure, spans of control, role profiles and hiring plan for each transition wave. 
 - Recruit, onboard and develop team leads and specialists. Build succession cover for every critical role before the tower reaches steady state. 
 - Run a disciplined people-performance cycle covering goal setting, monthly one-to-ones, quarterly reviews and calibrated year-end ratings. 
 - Keep attrition, absence and engagement at or better than hub targets. Act early on hotspots. 
 - Model the hub culture of ownership, customer focus, speed with control and learning. Make it visible in how the team works every day.

You will be the architect who wins the technical deal. Before a contract is signed, you show enterprise customers that their AI agents will work, at their scale and under their rules. You build the demos and proofs of concept, answer the architecture questions, and hand delivery a plan they can execute. This is a hands-on engineering role in front of customers. • Design: produce reference architectures for agent deployment on AWS, Azure or GCP, covering identity, data access, observability and guardrails. 

• De-risk: answer security, compliance and model-risk questionnaires (SOC 2, data residency, audit logging, human-in-the-loop controls). 

• Hand off: turn every won proof of concept into a delivery plan our forward-deployed engineers can run from day one. 

• Feed back: bring field patterns to product and build reusable demo assets, templates and starter agents. 

What we are looking for

• 8+ years in software engineering, solutions engineering, solutions architecture or forward-deployed engineering for enterprise customers. 

• Hands-on experience building LLM applications or agents: prompt and tool design, RAG, evaluation, and at least one agent framework. 

• Strong Python, plus working knowledge of APIs, containers and one major cloud. 

• Comfort in regulated environments, where governance, auditability and access control decide the deal.

• Understanding of tool calling and MCP, guardrails and policy controls, access management, observability and audit trails.

data.description:
Job Specification: 

We are seeking a Lead Java Engineer to head the XiP Compute Service (XCS) team - the engine room of Citi's enterprise-scale XiNG Platform (XiP), responsible for orchestrating and executing 1. 5 billion risk calculations every day. 

As the lead of the XCS team, you will own the design, development, and evolution of the most performance-critical component within XiP. XiP is Citi's unified risk calculation platform built on the XiNG quantitative libraries standard, and XCS sits at its core - providing the powerful compute paradigms and guardrails that enable calculations to run reliably at massive scale. 

Your team is the engine that daily coordinates hundreds of thousands of pods, consumes tens of thousands of compute nodes, utilises hundreds of TB of memory, and distributes hundreds of millions of calculations across Citi's private cloud and Public cloud infrastructures. The platform is both highly performant and rapidly evolving, and your leadership will be central to driving it to its next generation of scale, efficiency, and capability. 

You will work closely with other software engineers, DevOps, and our customers to define technical strategy and ensure the reliable, secure, and scalable operation of the platform. 

Responsibilities

Take a lead in defining the long-term strategic direction of the XiP Platform: 

Apply your experience and skills to develop the future versions of the calculation engine. This means making it faster, utilize resources better, and scale to even greater sizes. This means adding new features without impacting performance of the platform in an undesirable manner, as small changes multiplied by millions of calculations have a high cost. This means solving hard problems like transferring small amounts of data to a huge number of machines. 

Take on the day-to-day leadership of the development team: 

Lead the team's Agile/Scrum ceremonies, including sprint planning, daily stand-ups, and retrospectives, to ensure a smooth and effective development workflow. Manage the project backlog, prioritize tasks, and coordinate development efforts to align with the product roadmap and strategic goals. Provide hands-on technical leadership, guiding the team in architectural decisions and enforcing coding standards. 

Serve as advisor or coach to team members, allocating and overseeing work: 

Mentor and guide developers, providing technical advice, code reviews, and career development support. Allocate tasks based on skill sets and project priorities, ensuring balanced workloads and timely delivery. Foster a collaborative and growth-oriented team environment, encouraging best practices and continuous learning. 

Lead the implementation of changes and improvements to Citi's Risk Calculation Engine: 

Lead the design, development, and implementation of enhancements to the Risk Calculation Engine, focusing on optimizing its distribution mechanisms. Analyze current parallelization strategies, which regularly handle 250, 000 hours of compute in a single 90-minute execution, and identify opportunities to further improve efficiency, scalability, and throughput. 

Plan, coordinate, and execute strategic changes to the engine to reach the next scaling milestone: 

Develop and manage strategic initiatives aimed at scaling the Risk Calculation Engine to meet future business demands. Coordinate with stakeholders to ensure that all scaling efforts are aligned with customer needs.

data.title: AI Quality Analyst
data.description:
About The Opportunity

Avenue Code is looking for an AI Quality Analyst to work with Fanatics as part of its AI/ML Platform team. 

The AI/ML Platform team builds and supports Fanatics' internal AI platform, including the gateway, agent runtime, registry, retrieval, and evaluation infrastructure used by teams developing solutions with LLMs and AI agents. 

As the team's dedicated AI Quality Analyst, you will be responsible for evaluating whether AI agents are performing as expected. You will run evaluation sets, review outputs against established rubrics, maintain high-quality ground-truth datasets, identify failure patterns, and provide actionable findings to the engineering and product teams responsible for each agent. 

This is a 12-month contract opportunity based in Hyderabad, India, following a hybrid work model. 

Responsibilities

- Run evaluation sets against production and pre-release AI agents on a regular cadence and following meaningful changes to prompts, models, tools, or retrieval systems. 
 - Analyze and report evaluation results, including pass rates, regressions, trends, and recurring failure patterns. 
 - Review AI agent outputs against defined quality rubrics covering correctness, grounding, tool-use accuracy, safety, tone, and output format. 
 - Score outputs consistently, document edge cases, and identify areas where evaluation rubrics need clarification or improvement. 
 - Curate and maintain ground-truth datasets used to evaluate AI and LLM-based applications. 
 - Create, review, and validate golden answers and expected outputs for evaluation cases. 
 - Classify failures by root cause, including prompt issues, retrieval failures, incorrect tool usage, or model-related errors. 
 - Identify and retire outdated, ambiguous, or low-quality evaluation cases. 
 - Compare LLM-as-a-judge evaluation results against human review and identify discrepancies between automated and human scoring. 
 - Provide agent owner teams with reproducible examples, severity assessments, and suspected root causes for identified issues. 
 - Partner with engineering and product teams to track fixes and re-run evaluations until issues are resolved. 
 - Convert production failures, user feedback, and user corrections into new evaluation cases to continuously improve evaluation coverage. 
 - Use Python and SQL to execute evaluation scripts, analyze results, investigate traces, and identify patterns in agent behavior. 
 - Write clear and concise quality reports, bug reports, and evaluation summaries for technical and product stakeholders. 

Required Qualifications

- 3+ years of professional experience in Quality Assurance, Data Annotation, Data Analytics, AI Quality, or another evidence-driven role. 
 - At least 1 year of hands-on experience reviewing or evaluating outputs from LLMs, conversational AI systems, chatbots, or AI agents. 
 - Strong ability to evaluate open-ended AI-generated content consistently using predefined scoring rubrics. 
 - Ability to clearly explain and defend evaluation decisions based on defined criteria and evidence. 
 - Working knowledge of Python and SQL for running evaluation scripts, analyzing datasets, and investigating results. 
 - Understanding of common failure modes in LLM applications, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), tool calling, and agent workflows. 
 - Ability to distinguish between issues caused by retrieval, prompting, tools, data, and model hallucinations. 
 - Experience creating or maintaining ground-truth datasets, golden answers, or labeled evaluation datasets. 
 - Strong analytical skills and attention to detail. 
 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to document findings clearly for engineers and product stakeholders. 
 - Fluent written and spoken English. 
 - Ability to maintain regular overlap with US working hours for team collaboration and pod syncs. 
 - Familiarity with AI observability, tracing, or evaluation platforms such as Langfuse, Arize Phoenix, or similar tools is a plus. 

Nice To Have Skills

- Familiarity with Langfuse, Arize Phoenix, or similar tracing and eval tools
 - Understanding of RAG
 - Understanding of tool calling
 - Understanding of agent loops/workflows
 - Ability to distinguish retrieval misses vs. model hallucinations
 - Familiarity with LLM-as-a-judge calibration against human review
 - Experience curating ground-truth datasets / golden answers

Candidate data shared with Avenue Code will be kept confidential and will not be transmitted to disinterested third parties, nor will it be used for purposes other than the application for open positions. data.title: Senior Enterprise Software Engineer
data.description:
Wolters Kluwer is seeking a motivated and talented DevSecOps Senior Engineer to join our dynamic team. This is an exciting opportunity for an individual with hands-on experience in mature software engineering and a DevSecOps environment to further develop their skills and make a meaningful impact within a forward-thinking organization. As a DevSecOps Senior Engineer, you will play a crucial role in supporting our engineering team, contributing to the development, maintenance, and enhancement of our enterprise cloud platform. 

In this role, you will be responsible for working closely with various stakeholders, including our experienced engineering team, Cloud Operations, Security, Compliance, and other key partners. Your primary focus will be on engineering practices to streamline our software development processes, enhance efficiency, and ensure the reliability and scalability of our cloud platform. You will gain hands-on experience with a variety of DevSecOps tools and application and platform technologies, helping to build and maintain our continuous integration and delivery pipelines, infrastructure as code, and automated deployment processes. 

You will be involved in a wide range of tasks, including application and platform automation, infrastructure management, monitoring, and performance optimization. Your foundational understanding of application and platform engineering concepts, practices, and tools will be critical as you contribute to the implementation of best practices and the optimization of our platform workflows. You will have the opportunity to learn from and collaborate with seasoned professionals, gaining valuable insights and experience that will help you grow in your career. 

As a DevSecOps Senior Engineer, you will be expected to actively participate in the design, development, and deployment of our cloud applications. You will work on projects that require keen attention to detail and a strong commitment to quality. Your ability to collaborate effectively with team members and communicate clearly will be essential in ensuring the successful delivery of our application and platform solutions. 

This position offers a fantastic opportunity for growth and career development within a supportive and innovative environment. You will have the chance to work with state-of-the-art technologies, be part of a collaborative and high-performing team and make a significant impact on our organization's success. If you are passionate about engineering and eager to take your career to the next level, we encourage you to apply and join our team at Wolters Kluwer. 

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

 - Ensure software and platforms comply with security standards and regulations. 
 - Implement security best practices and conduct regular security assessments. 
 - Adhere to access controls and protect sensitive data. 
 - Document processes, procedures, and infrastructure setups. 
 - Stay up to date with emerging technologies and industry trends. 
 - Continuously improve systems, processes, and methodologies. 
 - Participate in project planning and execution. 
 - Ensure projects are completed on time and within budget. 
 - Understand customer requirements and translate them into technical solutions. 
 - Engage with stakeholders to gather feedback and refine requirements. 
 - Ensure customer satisfaction through reliable and high-quality deliverables. 
 - Explore generative AI technologies to enhance software capabilities. 
 - Deploy AI models for automated content generation and predictive analytics. 

Other Duties

- Performs other duties as assigned by management
 - On call rotation responsibilities with the Service Delivery and Operations Team

Job Qualifications & Experience

Requirements: 

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Systems, or a related field
 - Minimum 1 year of experience with AI and Generative AI technologies or equivalent
 - Minimum of 5 years of hands-on experience in the DevSecOps engineering discipline, prefer enterprise engineering experience or equivalent 
 - Experience with Application and Infrastructure Operations
 - Proficiency in scripting languages (e. g. , Bash, Python) for automation tasks and infrastructure management. 
 - In-depth knowledge of programming frameworks (e. g. , . NET, JAVA) and application development.

 - Proficiency with CI/CD tools and practices (e. g. , Azure DevOps, Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions), including creating and managing pipelines.

Thought Leadership and Soft skills:

About DHL Blue Dart Express India: 

Blue Dart Express Limited, a listed company, is a leader in courier, integrated air express package distribution, and eCommerce in South Asia, offering a wide range of logistics solutions. Founded in 1983, it is recognised for reliable, time-bound, and secure delivery services across 55, 000+ locations in India as well as internationally. Its competencies span across evaluation and contracting, planning and transition, delivery and execution, and specific service capabilities. We pride ourselves on innovation, digitalization, service excellence, and creating long-term partnerships with our clients, enabling businesses to thrive in the fast-paced logistics environment and ever-evolving supply-chains. It wholly-owns India's only scheduled air cargo airline, Blue Dart Aviation Limited, since May 1994, and the Concorde Air Logistics Limited, a transport, storage, and communications business, since May 2004. 

Blue Dart Express Limited is a part of the DHL Group's DHL eCommerce division, leveraging this global logistics leader's network across 220 countries and territories to provide comprehensive express and logistics solutions to our clients. Our robust network and unmatched infrastructure have positioned the Blue Dart brand as a key India-grown logistics player with an unmatched and phenomenal global outreach rooted in the DHL brand of its majority shareholder. 

We are proud to be consistently ranked among India's Top 100 Great Places to Work, combining it with DHL Group's Top Employer certification. Being an Employer of Choice is not just a goal; it's a fundamental part of who we are, committed to creating a workplace where people are valued, empowered, and wear the sobriquet "Blue Darter" with honour. 

If you are looking to join a purpose-led, people-first, company that shapes India's supply-chains with integrity and safety, Blue Dart is where you belong. Blue Dart offers competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits, access to cross-functional, succession planning and global career paths, and strong culture of recognition. 

Position Overview: 

The Service Centre Incharge - Operations (Non Metro / BDO) is responsible for managing end-to-end operational activities across one or more assigned Non Metro Branches, Business Development Offices (BDOs) or Service Centres. The role oversees inbound and outbound shipment processing, pickup and delivery coordination, customer service support, manpower deployment and operational governance to ensure seamless day-to-day operations. 

Reporting to the Assistant Manager - Operations (Area Operations), the incumbent provides frontline leadership to operational teams, ensuring adherence to service commitments, operational productivity, safety, compliance and Blue Dart's Standard Operating Procedures while delivering consistent customer experience and supporting business continuity across the assigned locations. 

Job Purpose: 

To lead and manage end-to-end shift operations across assigned Non Metro Branches and BDO locations by ensuring efficient shipment processing, timely pickups and dispatches, optimal workforce utilisation, operational discipline and consistent service delivery while maintaining safety, compliance and customer satisfaction. 

Key Roles & Responsibilities: 

End-to-End Shift Operations

- Lead and supervise all inbound, outbound, pickup and dispatch activities during the assigned shift. 
 - Ensure timely receipt, processing, sorting, scanning, loading and dispatch of shipments in line with operational timelines. 
 - Monitor operational workflow across assigned BDOs and Service Centres to ensure seamless shipment movement. 
 - Ensure operational readiness to manage daily volumes, peak periods and contingency situations. 

Shipment Processing & Service Quality

- Ensure accurate scanning, sorting, bagging, routing and reconciliation of all shipments. 
 - Minimise shipment exceptions, operational delays and service failures through proactive monitoring. 
 - Ensure adherence to network cut-off timelines and service commitments. 
 - Escalate damaged, short, discrepant or delayed shipments promptly and ensure timely resolution. 

Pickup & Delivery Operations

- Coordinate daily pickup and delivery activities to achieve defined service levels. 
 - Monitor route readiness and shipment movement to ensure timely customer service. 
 - Support resolution of operational issues impacting deliveries and pickups. 
 - Coordinate with transport, network and customer service teams to ensure smooth operational execution. 

People Leadership & Shift Management

- Plan and deploy manpower effectively across operational activities and assigned locations. 
 - Lead, coach and guide Ops Staff, Senior Ops Staff and Territory Service Representatives during the shift. 
 - Conduct daily shift briefings covering operational priorities, safety and productivity expectations. 
 - Monitor attendance, punctuality, discipline and workforce productivity while promoting teamwork and accountability. 

Safety, Compliance & Operational Discipline

- Ensure adherence to Blue Dart Standard Operating Procedures, operational guidelines and statutory requirements. 
 - Promote a safe working environment by ensuring compliance with safety standards and security procedures. 
 - Ensure prescribed uniform, identity card and personal protective equipment are used wherever applicable. 
 - Maintain high standards of housekeeping, operational discipline and ethical conduct across all assigned locations. 

Operational Governance & Continuous Improvement

- Monitor daily operational performance and productivity against defined targets. 
 - Ensure timely completion of operational documentation, system updates and shift reports. 
 - Conduct effective shift handovers and escalate operational risks or service issues promptly. 
 - Support implementation of operational excellence and continuous improvement initiatives. 

Stakeholder Collaboration

- Work closely with Customer Service, Fleet, Security, Network Operations and Area Operations teams to ensure seamless service delivery. 
 - Build effective working relationships across internal teams and operational partners. 
 - Support implementation of new operational initiatives, business priorities and process improvements. 
 - Act as the primary operational contact for assigned locations during the shift. 

Qualifications & Experience: 

Education: 

- Graduate in any discipline from a recognized university. 

Experience: 

- 2-5 years of relevant experience in courier, express logistics, transportation, warehousing, distribution or supply chain operations. 
 - Experience in managing end-to-end Service Centre operations, including inbound, outbound, pickup and delivery activities. 
 - Proven experience in leading frontline operational teams and coordinating shift operations. 
 - Exposure to shipment processing, scanning, sorting, reconciliation, dispatch and customer service operations. 
 - Experience working with operational systems, handheld scanners and operational reporting will be an advantage. 

Skills & Capabilities: 

Technical Skills: 

- End-to-End Shift Operations Management 
 - Service Centre Operations 
 - Shipment Processing & Dispatch Management 
 - Pickup & Delivery Coordination 
 - Workforce Planning & Shift Management 
 - Productivity & Resource Utilization 
 - Operational Reporting & MIS 
 - Operational Systems & Scanner Usage 
 - Safety & Regulatory Compliance 
 - Process Improvement & Operational Excellence

Key Competencies: 

- Operational Leadership 
 - Planning & Organising 
 - Decision Making 
 - Customer Focus 
 - Team Leadership & Coaching 
 - Problem Solving 
 - Accountability & Ownership 
 - Communication & Collaboration 
 - Integrity & Ethical Conduct 
 - Operational Discipline 
 - Continuous Improvement Mindset

Key Performance Indicators: 

KRAs

KPIs

Operational Performance

Inbound & Outbound SLA adherence; On-time shipment processing; Dispatch timeliness

Service Quality

Shipment accuracy; Scanning compliance; Reduction in shipment exceptions and operational errors

Pickup & Delivery Performance

Pickup & Delivery SLA adherence; Timely vehicle turnaround; Customer service support

Productivity

Shift productivity; Manpower utilization; Resource optimization

Safety & Compliance

SOP adherence; Audit compliance; Safety & security compliance; Housekeeping standards

Operational Governance

Shift reporting accuracy; Timely documentation; Effective shift handover; Timely escalation of operational issues

People Leadership

Team productivity; Coaching & capability development; Attendance & workforce discipline

Continuous Improvement

Participation in process improvement initiatives; Productivity and service enhancement

Why join DHL Blue Dart?

When you join us, you're not just taking a job-you're becoming part of a purpose-led movement that's reshaping the future of logistics across India and the world. At Blue Dart, we don't just deliver parcels-we deliver excellence, innovation, and opportunity every day. 

Here's what makes us stand out:

 - A culture that celebrates diversity, innovation, and bold thinking-where your voice is heard and your contributions matter. 
 - Global career paths across the DHL Group, opening doors to opportunities in 220+ countries and territories.

This is your chance to do meaningful work, build a career without borders, and thrive in a company that's not just a logistics leader-but a Great Place to Work. Come grow with us.

Relevant certifications (preferred):

data.title: Software Product Assurance Engineer
data.description:
ReOrbit is looking for a motivated and detail oriented Software Product Assurance Engineer for Space Systems to join our growing team. 

As our new Software Product Assurance Engineer, you will play a key role in ensuring the quality, reliability, and safety of software throughout the spacecraft development lifecycle. You will define and evolve software product assurance requirements, adapted to lean and agile development practices, while applying a criticality-based approach where the level of rigour is aligned with the safety and mission impact of each software item. 

You will work closely with software, systems, hardware, AIT, Product Assurance and supplier teams to ensure that software development, verification, configuration management and change control activities meet the required quality and product assurance standards. 

It's an exciting chance to join a dynamic start-up, with the opportunity to make a real impact, to reach our goal of pushing the boundaries of space data transfer. 

Responsibilities

- Define and evolve software product assurance requirements across the development lifecycle, adapted to lean and agile development practices. 
 - Apply a criticality-based approach to software product assurance, scaling the level of rigour according to the safety and mission impact of the software item. 
 - Develop, implement, monitor and review Software Product Assurance (SW PA) plans. 
 - Oversee and participate in verification and validation (V&V) activities according to defined V&V plans. 
 - Support Independent Verification and Validation (IV&V) activities, working with IV&V personnel to mitigate software risks and enhance safety and quality. 
 - Help drive internal and external reviews of development plans and software designs to ensure seamless integration with the satellite system. 
 - Participate in the analysis and evaluation of software designs, including change impact analysis and regression testing, particularly for COTS software. 
 - Support Product Assurance activities across engineering and flight models and associated infrastructure, ensuring documentation and objective evidence are captured consistently. 
 - Contribute to estimating and tracking the expected reliability and availability of the satellite platform as part of Product Assurance reporting. 
 - Support Product Assurance follow-up on supplier discrepancies and defects, ensuring corrective actions are documented and tracked. 
 - Support engineering change control, including understanding the Class I / Class II concept and ensuring the required approvals are obtained. 
 - Be willing to travel to supplier facilities for audits when required. 

Skills And Requirements

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in aerospace, electronics, information technology, systems engineering and minimum 8 years of work experience in a similar relevant field. 
 - Knowledge of software development processes and lifecycles. 
 - Knowledge of software verification techniques, including testing and inspections. 
 - Knowledge of software configuration management fundamentals and related tools. 
 - Clear conceptual understanding of the difference between proactive Product Assurance and retrospective Quality Control. 
 - Familiarity with non-conformances, deviations, waivers, and corrective/preventive actions, including RCA and CAPA, at a basic level. 
 - Awareness of SW Product Assurance principles and the ECSS/Q Product Assurance philosophy. 
 - Ability to constructively challenge engineering decisions and ask, "What is the risk?"
 - Comfortable working cross-functionally with systems, hardware, software, AIT and suppliers. 
 - Clear and effective technical writing and communication skills in English, both written and spoken. 
 - Previous exposure to satellite technologies through an internship, thesis, or student satellite project (e. g. CubeSat, nanosat or payloads), with an understanding of software Product Assurance concepts such as verification matrices, test coverage and configuration management. 
 - Introductory knowledge of risk management and single-point failure identification, with proficiency in C/C++ and Python and familiarity with NASA software assurance standards such as NASA-STD-8739. 8 and NASA-GB-8719. 13. 

What does ReOrbit do?

ReOrbit builds the foundation for the next generation of space applications by transforming satellites into truly intelligent, interconnected platforms, defined by software. Our satellite design philosophy revolves around the idea that satellites must network, communicate with each other and thus improve mission efficiency. How can this be achieved? Thanks to a flexible software-first architecture, where all these aspects are dealt with upfront in the mission concept, as integrated functionalities. 

ReOrbit's top-notch team of software engineers and system architects develop in-house software, procure hardware from the best-in-class suppliers, and seamlessly integrate the components to create flexible and secure satellites. Today, we are a rapidly growing company building a very strong multidisciplinary team to support our activities. We are headquartered in Helsinki, Finland with a subsidiaries in Bristol, UK, Bariloche, Argentina and Bengaluru, India. 

Working at ReOrbit

At ReOrbit, we are focused on building a strong team as we believe nothing can be accomplished without innovative, humble and curious minds working together on a common goal. We're all about fostering an inclusive, dynamic environment where equality and diversity are our strength. 

We offer

- Challenging but rewarding environment - you will thrive if you are always reflecting on how to make things better. Your ideas will be heard. 
 - Ambitious and supportive network of people, who are motivated to change the space industry, bringing expertise from both classic and new space . 
 - Benefits such as lunch vouchers, events, parties, occupational health care and additional health insurance - but most importantly a possibility to be a part of a unique and diverse team, connected by similar mindset and sense of humor. 
 - We like to spend time together! You can choose activities whichever is to your liking - runOrbit, climbOrbit; become ping pong or board games champion. 

Join us in our journey of building software enabled satellites for secure communications

and, thus, creating the most compelling in space data flow company of the new space era. 

The Company may require a security clearance for certain positions. Any such security clearance will be conducted in accordance with applicable law and the Company's relevant policies

For agencies: We do not accept unsolicited CVs for our open vacancies. Any CV sent to our team unsolicited will reserve us the right to pursue a candidate without obligation to the sender. All candidate submissions must be conducted through our official channels and in accordance with our terms of engagement.

The Senior Software Test Engineer role ensures delivery of high‐quality, reliable, and secure software by leading comprehensive testing across distributed, microservices‐based applications. It involves designing and executing test cases, supporting automation frameworks, and integrating testing into CI/CD pipelines to validate functionality, performance, and scalability. By collaborating with cross‐functional teams, identifying and documenting issues, and driving continuous improvement, the role enhances product stability and accelerates delivery cycles. 

Responsibilities

- The Senior Software Test Engineer role ensures delivery of high‐quality, reliable, and secure software by leading comprehensive testing across distributed, microservices‐based applications.

data.title: Senior Mechanical Engineer Manager
data.description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for a senior, hands-on mechanical engineering leader to manage the engineering team and own final technical quality control across our engineering workstreams. These include CAD and engineering design data, simulation load cases, and reviews of FEA and CFD work used in AI development. 

You will assess whether deliverables are technically sound, supported by evidence, and ready for client delivery. The role combines broad engineering judgment with detailed technical review, guidance for engineers and external partners, and ownership of consistent quality standards as delivery scales. 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

• Own final technical review and sign-off across workstreams; identify critical issues, request corrections, and verify their resolution before delivery. 

• Review CAD models, assemblies, drawings, design changes, and engineering rationale for functional validity, consistency, and manufacturability. 

• Evaluate FEA and CFD simulation assumptions, material properties, loads, boundary conditions, mesh quality, results, and relevant modelling choices; assess convergence, physical plausibility, and whether conclusions are supported. 

• Review load-case definitions and engineering workflows for realistic use scenarios, clear documentation, and traceability between requirements, models, and outputs. 

• Define acceptance criteria and review checklists, resolve technical disagreements, and involve specialist reviewers where deeper domain expertise is needed. 

• Manage and mentor engineers, assess vendor and freelancer capability, and improve review processes to increase throughput while maintaining quality. 

• Communicate directly with customers to clarify technical requirements, discuss review findings, and explain risks and limitations; align with project leads on delivery readiness. 

REQUIREMENTS

• Degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related discipline, with 6+ years of relevant industry experience and demonstrated technical leadership at lead or head of engineering level. 

• Experience working with international teams and coordinating quality across multiple projects and external partners. 

• Strong foundations in design, engineering and manufacturing, supported by experience solving real industrial engineering problems. 

• Hands-on expertise in CAD and FEA, with sufficient breadth to evaluate CFD work alongside specialists and recognise the limits of an analysis. 

• Experience reviewing and approving other engineers' work, challenging assumptions, and making defensible technical decisions. 

• Proficiency in relevant CAD and simulation tools, such as SolidWorks, Ansys, Abaqus, Fluent, or Simcenter.

data.title: Software Engineering Manager, Agentic Transformation for Graphics Systems
data.description:
Agents are changing how all software will be built. Agentic systems can perform substantial engineering work. It is still unproven whether they can be a reliable production capability at graphics systems' quality standards. Meanwhile, teams continue shipping new features, sustaining platforms, and meeting product commitments. Graphics drivers are a difficult proving ground. They involve large codebases, complex hardware-OS interactions, strict performance demands, broad application compatibility, and formal safety obligations in automotive. 

NVIDIA seeks an engineering manager in India to develop a new framework for agentic software development. You will test this model against one of our most fast-paced production software stacks. You will lead a graphics systems team through this transition and continue delivering the necessary product roadmap. Afterwards, you will transform effective practices into a reusable engineering product for other teams. You will grow the people, technology, and operating model together, creating an ambitious, highly engaged team that uses agents to surpass typical capacity. Success goes beyond one team's transformation; it establishes a production-proven system for software development in the agentic era at NVIDIA. 

What You'll Be Doing

- Develop and launch an end-to-end production model for agentic software development. Apply it to graphics systems, where agents perform engineering tasks from requirements and diagnosis to implementation, validation, review, and release. 
 - Define the technical strategy and transformation roadmap, turning fast paced agentic capabilities into dependable production execution and steadily growing the work agents complete end to end. 
 - Keep the team delivering its must-do graphics and display roadmap. This includes new features, platform enablement, performance, stability, and release commitments. At the same time, fundamentally evolve how that work gets done. 
 - Build an ambitious, highly engaged team that produces outstanding results, nurturing engineers and technical leaders alongside the technology and operating model. 
 - Transform the established agentic engineering system into a reusable product for other teams. Package its orchestration, skills, tools, evaluations, validators, and operating methods. Collaborate across NVIDIA to encourage adoption with measurable production outcomes. 

What We Need To See

- Demonstrated experience developing and delivering production software via autonomous engineering systems that include planning, tool application, retrieval, memory, evaluation, and validation, with agents handling a significant portion of actual engineering tasks. 
 - Demonstrated ability to turn a fast paced and ambiguous technical opportunity into a clear strategy, roadmap, and measurable production system while keeping an existing product roadmap on track. 
 - 10+ overall years of software engineering experience, including 3+ years of engineering management or technical leadership, with a degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or equivalent experience. 
 - Strong technical foundations in complex production software, including systems architecture, debugging, validation, CI/CD, and release engineering. 
 - High-agency, results-focused leadership: you build an environment where people grow, enjoy doing their best work, and use technology to deliver results far beyond the team's traditional capacity. 

Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd

- Acknowledged advancements in the field of agentic systems, shown through peer-reviewed publications, widely embraced open-source projects, public benchmarks, or other externally validated outcomes. 
 - Experience with graphics or display driver development and technologies such as Vulkan, OpenGL ES, EGL, SurfaceFlinger, HWC, Gralloc, UMD/KMD drivers, X11, or Wayland. 
 - Familiarity with NVIDIA DRIVE OS and experience developing safety-critical automotive software using standards such as ISO 26262 and ASIL. 
 - Meaningful contributions to the Linux kernel, graphics software ecosystem, developer tools, or other broadly adopted systems software. 

NVIDIA is widely considered one of the technology world's most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking people in the world working with us. If you are a creative and autonomous engineering leader who wants to invent how the most demanding production software will be built in the agentic era and prove it by helping real driver teams ship, we would love to hear from you. 

, , JR2024865
