data.title: ASIC Digital Design, Sr Manager
data.description:
We Are

Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow. 

You Are

You have spent the better part of your career building and verifying silicon that actually ships, not just passes simulation. You know that verification is where the real complexity lives, where assumptions break, and where a good engineer becomes a great one by catching the corner case no one thought to write down. Leading a team is not about delegation for you, it is about building engineers who think critically, ask the right questions, and take ownership of the hard problems. 

You have been in the room when a design looked perfect on paper but fell apart under real stimulus. That experience taught you to build verification environments that stress the design in ways the architect did not anticipate. Mentorship matters to you because you remember the engineers who shaped how you think, and you want to do that for others. 

Managing multiple projects does not overwhelm you because you have learned to prioritize what matters, push back when timelines do not match reality, and keep your team focused on the work that moves the needle. You are technical enough to review a testbench architecture and organizational enough to keep three projects on track without losing sight of the people doing the work. 

At Synopsys, you will lead verification for complex ASIC designs that power the products our customers build, and you will do it with a team that values depth, rigor, and getting it right. 

What You'll Be Doing

- Lead a team of design and verification engineers in Noida, managing performance, growth, and day-to-day execution across multiple ASIC projects
 - Own the verification strategy and environment architecture for complex, high-speed protocol designs, defining testplans and coverage models that catch real issues
 - Drive technical decisions around verification flows, including SystemVerilog, UVM, behavioral modeling, and coverage-driven verification
 - Work directly with architects, RTL designers, and VIP teams to align on design intent, resolve ambiguities, and ensure functional correctness before tapeout
 - Identify design gaps and propose corrective actions when documented functionality does not match implementation or customer requirements
 - Reproduce and resolve customer-reported issues through deep technical analysis, working backward from symptoms to root cause
 - Continuously improve verification methodologies, tooling, and execution efficiency across the team

The Impact You Will Have

- Deliver functionally correct, high-performance silicon designs that ship to customers and power next-generation products
 - Build a team culture where engineers grow technically, take ownership, and solve hard problems without waiting for perfect direction
 - Reduce time-to-market by catching design issues early through rigorous verification and well-architected testbenches
 - Strengthen cross-functional collaboration between design, architecture, and verification, ensuring alignment and reducing late-stage surprises
 - Influence verification best practices across Synopsys, shaping how teams approach coverage, automation, and testbench design
 - Resolve customer issues faster and more thoroughly, building trust and long-term partnerships
 - Set the technical bar for what great verification looks like, raising the standard across projects and teams

What You'll Need

- 15+ years of hands-on experience in ASIC design and verification, with deep expertise in high-speed protocols and complex digital systems
 - Strong proficiency in Verilog, VHDL, and SystemVerilog for RTL design and verification
 - Proven experience building UVM-based verification environments, including testbench architecture, coverage analysis, and constraint-driven stimulus
 - Solid scripting skills in BASH, TCSH, PERL, PYTHON, or TCL for automation, flow development, and productivity tooling
 - Track record of managing and mentoring engineering teams, balancing technical leadership with people development
 - Experience working through ambiguous requirements, incomplete specs, or shifting priorities without losing momentum

Who You Are

- You can review a verification plan and immediately spot what is missing, whether it is a corner case, a coverage gap, or an unrealistic timeline
 - You give feedback that makes engineers better, not just feedback that checks a box during a review cycle
 - You are comfortable saying no when a project plan does not match reality, and you can explain why in a way that moves the conversation forward
 - You manage multiple projects without losing track of the details that matter, knowing when to dive deep and when to trust your team
 - You write and communicate clearly in English, whether it is a technical document, a status update, or a difficult conversation with a stakeholder
 - You adapt quickly when priorities shift, helping your team stay focused on what matters most without creating chaos

The Team You'll Be Part Of

Your recruiter will share more about the team structure and mission during the interview process. 

Rewards and Benefits

We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

Job Summary - AI Technical Lead. 

- Kumaran Systems is looking for an experienced AI Lead (Technical) to lead the design, development, and deployment of scalable, production-ready AI/ML solutions within its Equity Market Technology -Capital Markets domain. 

- The role will drive innovation in Generative AI, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Agentic AI workflows, and intelligent automation using the Microsoft Azure cloud platform. 

- The candidate will provide technical leadership to a team of AI engineers, collaborate closely with stakeholders, data scientists, and platform teams, and translate business requirements into robust, secure, and scalable AI solutions. 

- The role requires strong hands-on technical expertise, solution architecture capabilities, and the ability to lead AI initiatives from Concept to Production. 

Details of Employment: 

Location: Chennai, India

Work Location - Guindy Olympia Tech Park OR SIPCOT Siruseri. 

Mode of Employment - 3 days Hybrid in the Office. 

Employment Type: Full-Time, Permanent. 

Notice Period - 0 to 15 days from the date of the offer (Critical Requisition; hence the ask)

Key Responsibilities

1. AI Architecture and Solution Design

- Architect and lead the development of enterprise-grade RAG pipelines, including document ingestion, vector databases, embedding models, and retrieval strategies using Azure AI Search, FAISS, and Pinecone. 
 - Design and implement Agentic AI systems incorporating autonomous agents, multi-step planning, tool orchestration, reasoning workflows, and human-in-the-loop controls. 
 - Develop AI solutions that integrate with internal systems, including trading platforms, operations workbenches, and risk engines, to automate decision support, exception handling, and reporting. 
 - Establish standards for prompt engineering, AI guardrails, and evaluation frameworks, including offline evaluations, A/B testing, and automated regression testing.

- Lead the design, implementation, and management of AI/ML infrastructure on Microsoft Azure using Azure OpenAI Service, Azure AI Search, Azure Machine Learning, Azure Functions, and Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS).

 - Ensure compliance with enterprise cloud governance, data residency, and security requirements using Azure Private Endpoints, Managed Identity, Key Vault, and related security controls. 

3. AI Performance Optimization and Troubleshooting

- Diagnose and resolve production AI performance issues, including inference latency, embedding drift, retrieval quality degradation, hallucinations, and context-window limitations.

 - Establish AI observability through structured logging, distributed tracing across prompt processing, retrieval, and generation, and dashboards tracking latency (p50/p95/p99), retrieval recall, and answer relevance. 
 - Conduct root-cause analysis of AI system failures, including incorrect tool invocations, RAG retrieval failures, safety-filter false positives, and model regressions following version upgrades.

 - Deep hands-on experience with RAG architectures, including vector databases, embedding pipelines, chunking strategies, hybrid search (keyword + semantic), re-ranking, and retrieval evaluation. 
 - Proven track record of building Agentic AI systems, including multi-agent orchestration, tool-use patterns, planning loops, memory management, and fallback strategies. 
 - Strong proficiency in Azure Cloud services, including Azure OpenAI Service, Azure AI Search (formerly Cognitive Search), Azure Machine Learning, Azure Functions, AKS, and App Service. 
 - Experience troubleshooting AI performance issues, including inference latency optimization, token budgeting, embedding drift detection, hallucination mitigation, and cost management at scale. 
 - Proficiency in Python and at least one of the following: C#/. NET or TypeScript/Node. js.

Who We Are

The real world is the next frontier, and at Metropolis, we are creating the artificial intelligence to make it responsive. We are pioneering the Recognition Economy - a future where mundane repetition disappears and being known unlocks access, comfort, and belonging everywhere you go. From transforming parking and reservations into a seamless drive-in, drive-out experience for millions of Members to expanding our intelligence layer across retail and hospitality, we are building a world that feels instinctive and magical. The future isn't coming; it's here, and we need builders, innovators, and problem solvers to help us create it. 

Who You Are

Metropolis is seeking a Senior Software Engineer to join our AeroParker application development team to help drive our next phase of global growth. As a member of this engineering team, you will have the opportunity to design and build systems and features from the ground up, play a major role in defining our product direction, and mentor other engineers. The ideal candidate has a product-oriented mindset, a passion for scaling e-commerce platforms, and a deep commitment to technical excellence. This is a unique opportunity to build and scale an end-to-end mobility and pre-book platform impacting the everyday travel experiences of millions of people. 

What You'll Do

- Design, implement, and maintain the backend services that power the AeroParker pre-book parking and e-commerce platform
 - Be a key part of the entire development lifecycle, from initial ideation and technical specification to deployment
 - Moderate technical discussions, evaluate new techniques, and ensure our e-commerce architecture is constantly evolving
 - Leverage best practices in automation testing, TDD/BDD, and CI/CD to enable rapid iteration and feature launches
 - Help build a culture where production bugs are treated as constructive opportunities to improve the platform
 - Ensure that our distributed systems remain highly available, secure, and capable of handling high-volume consumer traffic across global airports
 - Work directly with global partners to build solutions and seamless API integrations that connect their products with the AeroParker platform
 - Experience leveraging AI tools to transform static workflows into responsive, high-output processes

What we're looking for

- MS or BS in Computer Science or equivalent work experience with strong fundamental computer science skills
 - 7+ years of software engineering experience, featuring advanced level knowledge of Scala, Java, or related languages
 - Demonstrate a proven track record of designing and delivering large-scale distributed systems and microservices in high-volume, consumer-facing applications
 - Possess robust experience with event-driven architectures and modern software design paradigms
 - Maintain a deep understanding of Agile engineering processes, including CI/CD pipelines and automated build/test/deploy workflows
 - Bring strong hands-on experience with database technologies, especially MySQL and PostgreSQL
 - Demonstrate excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a proven ability to present complex technical architecture clearly to both engineering peers and cross-functional stakeholders
 - Possess familiarity or experience with additional stack components including TypeScript, React, Snowflake, AWS, Git, GitHub, Copilot on GitHub, and Datadog

While not required, these are a plus: 

- Possess hands-on experience with container technologies and "infrastructure as code" (IaC) techniques
 - Bring previous experience working with e-commerce platforms, data analysis tools, or complex third-party API integrations
 - Demonstrate a proactive interest or curiosity in emerging AI technologies to enhance productivity or customer experience
 - Possess experience working in innovative, fast-paced, high-growth SaaS environments

Our Stack

- Languages + Frameworks: Java, JavaEE, SpringBoot, JavaScript, JQuery
 - Datastores: MySQL
 - Cloud: AWS
 - Version Control: Git & Github

3 Days in Office: Metropolis values in-person collaboration to drive innovation, strengthen culture, and enhance the Member experience. Our corporate team members hold to our office-first model, which requires employees to be on-site at least four days a week, fostering organic interactions that spark creativity and connection

When you join Metropolis, you'll join a team of world-class product leaders and engineers, building an ecosystem of technologies at the intersection of parking, mobility, and real estate. Our goal is to build an inclusive culture where everyone has a voice and the best idea wins. 

Metropolis may utilize an automated employment decision tool (AEDT) to assess or evaluate your candidacy for employment or promotion. AEDTs are used to assist in assessing a candidate's application relative to the required job qualifications and responsibilities listed in the job posting. 

As part of this process, Metropolis retains data relevant to your candidacy, including personal information, for a period that is reasonably necessary for the use of the tool. If you are hired for the position, your data may become part of your employee records. 

Metropolis Technologies is an equal opportunity employer. We make all hiring decisions based on merit, qualifications, and business needs - without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including gender identity, sexual orientation, and pregnancy), national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under federal, state, or local law. 

We are committed to providing a welcoming, accessible hiring experience. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the application or interview process, please reach out to us at recruiting@metropolis. io.

Position Overview

This role combines deep networking expertise with full-stack engineering leadership to build enterprise-grade solutions that manage complex network infrastructures for our global customer base. 

Key Responsibilities

- Platform Architecture: Design scalable, multi-tenant architecture for managing thousands of network devices across customer environments
 - Advanced Network Analytics: Lead development of AI/ML-powered network analytics, predictive maintenance, and automated troubleshooting capabilities
 - Enterprise Integration: Architect integrations with major network vendors' management platforms and enterprise IT systems
 - Performance Engineering: Optimize platform performance for handling massive telemetry data streams from network devices
 - Security Architecture: Design zero-trust security models for secure device access and customer data protection
 - API Strategy: Lead design of comprehensive APIs for network automation, third-party integrations, and customer workflows
 - Edge Computing: Develop edge gateway solutions for on-premises network management in hybrid deployments
 - Scalability Planning: Architect solutions supporting enterprise customers with 10, 000+ managed devices
 - Technical Leadership: Mentor engineering teams and establish best practices for network software development
 - Customer Success: Work directly with enterprise customers on complex technical requirements and custom integrations

Advanced Technical Requirements

- Network Expertise: Deep knowledge of enterprise networking, SDN/SD-WAN, network virtualization, and modern networking protocols
 - Distributed Systems: Expert-level experience with microservices, event-driven architecture, and distributed data processing
 - Real-time Processing: Advanced experience with stream processing (Kafka, Apache Storm) for handling network telemetry at scale
 - Machine Learning: Experience applying ML to network analytics, anomaly detection, and predictive maintenance
 - Network Security: Deep understanding of network security protocols, certificate management, and secure device provisioning
 - Multi-vendor Integration: Extensive experience with network vendor APIs and management protocols across different manufacturers
 - Performance Optimization: Expert knowledge of database optimization for time-series data and high-throughput network metrics
 - Cloud Networking: Advanced knowledge of cloud networking services, VPC design, and hybrid cloud architectures

Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Network Engineering, or Electrical Engineering
 - 14+ years of software development experience with 5+ years in network management systems
 - Deep understanding of enterprise networking technologies and network operations centers (NOC)
 - Experience with major network vendors (Cisco, Juniper, Aruba, Fortinet, etc. ) and their management APIs
 - Proven track record building SaaS platforms serving enterprise customers
 - Experience with network certification programs (CCNA/CCNP knowledge preferred)
 - Strong background in both software engineering and network infrastructure

Company Statement

At NETGEAR, we are on a mission to unleash the full potential of connectivity with intelligent solutions that delight and protect. We turn ideas into innovative networking products that connect people, power businesses, and advance the way we live. 

We're a performance-driven, talented and connected team that's committed to delivering world-class products for our customers. As a company, we value our employees as the most essential building blocks of our success. And as teammates, we commit to taking our work to the Next Gear by living our values: we Dare to Transform the future, Connect and Delight our customers, Communicate Courageously with each other and collaborate to Win It Together. You'll find our values woven through our processes, present in our decisions, and celebrated throughout our culture. 

We strive to attract top talent and create a great workplace where people feel engaged, inspired, challenged, proud and respected. If you are creative, forward-thinking, passionate about technology and are looking for a rewarding career to make an impact, then you've got what it takes to succeed at NETGEAR. Join our network and help us shape the future of connectivity. 

NETGEAR hires based on merit. All qualified applicants will receive equal consideration for employment. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

data.title: LV Secondary System Engineer
data.description:
Job Description Summary

About GE Grid Solutions: At GE Grid Solutions we are electrifying the world with advanced grid technologies. As leaders in the energy space our goal is to accelerate the transition for a more energy efficient grid to full fill the needs of tomorrow. With a focus on growth and sustainability GE Grid Solutions plays a pivotable role in integrating Renewables onto the grid to drive to carbon neutral. In Grid Solutions we help enable the transition for a greener more reliable Grid. GE Grid Solutions has the most advanced and comprehensive product and solutions portfolio within the energy sector. 

Why we come to work: At GE Renewable Energy, our engineers are always up for the challenge - and we're always driven to find the best solution. Our projects are unique and interesting, and you'll need to bring a solution-focused, positive approach to each one to do your best. Surrounded by committed, loyal colleagues, if you can dare to bring your ingenuity and desire to make an impact, you'll be exposed to game-changing, diverse projects that truly allow you to play your part in the energy transition. 

What We Offer: 

- Working in an international team which is part of global Engineering HVDC Centre of Excellence
 - A key role in a dynamic, international working environment with a large degree of flexibility of work agreements
 - Competitive benefits, and great development opportunities

Job Description Summary

Systems engineering is a cross-functional engineering discipline centred on an approach, mindset, and process. All activities that consider both the business and the technical needs of the customers with the goal of providing a quality product that meets the users needs. The discipline that executes a robust process of design, creation, and optimization of systems, consisting of identification and quantification of system requirements, creation of alternate system design concepts, performance of design trade studies, selection and implementation of the best designs and verification that the design is properly integrated and executed. Process that proceeds from concept to production to operation. 

Impacts departmental operations and responsible for planning/execution. The role has some autonomy but is focused on execution of activities within an operating discipline covered by standard functional practices and procedures. 

Some judgment may be required but this is typically with guidance. 

The role will work within defined parameters to make decisions, apply concepts to issues of moderate complexity, and resolve issues through immediate action or short-term planning. 

We are looking for our future electrical technical project Lead Engineer to strengthen our engineering department. If you project yourself into our mission and our values, then here are more details on GE GRID, the missions of the position and who we wish to become

The GE Renewable - Grid Integration product line is globally recognized for the design, manufacture and supply of custom high voltage direct current (HVDC) solutions for utilities worldwide. With over 130 years of pioneering experience, GE offers two HVDC technologies, Line Commutated Converters (LCCs) and Voltage Source Converters (VSCs), to support a wide range of applications in different countries on land or at sea. 

Each HVDC solution is tailored and designed based on a project-by-project assessment of customer needs, whether connecting offshore wind generation, long-distance power transmission or utility trading. energy between independent power grids. 

In our department we design the control / command / protections of the AC part of HVDC substations. We are responsible for secondary and low voltage engineering, automation and protection. The department's teams are located in France, the United Kingdom and India. 

Our Technical project Lead Engineer contributes to our HVDC projects. You will be part of a project team that delivers the "conventional" control and protection system for our HVDC substations and is in charge of the electrical protection systems, interlocks, wiring and oversees the power supply studies for the auxiliary services. 

As a LV Secondary System Engineer, you will report to the Control System Engineering Manager and will be part of a highly motivated and dynamic team of engineers working on the requirement, design, integration, installation, and commissioning of HVDC and AC Control and Protection System. 

Job Description

Roles and Responsibilities

Overseeing the overall technical solution that meets customer Requirement

This Includes The Following Actives: 

- Requirement Capture, Gap Analysis
 - Define Schematic diagrams requirements of the Control & protection system and produce detailed design documentation, drawings, test specification and test report. 
 - Prepare substation Single line diagrams & Protection Single line diagrams and Protection list & specification. 
 - On the basis of the single line Diagram of the sub station and the architecture of the control system, clarify the specifications and refine the technical solution with the customer. 
 - Prepare Principal diagrams (Interlockings, Protection actions, Polarities, HVDC specific functions)
 - Monitor the manufacture of control and protection cabinets and supervise factory tests. 
 - Follow the departments standard design practices, engineering reviews and guidelines. 
 - Prepare Technical specification for cabling, fibre optic, cable list , Cable Schedule
 - Interface with equipment supplier and reviewing in-house designs and those produced by external contractors and analyse a variety of engineering data, documents, and reports. 
 - Ensure that design projects are undertaken by competent personnel and sub-contractors reviewing designs created by others
 - Participate in the investigation of technical problems and the establishment of procedures and corrective actions to avoid recurrences. 
 - Prepare Bill of Material for LV equipment using available tools. 
 - Prepare replies to customer comments on technical submittals in coordination with project management. 
 - Attend meeting with customers/contractors/ consultants for technical discussions. 
 - Prepare design calculations including load list, power consumption & heat dissipation data calculations. 
 - Define Control Panel requirements and produce detailed design documentation for the control system using standard design blocks. 
 - Panel Electrical Schematics (using Engineering Base tool)
 - Wire/Cable Schedules
 - Routine Test specification
 - General Assembly drawings
 - Bill of Materials
 - undefined
 - Oversee the testing and FAT witnessing of the Control System. 
 - Assist site activities relevant to the installation and commissioning of the control system. 
 - Share engineering information and promote open dialogue. 
 - Assure proper documentation of technical data generated for the assigned projects and/or tasks consistent with engineering policies and procedures. 

Required Qualifications

- Engineering degree in electrical or electronic engineering. 7 years minimum experience in an EPC project environment in the T&D, Power Gen, or Oil & Gas industries, with at least 2 projects as an engineer responsible for the business. Good experience in project management and budget management processes, quality, planning, R&O. Motivated to evolve in an international environment & recognizes himself in our key values. 
 - Good leadership, listening and communication skills. 
 - Experience in functional team management. 
 - Good experience in managing technical interfaces and systems integration. Solid knowledge of conventional substation control system design. Solid experience in the design of control and protection cabinets, preferably in high voltage substation or power plant environments. 
 - Good knowledge of the control and protection functions of high voltage AC substations. Good knowledge of ancillary services engineering in a substation environment and understanding of design/commissioning of secondary systems. Knowledge of networking and telecommunications. 
 - Experience with engineering tools such as AutoCAD, Engineering Base or Microsoft Visio. 

Desired Characteristics: 

Strong oral and written communication skills. Demonstrated ability to analyze and resolve problems. Ability to document, plan, market, and execute programs. Established project management skills. 

Additional Information

Relocation Assistance Provided: Yes

data.description:
Job ID: R-2026-27-Q01-0011

Department: ETPL AI

Designation: Staff Engineer

Experience: 6-9 years

Employment Type: Full-time

Location: Bangalore, India

About ETPL

eReleGo Technologies Private Limited (ETPL) is a Bengaluru-based technology company building scalable digital platforms across AdTech, EdTech, SaaS ERP, and FinTech domains. The company focuses on applying advanced technologies such as artificial intelligence and data-driven systems to solve real operational problems for businesses and educational institutions. 

As ETPL scales into a firm of larger size, revenue, and complexity, it is investing deliberately in building strong internal capabilities across leadership, operations, technology, people, and culture. The objective is not just rapid growth, but sustainable, future-ready growth supported by structured systems, strong talent, and accountable teams. 

About Crafter

Crafter is a comprehensive low-code / no-code Enterprise & SaaS platform that helps organizations build custom applications, automate workflows, and streamline core business processes without extensive technical expertise. 

Designed for startups, SMEs, and large enterprises seeking agility and efficiency, Crafter's visual drag-and-drop builder and modular solutions enable businesses to rapidly create applications, manage resources, and enhance customer engagement with minimal coding.   

Role Overview

We are seeking a Staff Engineer with 6 to 9 years of hands-on experience in Java and Spring Boot to provide technical leadership across one or more products within the ETPL AI portfolio. This role sits within ETPL's engineering capability and carries responsibility for backend architecture, system design, engineering quality, and the technical development of delivery teams. 

The Staff Engineer will be the senior technical authority within their product engineering context - owning architectural decisions, driving best practices, and ensuring that the systems they are responsible for are scalable, maintainable, and built to support enterprise-grade deployments. The role combines deep hands-on engineering with the influence and communication skills to lead other engineers and engage meaningfully with product and business stakeholders. 

This is a role for an engineer who has moved beyond individual contribution and is ready to shape how systems are designed, how teams deliver, and how technical quality is defined and maintained across a product. 

Key Responsibilities

- Provide technical leadership in the design, development, and evolution of backend systems and services built on Java and Spring Boot across assigned ETPL AI products
 - Own system architecture decisions for assigned product areas - ensuring scalability, modularity, security, and performance across multi-tenant enterprise deployments
 - Lead and mentor a team of engineers, conducting code reviews, architectural walkthroughs, and technical discussions that raise the capability and quality of the broader team
 - Translate product requirements and business logic into well-structured, maintainable technical designs - collaborating closely with product managers and senior stakeholders to ensure alignment between technical decisions and product outcomes
 - Define and enforce coding standards, design patterns, and engineering governance frameworks across the product codebase
 - Conduct architectural reviews and deep code audits to identify technical debt, performance bottlenecks, and structural risks - and lead the resolution of findings in a structured manner
 - Design and optimize data models, database schemas, and query performance across relational databases, particularly MySQL and PostgreSQL, to support high-volume, data-intensive operations
 - Drive the adoption of RESTful API design standards, microservices principles, and service integration patterns appropriate to ETPL's platform architecture
 - Own the technical quality of the software delivery lifecycle within the product team - including requirements validation, design reviews, testing governance, deployment oversight, and post-release monitoring
 - Identify, evaluate, and integrate appropriate libraries, frameworks, and tools to improve engineering efficiency, system reliability, and long-term maintainability
 - Act as the escalation point for critical technical issues and production incidents within the product, leading structured root cause analysis and resolution
 - Champion a culture of engineering excellence, documentation discipline, and continuous improvement within the product engineering team

Experience And Profile

- 6 to 9 years of hands-on software engineering experience, with strong and sustained depth in Java and Spring Boot
 - Demonstrated experience designing and delivering scalable, high-performance backend systems for enterprise or SaaS products
 - Experience leading or mentoring other engineers within a structured delivery team
 - Proven ability to make and communicate sound architectural decisions across backend systems, APIs, and data layers
 - Experience with microservices architecture, RESTful API design, and distributed systems is expected
 - Prior exposure to multi-tenant platform design or enterprise product engineering is an advantage

Skills And Attributes

- Deep mastery of Java and Spring Boot, with strong expertise in building modular, production-grade enterprise backend systems
 - Solid understanding of Spring ecosystem components - Spring MVC, Spring Security, Spring Data, Spring Cloud - and their appropriate application in enterprise contexts
 - Strong database engineering skills across relational databases (MySQL, PostgreSQL) including schema design, query optimization, indexing strategies, and performance tuning at scale
 - Proficiency in RESTful API design and development, with a clear understanding of API contracts, versioning, and integration standards
 - Experience with microservices architecture, service decomposition, and inter-service communication patterns including REST and message queuing (Kafka, RabbitMQ, or equivalent)
 - Familiarity with containerization and orchestration using Docker and Kubernetes, and with CI/CD pipeline tooling for structured, automated delivery
 - Proficiency with Git and structured branching strategies for collaborative development within multi-team engineering environments
 - Working knowledge of cloud platforms - AWS / Azure - and the deployment and infrastructure considerations relevant to enterprise SaaS products
 - Experience with unit testing, integration testing, and test-driven development practices, with a commitment to maintaining high automated test coverage
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving capability with structured root cause analysis - particularly under production pressure
 - Clear and effective communication skills, with the ability to articulate technical decisions and trade-offs to both engineering teams and non-technical stakeholders
 - A collaborative and mentoring disposition - genuinely invested in the growth of the engineers around them, not just personal technical output

Recruitment Process

ETPL follows a structured, assessment-led recruitment process focused on long-term fit and capability development. Shortlisted candidates will go through: 

- ETPL Aptitude Test (EAT) - to assess analytical ability, reasoning, and problem-solving
 - ETPL Psychometric Test (EPT) - to understand work style, behavioral tendencies, and role alignment
 - Interview Rounds - including functional and culture-fit discussionsThis process ensures fairness, transparency, and clarity for both the candidate and the organization. 

What do we offer

- Exposure to senior educators, institutional leaders, and industry practitioners
 - Opportunities to learn from internal capability-building initiatives and leadership programs
 - A growing organization that is investing in better systems, clearer roles, and stronger people practices
 - A work environment that values learning, ownership, and long-term career growthAs a scaling company, ETPL is evolving its processes, teams, and structures. This role suits individuals who are comfortable growing alongside the organization, contributing to improvement, and building strong foundations rather than expecting everything to be fully polished from day one. 

To apply you can send your resume to prashant. musale@erelego. com or DM me on (LinkedIn or +91-9167464004).

data.title: Lead AI Engineer (LLM Agents)-Immediate
data.description:
Location: Remote (India), working with a San Francisco-based founding team

Engagement: Full-time, long-term, dedicated

Experience: 8-10+ years in software engineering, including 2+ years building production LLM applications and agents

Openings: 1

Time zone: Flexible hours, with a daily live overlap with the founders

About the ClientOur client is an early-stage AI startup in San Francisco, founded by alumni of Harvard and MIT. The company is in stealth. It is building an agent-based product that takes complex, high-stakes paperwork off the hands of US families: working out what applies to them, researching official sources, handling correspondence and following up over weeks, with every step checked and backed by evidence. 

Parts of the product are already built and running in test. The team today is two co-founders and one engineer. As Lead Engineer, you will be the most senior technical person on the team. You will be the founders' technical partner, own the architecture, and lead the product into production with real users. 

The Role: CTO Judgement, Builder's HandsWe are looking for someone with the judgement of a CTO who still writes code every day. Expect roughly 70-80% of your week to be hands-on: designing, building, reviewing and shipping. The rest goes into technical direction, standards and growing the team. 

•      Own the architecture end to end, and be accountable for how the system behaves in production. 

•      Be the founders' technical partner: shape the roadmap, make build-vs-buy calls, size work honestly, and push back when something is the wrong thing to build. 

•      Set the engineering bar for code review, testing, evals, security and releases. 

•      Lead and mentor the engineers on the team, and help interview future hires. 

•      Lead from the front in production: when something breaks, you're on it, and you make sure it doesn't break the same way twice. 

This role is not for you if you haven't shipped production code in the last 12 months, or you'd rather manage engineers than build alongside them. 

What You'll Own•      Agent platform architecture: design the agent harness, with tool-calling loops that have budgets, stop conditions and failure recovery, and a check on every output before it reaches a user or an outside party. 

•      Model layer: route across model vendors with fallbacks, manage prompts and versions, and weigh the cost, latency and quality behind each choice. 

•      Durable, long-running workflows: agent runs that wait days or weeks for a reply, survive restarts and deployments, and can be audited afterwards. 

•      Evaluation and safety: build the eval framework that decides when an agent is correct, when it can act without a person approving, and when it must escalate. Trace and observe every run. 

•      Data, security and compliance: store sensitive personal records securely, with row-level access control, encryption, secrets management and audit trails. Get the platform ready for the security reviews (e. g. SOC 2) that customers and partners will ask for. 

•      Infrastructure and reliability: AWS and Azure architecture, infrastructure as code, CI/CD, monitoring and alerting. Build performance-critical services in Go, Rust or Python where TypeScript is not the right tool. 

•      Full-stack product: you will still ship features end to end, from the agent to the screen a family sees on phone or desktop. 

Milestones•      First 30 days: ship code in week one. Review the existing system, then agree an architecture, a risk list and a 90-day technical plan with the founders. 

•      By 90 days: the core agent harness, eval framework and production infrastructure are in place, and the first real users are live. 

•      By six months: the platform runs in production with real users, with measurable reliability and eval coverage, and the team ships to your standard. 

Core RequirementsSeniority and leadership•      8-10+ years of professional software engineering. In recent years you have worked as a tech lead, principal or staff engineer, founding engineer or CTO in early-stage startups, and still written production code throughout. 

•      You have owned the architecture of a production system from early design through scale, and lived with the consequences of your decisions. 

•      0-to-1 experience: you have taken a product from prototype to real users, at an early-stage startup or on a new product line. 

•      You have led or mentored a small team (2-8 engineers) without big-company process around you. 

Agents and AI systems (hands-on, in production)•      2+ years building LLM applications, including at least one agent system you architected, shipped to real users and ran in production. 

•      Deep understanding of agent architecture: 

-      tool and function calling

-      planning vs. execution, and single vs. multi-agent designs

-      context and memory management

-      human-in-the-loop approvals and guardrails

-      defence against prompt injection

•      You know the frameworks (LangGraph, OpenAI Agents SDK, Claude Agent SDK, Vercel AI SDK, MCP) well enough to know when to write the loop yourself. 

•      Structured output and failure handling: you get typed, schema-validated output from models, and you handle the cases where the model gets it wrong with retries, repair and fallbacks. 

•      Evaluation at production level: you have built eval sets and graders (including calibrated LLM-as-judge), wired regression gates into CI, and used the results to decide whether to ship. 

•      Running models in production economically: caching, routing, batching, and choosing the right model for each task. 

•      Designing around interfaces, so a model vendor, cloud or database can be swapped without a rewrite. 

Engineering depth•      Expert TypeScript across the stack: Node. js on the server and React in the browser. 

•      Production depth in at least one of Go, Rust or Python. 

•      Designing and running systems on AWS or Azure, with infrastructure as code (Terraform, Pulumi). 

•      PostgreSQL: data modelling, query performance and row-level security. 

•      Durable workflow engines and queues in production (e. g. Temporal, Inngest, Step Functions, Celery). 

•      Security engineering for sensitive personal data: threat modelling, access control, encryption, secrets handling and audit logging. 

•      Observability and incident response: tracing, metrics, alerting and post-mortems. 

•      Automated testing as a habit, including tests of behaviour that depends on a model. 

•      Heavy daily use of AI coding tools (e. g. Claude Code, Cursor, Codex). You set the team's standard for reviewing what they produce. 

Nice to Have•      Hands-on experience with both AWS and Azure. 

•      A previous founder, co-founder or CTO role at a startup. 

•      Research agents that search the web and cite sources; browser automation or voice agents; MCP servers you have built. 

•      Document processing: OCR and pulling data from scans and PDFs. 

•      Compliance work such as SOC 2, HIPAA or GDPR. 

•      Products in high-stakes, regulated areas such as legal, financial, government or healthcare paperwork. 

•      Public repos, technical writing, talks or open-source work on agent systems. This will make your application stand out. 

What We Look For Beyond Code•      A founder mindset: comfortable with ambiguity, owns outcomes, and cares about the people using the product. They are going through a hard time, so every screen, message and automated action matters. 

•      "Evidence before claims": when you say something works, you show the test, the log or the screenshot. 

•      A clear technical communicator: you can explain a trade-off to non-technical founders in plain words, and write a design doc engineers can build from. 

•      Excellent written and spoken English. You are comfortable on video: a daily stand-up with cameras on, plus short recorded video updates. 

•      A reliable internet connection, a quiet workspace, and your own laptop (32 GB RAM preferred, disk encryption on).

data.title: Lead System Designer & Product Security Representative
data.description:
Job Description Summary

We are seeking a Lead System Designer / Product Security Representative (LSD/PSR) to lead compliance, quality, and security governance for Ethos Design System (EDS) by ensuring all components meet QMS, regulatory, and secure development requirements throughout their lifecycle. 

This role ensures that components are designed, developed, verified, released, and maintained in accordance with Quality Management System (QMS) requirements, Secure Development Lifecycle (SDL) practices, regulatory expectations, and enterprise security standards. You will serve as the primary compliance steward for EDS, partnering with Product Management, UX, Engineering, Architecture, and Product Security teams to maintain audit readiness, security posture, documentation completeness, and release compliance. This includes complete ownership of QMS documentation, review coordination, approvals, and process compliance activities. 

Job Description

About the Ethos Design System (EDS)

EDS is the unified digital platform that powers GE HealthCare's global software portfolio. It serves as a comprehensive library of reusable UI components, design patterns, and accessibility standards that bridge the critical gap between User Experience (UX) and Engineering. By fostering a philosophy of "reduce, reuse, and recycle, " EDS enables hundreds of product teams to eliminate redundant coding and design work. We provide the foundational building blocks that ensure our clinical and operational applications are intuitive, consistent, and accessible, allowing teams to focus on patient safety. 

The Mission: Scale and Empowerment

We are in a phase of hyper-growth, scaling from 25 adopting products to over 100. This requires a leader who thinks like a founder. You must look beyond simple backlog management to think about scale, growth, and empowerment. You will build a self-service ecosystem that allows teams to move fast without breaking the consistent standards required for patient safety and accessibility. 

Core Responsibilities

- Quality & Compliance
 - QMS Ownership: Own QMS-related activities across the EDS component lifecycle. Set and own the program Design History File (DHF) strategy. 
 - Documentation & Traceability: Develop, maintain, and govern required design, development, verification, and release documentation. Ensure traceability between requirements, design artifacts, implementation, verification, and releases. 
 - Audit Readiness: Coordinate reviews, approvals, and signoffs for quality records. Support audits, assessments, and inspection of readiness activities while maintaining compliance with organizational development processes and regulatory requirements. 
 - Continuous Improvement: Drive continuous improvement of quality processes, templates, and workflows. Ensure component Technical Design Reviews (cTDR/dTDR/eTDR) align with program plans and needs. 
 - Product Security & Secure Development
 - Security Governance: Serve as the Product Security Representative for EDS, ensuring adherence to Secure Development Lifecycle requirements. 
 - Risk Management: Coordinate security reviews, threat modeling, and security risk assessments. Track remediation of vulnerabilities, security findings, and compliance gaps. 
 - Release Validation: Ensure security controls, evidence, and documentation are completed before releases. 
 - Engineering Partnership: Partner with engineering teams to implement secure coding and dependency management practices. Coordinate penetration testing, security scans, SBOM generation, and vulnerability management activities. Track security metrics, remediation SLAs, and compliance status across components. 
 - Governance & Program Oversight
 - Release Readiness: Establish release readiness checklists covering quality and security requirements. Maintain audit-ready records and ensure documentation integrity. 
 - Strategic Liaison: Act as the primary liaison between EDS teams, Quality, Regulatory, and Product Security organizations. Collaborate with Product, Architecture, UX, and Engineering to identify compliance risks and mitigation plans. 
 - Automation: Drive automation of QMS and security compliance processes where practical. Monitor compliance with KPIs and provide status reporting to leadership. 

Qualifications

- Experience: 10+ years of experience with Quality Management Systems (QMS) and regulated product development. 
 - Mandatory: Strong understanding of Secure Development Lifecycle practices. 
 - Mandatory: Experience coordinating security reviews, threat modeling, vulnerability management, and compliance activities. 
 - Domain Knowledge: Familiarity with design controls, traceability, audit readiness, and release governance. 
 - Process & Methodology: Experience in Agile Software Development, including associated concepts, tools, and practices. Ability to drive process improvements and compliance automation initiatives. 
 - AI Tooling: Experience using AI tools is a must to enhance workflows, optimize compliance checks, or assist in documentation generation. 
 - Leadership Skills: Strong cross-functional leadership, stakeholder management, and program coordination skills. 
 - Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field. 
Inclusion And Diversity

GE Healthcare is an Equal Opportunity Employer where inclusion matters. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, colour, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law. 

We expect all employees to live and breathe our behaviours: to act with humility and build trust; lead with transparency; deliver with focus, and drive ownership - always with unyielding integrity. 

Our total rewards are designed to unlock your ambition by giving you the boost and flexibility you need to turn your ideas into world-changing realities. Our salary and benefits are everything you'd expect from an organization with global strength and scale, and you'll be surrounded by career opportunities in a culture that fosters care, collaboration, and support.

data.title: Staff Engineer, CPU Core Verification
data.description:
Tenstorrent is leading the industry on cutting-edge AI technology, revolutionizing performance expectations, ease of use, and cost efficiency. With AI redefining the computing paradigm, solutions must evolve to unify innovations in software models, compilers, platforms, networking, and semiconductors. Our diverse team of technologists have developed a high performance RISC-V CPU from scratch, and share a passion for AI and a deep desire to build the best AI platform possible. We value collaboration, curiosity, and a commitment to solving hard problems. We are growing our team and looking for contributors of all seniorities. 

At Tenstorrent, we build open, state of the art compute for real workloads and real developers. You will own CPU core‐level verification, shaping how our out‐of‐order RISC‐V CPUs behave in silicon. 

This role is hybrid, based out of Bangalore, India. 

We welcome candidates at various experience levels for this role. During the interview process, candidates will be assessed for the appropriate level, and offers will align with that level, which may differ from the one in this posting. 

Who You Are

- You bring 8+ years in CPU verification or closely related digital design. 
 - You know high‐performance out‐of‐order CPU microarchitecture in depth. 
 - You work comfortably with RTL, waveforms, logs, and complex debug scenarios. 
 - You communicate clearly across design, DV, emulation, and post‐silicon teams. 

What We Need

- Plan and drive functional verification for CPU core features and complex microarchitectural scenarios. 
 - Develop UVM, assembly, and C/C++ based stimulus, functional models, and coverage for ISA, RISC-V extensions, and un-core components. 
 - Debug simulation and emulation regressions using RTL understanding, waveforms, and logs to identify and resolve issues efficiently. 
 - Build and enhance coverage models, testbenches, and debug infrastructure to improve verification quality and coverage closure. 
 - Collaborate with design, validation, and test teams to support bring-up and delivery of robust CPU cores and clusters. 

What You Will Learn

- How Tenstorrent designs and validates high‐performance RISC‐V CPU cores and clusters. 
 - Techniques for spanning pre‐silicon, emulation, and post‐silicon verification with shared stimulus. 
 - Ways to scale coverage, debug, and infrastructure across multiple CPU programs. 
 - How open hardware and software fit into Tenstorrent's broader compute roadmap. 

Tenstorrent offers a highly competitive compensation package and benefits, and we are an equal opportunity employer. 

This offer of employment is contingent upon the applicant being eligible to access U. S. export-controlled technology. Due to U. S. export laws, including those codified in the U. S. Export Administration Regulations (EAR), the Company is required to ensure compliance with these laws when transferring technology to nationals of certain countries (such as EAR Country Groups D: 1, E1, and E2). These requirements apply to persons located in the U. S. and all countries outside the U. S. As the position offered will have direct and/or indirect access to information, systems, or technologies subject to these laws, the offer may be contingent upon your citizenship/permanent residency status or ability to obtain prior license approval from the U. S. Commerce Department or applicable federal agency. If employment is not possible due to U. S. export laws, any offer of employment will be rescinded.

 - Support cross-platform initiatives through working knowledge of iOS development principles and mobile ecosystem standards. 
 - Foster a culture of collaboration, accountability, continuous improvement, and engineering excellence. 
 - Support recruitment, onboarding, and team growth initiatives. 
 - Strong advocate of clean, testable, and maintainable code. 

Key Technical Skills And Experience

Accountabilities

 - Learning: Stay informed of industry technology trends and innovations, and actively contribute to the organization's technology communities to foster a culture of technical excellence and growth. 

Analyst Expectations

- To perform prescribed activities in a timely manner and to a high standard consistently driving continuous improvement. 
 - Requires in-depth technical knowledge and experience in their assigned area of expertise
 - Thorough understanding of the underlying principles and concepts within the area of expertise
 - They lead and supervise a team, guiding and supporting professional development, allocating work requirements and coordinating team resources. 
 - If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L - Listen and be authentic, E - Energise and inspire, A - Align across the enterprise, D - Develop others. 
 - OR for an individual contributor, they develop technical expertise in work area, acting as an advisor where appropriate. 
 - Will have an impact on the work of related teams within the area. 
 - Partner with other functions and business areas. 
 - Takes responsibility for end results of a team's operational processing and activities. 
 - Escalate breaches of policies / procedure appropriately. 
 - Take responsibility for embedding new policies/ procedures adopted due to risk mitigation. 
 - Advise and influence decision making within own area of expertise. 
 - Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work you own or contribute to. Deliver your work and areas of responsibility in line with relevant rules, regulation and codes of conduct. 
 - Maintain and continually build an understanding of how own sub-function integrates with function, alongside knowledge of the organisations products, services and processes within the function. 
 - Demonstrate understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub-function. 
 - Make evaluative judgements based on the analysis of factual information, paying attention to detail. 
 - Resolve problems by identifying and selecting solutions through the application of acquired technical experience and will be guided by precedents. 
 - Guide and persuade team members and communicate complex / sensitive information. 
 - Act as contact point for stakeholders outside of the immediate function, while building a network of contacts outside team and external to the organisation. 

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship - our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset - to Empower, Challenge and Drive - the operating manual for how we behave.

data.title: Quality Engineer (6 Months Contract)
data.description:
Who are Inchcape

At Inchcape Shipping Services, our vision is to create a connected world where customers can trade successfully and make informed decisions in every port, everywhere. We achieve this by combining our worldwide infrastructure with local expertise, through our global network of more than 250 proprietary offices and a team of over 3, 000 dedicated professionals. Our diverse customer base includes owners and charterers in the oil, cruise, container, and bulk commodity sectors, as well as naval, government, and intergovernmental organizations. 

We have an ambitious growth model, and a career here is certainly going to be a rewarding one that will allow you to bring your skills & experience. We embrace change and are open to new thinking and pushing for positive change in our industry. 

Contract Type : Fixed term contract - 6 months

Main Purpose of Job: 

To analyze the system application, business requirements and responsible for the development and execution of test plan, test scenarios, test cases and quality control process to improve product quality for delivering defect free high quality software systems exceeding business expectations for ISS. 

Duties and Responsibilities: 

- Review and understand end to end business requirements, System/Application design, Integration, and functionalities/feature. 
 - Review and understand enterprise & solution architectures, design implementation of new features end-to-end considering both functional & non-functional requirements and the entire tech stack - frontend, backend, database, middleware, AWS, and DevOps
 - Effectively contribute to test plan creation, test strategy creation, develop test scenarios, develop test cases, collect test data, create test batches, perform test cases, report defects, track defect. 
 - Partner with other automation engineers to create a unified approach to automation across the team
 - Develop, execute and maintain automation test scripts, utilities, data sets leveraging commercial and/or open-source tools. 
 - Contribute in meetings, Scrums, and other inter-team interaction
 - Research and make recommendations to the group regarding new automation technology available and its proper application. 
 - Work with support, stakeholders, and developers to aid in replication of software defects. 
 - Provide guidance in good test design and implementation techniques. 
 - Automate testing of defects and assist with the maintenance of Regression Test suite. 
 - Responsible for creation, delivery, and maintenance of automated scripts. 
 - Prepare effort estimates for testing related tasks / projects. 
 - Prepare status reports and communicates to stakeholders. 
 - Propose/follow/develop SOP for all kind of test execution. 
 - Practice DevOps with automation first mindset, with excellent understanding of branching strategies, version control, best configuration, testing practices, build management, CI/CD pipeline. 

Person Specification : 

Knowledge

- Any Professional degree in computer science
 - Aability to quickly understand the business processes. 
 - All type of testing including Accessibility testing, Acceptance testing, Black box testing, End to end testing, Functional and non-functional testing, Feature testing, Interactive testing, Integration testing, load testing, Performance testing, Regression testing, Sanity testing and Security testing
 - Technical Knowledge: SQL, C#. NET, Webservices (XML, SOAP, HTTP, REST API), REST SHARP, AWS Cloud. 
 - Testing tools: TestRail, XUnit, Selenium, Sonar Cloud, Appium, Postman/SoapUI/ Rest-assured
 - Test Driven Development methodology
 - Agile product management tools: Jira, Confluence
 - DevOps tools (desirable): Bitbucket/GitHub, Sonar Cube, Team City, Selenium
 - Knowledge of maritime, Finance, Supply chain and logistics (desirable

Skills : 

- Test Automation, Test Driven Development methodology, C#. NET, XUnit, TestRail, Sonar Cloud, Selenium, Rest Sharp, Shift Left testing principles
 - Effective verbal & written communication skills in English
 - Excellent analytical, problem solving and trouble shooting skills
 - Strong collaborative and partner approach
 - Software engineering skills with high tech resilience
 - Agile development methodologies
 - DevOps mindset and Live site first approach

Experience : 

- 5 - 8 years in Software testing and quality assurance including both manual and automation testing. 
 - Creating and executing test plan, test cases, test scenarios, automate testing for software products. 
 - Experienced at building Object Repositories within test automation environments. 
 - A minimum of (3) years' experience in an automated testing environment. 
 - Exposure to Agile Methodologies. 
 - Experienced in assessing and developing the test automation framework. 
 - Exposure to Object Oriented programming language, C#
 - Prior experience with automated testing tools (Selenium); 
 - Experience using defect management tools. Experience in agile methodologies
 - Desirable experience: Performance Testing, Security Testing, Test Driven Delivery. 

Why Inchcape Shipping Services?

We believe in building a diverse and high-performing workforce that works together to provide our customers with the exceptional service they deserve. To reach the highest standards, we depend on our people, their welfare, training and expertise. We realize the value of our staff and know that your unique experiences, skills and passions will help you to build a rich and rewarding career in our dynamic industry. 

Our values are at the cente of everything we do, and the successful candidate will be expected to demonstrate and fully adopt these: 

Global Perspective - we connect the world and see the bigger picture. 

The Power of People - we rely on the strength of local agent knowledge and relationships. 

Progress - we adopt new thinking and push for positive change in our industry. 

In return, we will offer you: 

A diverse range of benefits, depending on your geographical location. Globally, as a minimum, you will receive: 

- A retirement savings plan
 - Life assurance
 - Holiday
 - Competitive salary
 - Employee Assistance Programme
 - Career development and progression opportunities
 - Values Award celebration events

Plus, much more!

If you think that you have the right skills, knowledge and attitude to join our team, then we invite you to apply by simply clicking at the top of this advert!

#ISSthebiggerpicture

Appointment to this role will be subject to satisfactory references and possession of a valid Right to Work documentation depending upon your geographical location. 

Inchcape is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer and equality, diversity and inclusion are at the centre of everything we do. We recognise that our customers, colleagues, contractors and other partners are central to our success and that we work in a diverse society. We acknowledge not only our legal, but also our moral responsibility to ensure all groups have equality of opportunity.

- Technically lead the sustenance team responsible for maintaining, supporting, and enhancing Network Automation and Orchestration products. 
 - Own the overall sustenance engineering lifecycle, including defect resolution, product enhancements, maintenance releases, and associated design, code, and unit/integration test artifacts. 
 - Drive engineering excellence through effective debugging, root-cause analysis, code quality, regression testing, and automation of repetitive maintenance activities. 
 - Analyse production issues and customer-reported defects, establish root causes, and drive timely resolution in collaboration with cross-functional teams. 
 - Mentor team members on troubleshooting, design principles, coding standards, testing practices, and effective problem-solving. 
 - Collaborate closely with Product Management, Development, QA, Customer Support, and other engineering teams to ensure end-to-end resolution of product issues and successful delivery of enhancements.

- Complete exposure to the entire Product Life Cycle (MUST HAVE)

 - Proficiency in local and remote debugging

Architecture and Design

data.title: Senior Staff Software Engineer (Development & Quality)
data.description:
About Kaseya

Kaseya is the leading provider of AI-powered IT management and cybersecurity software, serving Managed Service Providers (MSPs) and internal IT organizations worldwide. Our comprehensive platform helps organizations efficiently manage, secure, and automate their IT environments, driving operational efficiency and long-term business success. 

Backed by Insight Partners, a leading global software investor, Kaseya has experienced sustained double-digit growth and continues to expand its global footprint. Today, Kaseya supports customers in more than 20 countries and manages over 15 million endpoints worldwide. 

Founded in 2000, Kaseya was built by builders - and we're still building. We look for people who create rather than wait, who see a hard problem and lean in, and who treat challenges as raw material. At Kaseya, everyone plays a role in shaping the future of IT: whether you're in engineering, product, sales, marketing, customer support, or operations, your work helps protect, defend, and optimize IT environments across the globe. 

We're building teams that grow, perform, and make an impact. If you're driven by the itch to make things better - a product, a process, a career - you'll fit right in. 

At Kaseya, we don't just raise the bar. We build it. 

Senior Staff Software Engineer in Test, Endpoint Agent (Development & Automation Testing)

Why Kaseya?

Join a fast-growing company transforming the IT management and cybersecurity industry. At Kaseya, we are modernizing how software is designed, built, tested, and operated by combining strong engineering fundamentals with AI-native development practices. 

You will have the opportunity to shape not only our technology architecture, but also how engineering teams leverage AI to build high-quality software faster and more effectively. 

Join the Kaseya growth rocket ship and see how we are #ChangingLives

Job Summary

We are looking for a Senior Staff Software Development Engineer to help develop and maintain Kaseya's endpoint management agents across Windows, macOS, Linux, and mobile platforms. 

This is a hands-on software engineering role focused on building secure, reliable, and scalable endpoint management capabilities. The ideal candidate is passionate about operating systems, systems programming, device management, endpoint security, and software quality. 

Unlike traditional development environments where quality ownership is separated, our engineers own the full software lifecycle. You will design, develop, test, deploy, and support your solutions while building automated validation alongside the features you create. Successful candidates combine strong software engineering skills with a quality-first mindset and leverage automation to ensure reliability, maintainability, and release confidence at scale. 

What You Will Do

- Design and implement new features for endpoint agents across Windows, macOS, Linux, and mobile platforms. 
 - Develop software components supporting monitoring, automation, patching, inventory collection, remote actions, scripting, and device management. 
 - Write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code. 
 - Own features throughout the entire lifecycle from design and implementation through testing, deployment, and production support. 
 - Build automated tests and validation frameworks alongside feature development. 
 - Develop automated coverage for functional, integration, regression, resiliency, and system-level scenarios. 
 - Improve software quality through testability, diagnostics, telemetry, and automation. 
 - Investigate customer-reported issues and production escalations. 
 - Perform root-cause analysis and implement preventative solutions to avoid future recurrence. 
 - Reproduce complex issues across diverse operating system and endpoint environments. 
 - Improve agent stability, performance, scalability, security, and reliability. 
 - Develop integrations with operating system management, security frameworks, and device management APIs. 
 - Build telemetry and diagnostics capabilities that improve product supportability and troubleshooting. 
 - Collaborate with Product, Support, Cloud Platform, Security, and Engineering teams to deliver customer-focused solutions. 
 - Participate in design discussions, code reviews, architecture reviews, and sprint planning activities. 
 - Utilize AI-assisted development and testing tools to accelerate engineering productivity and improve software quality. 

What You Bring

Required Qualifications

- 12+ years of software engineering experience developing system software, endpoint software, platform services, or related applications. 
 - Strong proficiency in C# and . NET, including experience building production-grade applications and services. 
 - Experience building automated tests and validation capabilities as part of the software development lifecycle. 
 - Experience developing automated test frameworks and validation tooling using technologies such as xUnit, NUnit, MSTest, Selenium, Playwright or similar testing frameworks 
 - Experience with Windows system programming concepts such as Win32 APIs, Windows Services, WMI, Registry operations, process management, threading, security models, or related operating system capabilities. 
 - Strong knowledge of operating system fundamentals, including: Processes and threads, Filesystems, Networking, Services and daemons, Security models, Privilege management, Performance and resource utilization 
 - Strong troubleshooting, debugging, and root-cause analysis skills. 
 - Experience developing software that interacts with operating system services, APIs, or management frameworks. 
 - Understanding of software quality engineering principles, test automation, and CI/CD practices. 
 - Experience using AI-assisted development tools such as coding assistants, code generation tools, or intelligent debugging solutions. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with RMM, UEM, EDR, XDR, endpoint security, or device management products. 
 - Knowledge of C, C++, Rust, Go 
 - Experience with Microsoft Intune, Apple MDM, Android Enterprise, or Linux management platforms. 
 - Knowledge of PowerShell, Bash, Python, AppleScript, or other scripting technologies. 
 - Experience building test frameworks, automation libraries, or system-level validation tooling. 
 - Experience working with virtualization, containerization, or automated device provisioning environments. 
 - Familiarity with endpoint telemetry, diagnostics, observability, and monitoring systems. 

What Success Looks Like

A successful Senior Endpoint Software Engineer at Kaseya: 

- Builds secure, scalable, and high-quality endpoint software. 
 - Owns features end-to-end from design through production support. 
 - Demonstrates strong ownership of both software development and quality. 
 - Develops automated validation alongside feature implementation. 
 - Solves complex customer, platform, and operating system challenges. 
 - Improves the reliability, performance, security, and maintainability of endpoint agents. 
 - Rapidly diagnoses issues and implements long-term corrective solutions. 
 - Partners effectively across Product, Support, Security, Platform, and Engineering teams. 
 - Leverages AI-native engineering practices to improve productivity and accelerate delivery. 
 - Continuously grows expertise in operating systems, endpoint management, systems programming, and modern software development practices. 

Additional Information

Kaseya provides equal employment opportunity to all employees and applicants without regard to race, religion, age, ancestry, gender, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship status, physical or mental disability, veteran status, marital status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

As a Staff Reltio Architect, you will serve as the principal technical authority for our enterprise Master Data Management (MDM) ecosystem. You will lead the architectural design, configuration, and integration of the cloud-native Reltio Connected Data Platform. In this role, you will bridge the gap between complex business data needs and cutting-edge cloud architecture, ensuring high-performance entity resolution, robust data governance, and seamless real-time data streaming. 

Job Description

You will play a pivotal role in shaping the technical direction and architecture of our cutting-edge enterprise master data and healthcare data platform solutions. You will be responsible for designing and guiding the implementation of complex, cloud-native master data management (MDM) systems, ensuring scalability, reliability, and performance across various platforms. 

Responsibilities: **

- Lead the architectural design and development of enterprise MDM solutions, translating complex healthcare data requirements into robust and scalable technical designs using the Reltio Connected Data Platform. 
 - Define and enforce best practices for API Development, ensuring seamless real-time data integration, streaming, and interoperability across downstream and upstream healthcare systems. 
 - Architect and optimize MDM solutions leveraging Cloud Technology, aligning multi-tenant SaaS capabilities with organizational considerations for cost, security, compliance, and performance.

 - Drive the adoption of DevOps principles and practices, fostering continuous integration, deployment, and automated configuration management (JSON/UI) across tenant environments. 
 - Design and implement solutions incorporating Edge Computing and Embedded Systems Architecture, ensuring real-time data syndication and golden-record lookup capability for connected medical devices. 
 - Contribute to Full Stack Development efforts, ensuring architectural coherence from data-layer crosswalks and survivorship strategies to backend integrations and customer-facing UI/data steward consoles. 
 - Integrate Machine Learning (ML) capabilities into software products, utilizing advanced probabilistic matching, anomaly detection, and automated entity resolution. 
 - Design and evolve Microservices Architecture, promoting modularity, resilience, and independent deployability of data connectors and event-driven data streaming pipelines. 
 - Ensure adherence to Network Protocols and stringent healthcare security standards (including HIPAA, HITRUST, and data encryption) in all software designs. 
 - Champion Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) principles, promoting clean, maintainable, and extensible codebases for custom integration wrappers and data handlers. 
 - Oversee Performance Testing strategies and execution, ensuring high-throughput batch loading and low-latency API response times meet stringent performance requirements. 
 - Lead Software Design Architecture reviews, mentoring and guiding data engineering and MDM development teams on match/merge and survivorship logic. 
 - Provide technical leadership and oversight in Software Project Management, ensuring successful delivery of enterprise data-domain and architectural initiatives.

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.

 - Extensive experience with Cloud Technology (e. g. , AWS, Azure, GCP) and cloud-native architectures; direct experience with the Reltio SaaS environment is highly preferred. 
 - Strong proficiency in various Computer Programming languages and paradigms (e. g. , Java, Python).

 - Familiarity with Edge Computing and Embedded Systems Architecture principles as they relate to real-time distributed data consumption. 
 - Proficiency in Full Stack Development concepts, including data modeling, pipeline architecture, and front-end interface adjustments (JSON configuration). 
 - Experience with Machine Learning (ML) integration, matching algorithms, and automated data curation deployment. 
 - Demonstrated expertise in Microservices Architecture design and enterprise integration patterns. 
 - Strong understanding of Network Protocols, secure data transmission, and distributed systems. 
 - Mastery of Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) principles. 
 - Experience with Performance Testing methodologies, API load testing, and volume data optimization. 
 - Exceptional skills in Software Design Architecture, data modeling, pattern recognition, and entity resolution framework design.
